Prepare to face a mix of familiar and formidable new foes, and take on exceptional challenges. Earn <style="CE_Points">progress points</style> to open reward crates of increasing value as you fight and master every battle. 

Each Campaign highlights a specific faction and their allies. To fully maximise your rewards, you’ll need the three required characters. Don’t worry if you’re missing one or more—the borrowing system ensures you can still participate. 

Once you’ve completed the final battle in the Standard Campaign, you’ll unlock the Extremis Campaign, featuring even tougher challenges and even greater rewards! Progress in your chosen campaign is saved between Campaign Event instances. This means you can safely continue where you left off when the event returns in a few weeks, or choose to start a new campaign—if available. 

Are you ready for the challenge?

Campaigns/Elite_elite1_description: The <style="Faction_Necrons">Necrons</style> redoubled their forces and continue their relentless attack on Zeidos IV. The <style="Faction_Ultramarines">Ultramarines</style> have to steel their resolve and adapt their tactics to prevail.
Campaigns/Elite_elite2_description: The 13th Black Crusade envelops the fortress world Cadia. Push the <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Black Legion</style> forward and shatter the Imperial lines once and for all!
Campaigns/Elite_elite2_name_locked: Fall of Cadia Elite: Play now!
Campaigns/Elite_elite3_description: Dem Humie Tempaz krump really good. A propa fight for <style="Faction_Orks">Ork</style> Boss Gulgortz to prove that he is da mightiest Warboss!
Campaigns/Elite_elite4_description: Bring the wrath of the Bloody Handed onto the invaders of Craftworld Saim-Hann. Strike like the Serpent and bring down all foul Chaos spawn that desecrate the <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style>'s home.
Campaigns/EliteMirror_eliteMirror1_descr: The humans know no bounds to their insolence and continue to challenge the rightful sovereigns of Zeidos IV. Command your <style="Faction_Necrons">Necrons</style> forces to crush them once and for all!
Campaigns/EliteMirror_eliteMirror2_descr: Order the <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Astra Militarum</style> to stand against the forces of Chaos and never give an inch, no matter the odds!
Campaigns/EliteMirror_eliteMirror2_name_: Fall of Cadia Mirror Elite: Play now!
Campaigns/EliteMirror_eliteMirror3_descr: Suffer not the unclean to live and uphold the honour of the Emperor! Show no remorse with the <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Black Templars</style>, no matter which vile Xenos oppose them.
Campaigns/EliteMirror_eliteMirror4_descr: Let the <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thousand Sons</style> sorcerers shatter the futile efforts of the Xenos to avoid their fate, as fate is merely a skein of a possible future that is yours to change and shape.
Campaigns/Mirror_mirror1_description: The Szarekhan Dynasty’s operations in the Pariah Nexus are of vital importance. The humans making a desperate stand on Zeidos IV must be eradicated!
Campaigns/Mirror_mirror2_description: The Astra Militarum is mounting a desperate last stand on Cadia, supported by other Imperial elements. Mount a daring counter-offensive to drive back the forces of Chaos!
Campaigns/Mirror_mirror3_description: The Black Templars gain no respite after hard battles in the Octarius Sector. Stand with them in this war of attrition against marauding Orks, frozen landscapes and even worse terrors!
Campaigns/Mirror_mirror4_description: Craft schemes within schemes with the <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thousand Sons</style> to pry out the arcane knowledge harboured deep in the core of Craftworld Saim-Hann!
Campaigns/Standard_campaign1_description: War rages across the Pariah Nexus as the Necrons ravage world after world. On the arid planet Zeidos IV, the Ultramarines make a stand to turn the tide.
Campaigns/Standard_campaign2_description: The 13th Black Crusade has reached the fortress world Cadia. Take command of the <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Black Legion</style> as they make landfall!
Campaigns/Standard_campaign3_description: In the Octarius Sector, the snow planet Orrok is held by the Imperials. Take charge of the savage <style="Faction_Orks">Orks</style> and show dem Humies who’s da boss!
Campaigns/Standard_campaign4_description: On Craftworld Saim-Hann the Seers have a terrifying vision. Guide the <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> on a quest to alter fate and prevent the invasion of their home.
Dialogue/c1battle01_end_01: I made quick work of those Xenos. Thank the Emperor.
Dialogue/c1battle01_start_01_a: The Necrons may have separated me from my battle brothers.
Dialogue/c1battle01_start_01_b: But such minor obstacles shall not keep us from our mission.
Dialogue/c1battle01_start_03_a: Necron Warriors! Where there are few, there are many.
Dialogue/c1battle01_start_03_b: I must destroy them before they can alert their overlord to my presence.
Dialogue/c1battle02_end_01: Now, to reunite with my brothers...
Dialogue/c1battle03_end_01_a: Our orders are to reunite with Chapter Master Marneus Calgar.
Dialogue/c1battle03_end_01_b: The closer we draw to him, the more pitched the battles are sure to become.
Dialogue/c1battle03_end_02: Then we will fight harder! For the Emperor!
Dialogue/c1battle03_start_01: Sergeant Bellator! Ready your squad! We have Necron Warriors incoming!
Dialogue/c1battle03_start_02: Brother Tigurius! Your arrival is always welcome.
Dialogue/c1battle03_start_04: They may be voiceless, but they meet their end with a monstrous crackle.
Dialogue/c1battle03_start_05: Then let us shatter the silence with the sounds of their demise.
Dialogue/c1battle05_end_01_a: I detect no sign of our fellow Battle Brothers.
Dialogue/c1battle05_end_01_b: It occurs to me that we may well be the only survivors.
Dialogue/c1battle05_end_02: Do not lose hope, Sergeant Certus. Have faith.
Dialogue/c1battle05_start_01: Well met, Brother Tigurius! I have been tracking your movements for some time now.
Dialogue/c1battle05_start_02: So I have sensed! It is good to lay eyes on you, Sergeant Certus.
Dialogue/c1battle05_start_03_a: This raises my hope that more of our Brothers may have survived planetfall as well.
Dialogue/c1battle05_start_03_b: Should we begin searching for them?
Dialogue/c1battle05_start_04: I fear we have more pressing matters at the moment.
Dialogue/c1battle07_end_01: We have tested these xenos’ mettle and found them unworthy.
Dialogue/c1battle07_end_02_a: Beware of complacency, brothers! We will face far greater challenges soon enough!
Dialogue/c1battle07_end_02_b: Their overlord is undoubtedly aware of our presence by now.
Dialogue/c1battle07_start_01: Remain vigilant, Brothers. The Necrons we face grow ever more challenging.
Dialogue/c1battle07_start_02: Then we shall hit them harder.
Dialogue/c1battle07_start_03: And fill them with Mortis Rounds...
Dialogue/c1battle07_start_04: No armour can protect them from my mind!
Dialogue/c1battle08_end_01: Ultramarines? Thank the Emperor you’ve finally arrived!
Dialogue/c1battle08_end_02: A battle sister? We had been told that all of the Adepta Sororitas here had made the ultimate sacrifice.
Dialogue/c1battle08_end_03_a: We have no time to explain!
Dialogue/c1battle09_end_01: Well met, Ultramarines. I am Sister Vindicta, and your help is most appreciated.
Dialogue/c1battle09_start_01: The purity of the Emperor’s wrath shall scour these foul xenos from this planet.
Dialogue/c1battle09_start_02: Your flames leave behind nothing but ash.
Dialogue/c1battle09_start_03: Then I shall let them feed!
Dialogue/c1battle10_end_01_a: That seems like a fine start.
Dialogue/c1battle10_end_02_a: We must defeat the Royal Warden commanding these xenos first.
Dialogue/c1battle10_end_02_b: Then we can hunt down this Hexmark Destroyer.
Dialogue/c1battle10_start_01: Sister Vindicta, how do we come to find you in this state?
Dialogue/c1battle10_start_02_a: A Hexmark Destroyer ambushed us and buried my unit with a landslide.
Dialogue/c1battle10_start_02_b: By the time I dug my way out, the Necrons had advanced – and my fellow sisters were dead.
Dialogue/c1battle10_start_04_b: Let us see what can be done to make good on that.
Dialogue/c1battle11_end_01: There may be more to these infernal machines than there seems...
Dialogue/c1battle11_start_01: Take care, brothers. I sense xenos hiding in the tall grasses ahead.
Dialogue/c1battle11_start_02: If they can use it for cover, then we can too.
Dialogue/c1battle11_start_03: But they cannot hide from us.
Dialogue/c1battle12_end_01_a: Don't let the words of the Xenos distract you, brothers.
Dialogue/c1battle12_end_01_b: We are the Angels of Death and we will be its end!
Dialogue/c1battle12_start_01: We are near the Royal Warden! Keep pressing forward!
Dialogue/c1battle12_start_02_a: Your reckless agenda is illogical, humans.
Dialogue/c1battle12_start_02_b: You cannot kill what does not live.
Dialogue/c1battle13_end_01_a: Keep sending those pawns of yours against us!
Dialogue/c1battle13_end_01_b: We shall shatter their silence as we grant them their ends!
Dialogue/c1battle13_start_01: The Royal Warden is ahead. Adhere to Tactical Doctrine!
Dialogue/c1battle13_start_02_b: Should I fall, others will take my place.
Dialogue/c1battle13_start_03: Then we shall destroy them as well!
Dialogue/c1battle14_end_01: Certus! Have you ascertained the location of the Royal Warden yet?
Dialogue/c1battle14_end_02: I have the Necron leader in my sights.
Dialogue/c1battle14_meta_01: I shall Vox through to Command and request reinforcements
Dialogue/c1battle14_meta_02: Ultramarines Command! We require an Apothecary to join our fight!
Dialogue/c1battle14_meta_03: Let us pray that he is not too late.
Dialogue/c1battle14_start_01: I foresee a victory close at hand!
Dialogue/c1battle14_start_02: Engage, brothers! Let our fury be the last thing they know.
Dialogue/c1battle15_end_01: So much for the Royal Warden and his predictions of our failure.
Dialogue/c1battle15_end_02: He is finished. Who shall be next?
Dialogue/c1battle15_end_03_b: The filthy xenos that set off the avalanche that buried me.
Dialogue/c1battle15_end_04_a: Then we shall have to return the favour...
Dialogue/c1battle15_end_04_b: By returning him to his tomb.
Dialogue/c1battle15_meta_01: Brothers! Thank the Emperor you held out!
Dialogue/c1battle15_meta_02: Apothecary Incisus! You arrive none too soon!
Dialogue/c1battle15_meta2_01: Brothers! Have I arrived too late?
Dialogue/c1battle15_meta2_02: Apothecary Incisus! Thank the Emperor. We shall put your skills to good use.
Dialogue/c1battle15_start_01: Makhotep! The moment of your demise has arrived!
Dialogue/c1battle16_end_01: Sister Vindicta. What can you tell us about our next target?
Dialogue/c1battle16_end_02_a: Hexmark Destroyer Imospekh is a formidable foe.
Dialogue/c1battle16_end_02_b: His mind is sharper than most.
Dialogue/c1battle16_end_03_a: Then we shall not underestimate him.
Dialogue/c1battle16_end_03_b: And we shall avenge the loss of your sisters as well.
Dialogue/c1battle16_start_01_a: I bring dire news concerning Chapter Master Marneus Calgar.
Dialogue/c1battle16_start_01_b: His Thunderhawk dropship was damaged on re-entry. All aboard are feared lost!
Dialogue/c1battle16_start_02_b: But whether in his name or under his command, we shall fight on.
Dialogue/c1battle17_end_01: These creatures thought they could evade us on these cliffs.
Dialogue/c1battle17_end_02: As with their emergence on this planet, they were wrong.
Dialogue/c1battle17_start_01_a: I sense a Necron installation in those cliffs ahead.
Dialogue/c1battle17_start_01_b: And it is occupied. We must root them out.
Dialogue/c1battle17_start_02: We shall not allow them to remain.
Dialogue/c1battle18_end_01: If the Emperor wishes for vengeance, then I am his instrument.
Dialogue/c1battle18_start_01: I regret we did not arrive soon enough to save your sisters, Vindicta.
Dialogue/c1battle18_start_02_a: I admit, I struggle to see the Emperor’s plan there.
Dialogue/c1battle18_start_03_a: It is a miracle that you alone were left alive.
Dialogue/c1battle18_start_03_b: Fate must have much in store for you.
Dialogue/c1battle19_end_01: We are the Ultramarines, the sons of Guilliman. Whilst we draw breath, we stand.
Dialogue/c1battle19_end_02: Whilst we stand, we fight. Whilst we fight, we prevail. Nothing shall stay our wrath.
Dialogue/c1battle19_start_01_a: We cannot allow the xenos to delay us further.
Dialogue/c1battle19_start_01_b: We must strike hard and fast.
Dialogue/c1battle19_start_02_a: For Marneus Calgar, whether he be dead or alive.
Dialogue/c1battle20_end_01: Beware! I sense even more dangerous foes in our path.
Dialogue/c1battle20_end_02: Then we shall blaze our path through them.
Dialogue/c1battle20_start_01_a: Were I in charge of the xenos, I might think this a fine place to stage an ambush.
Dialogue/c1battle20_start_01_b: And I sense that my suspicions are correct.
Dialogue/c1battle20_start_02: We could simply let our foes come to us...
Dialogue/c1battle20_start_03_a: Unlike the Necrons, we are needed elsewhere.
Dialogue/c1battle20_start_03_b: And so we must press forward.
Dialogue/c1battle21_end_01: Good work! The more of them we destroy, the nearer our target draws...
Dialogue/c1battle21_start_02_b: He cannot be far from our grasp.
Dialogue/c1battle22_end_01: Be you motivated by rage or retribution, Sister, I cannot argue with your results.
Dialogue/c1battle22_start_01: Take care, Sister Vindicta. Do not let anger cloud your judgment.
Dialogue/c1battle23_end_01_b: It matters not how they change. Their ends shall all be the same.
Dialogue/c1battle23_start_01: Hold, Brothers and Sister! I sense new dangers ahead.
Dialogue/c1battle23_start_02: We need not your abilities to suspect that, Brother Tigurius!
Dialogue/c1battle23_start_03: The Deathmarks! They are evolving right before us!
Dialogue/c1battle24_end_01: If they bear some fashion of actual intelligence, perhaps that might teach them a lesson.
Dialogue/c1battle24_start_01: The xenos are circling us to come at us from behind.
Dialogue/c1battle24_start_02_a: Which direction they come from does not matter.
Dialogue/c1battle24_start_02_b: Wherever they meet us, they shall be destroyed.
Dialogue/c1battle25_end_01_b: One step closer to our ultimate goal.
Dialogue/c1battle26_end_01_a: It matters not what our foes are made of.
Dialogue/c1battle26_end_01_b: They shall be torn apart just the same.
Dialogue/c1battle26_start_01_a: Even as an apothecary, it is striking how these xenos differ so greatly from humanity.
Dialogue/c1battle26_start_01_b: Blasphemous as they are, they fight just as hard.
Dialogue/c1battle26_start_02: In that case, it is up to us to fight harder, brother. For the Emperor!
Dialogue/c1battle27_end_01: I can sense Imospekh growing closer. Not much further now...
Dialogue/c1battle27_start_01: As we get closer to the xenos’ centre of power, the taint they have left upon this land becomes greater.
Dialogue/c1battle27_start_03: It is Imospekh who ought to be praying.
Dialogue/c1battle28_end_01: Brothers! Vindicta! We have made our way through!
Dialogue/c1battle28_start_01_a: The xenos are attempting to flank us. We must split up.
Dialogue/c1battle29_start_01_a: Imospekh! It does not matter how many you throw against us.
Dialogue/c1battle30_end_01: It is my hope that Imospekh’s demise brings your battle sisters some peace, Vindicta.
Dialogue/c1battle30_end_02_a: Imospekh was merely the tool of their doom.
Dialogue/c1battle30_end_02_b: It is Plasmancer Thutmose who bears the ultimate blame. He gave Imospekh the order.
Dialogue/c1battle30_end_03_a: In that case, we shall press your case against him as well.
Dialogue/c1battle30_end_03_b: The Emperor’s wrath will shine on his tomb.
Dialogue/c1battle30_start_01_b: I find it fitting that you do not speak.
Dialogue/c1battle30_start_03: If you had any final words, we would ensure they were forgotten.
Dialogue/c1battle31_end_01: Chief Librarian! What news of our Chapter Master?
Dialogue/c1battle31_end_02_a: He yet lives, but the xenos have him pinned down.
Dialogue/c1battle31_end_02_b: So we shall pry him free.
Dialogue/c1battle31_start_01_b: Our Chapter Master requires our assistance!
Dialogue/c1battle31_start_02: I never doubted that he would survive.
Dialogue/c1battle31_start_03_a: We shall rush to his side in due time.
Dialogue/c1battle31_start_03_b: But first let us deal with the matter at hand.
Dialogue/c1battle32_end_01: We shall avenge your sisters, Vindicta, before this fight is through.
Dialogue/c1battle32_end_02_a: That is my most fervent wish.
Dialogue/c1battle32_end_02_b: But the Emperor’s plans come before vengeance.
Dialogue/c1battle32_start_01: Thank the Emperor that you yet have a chance to assist your Chapter Master.
Dialogue/c1battle32_start_02: Would that you had been so fortunate with your battle sisters.
Dialogue/c1battle32_start_03_a: They died in the service of the Emperor.
Dialogue/c1battle32_start_03_b: We have all pledged ourselves to that fate.
Dialogue/c1battle33_end_01_a: You are correct as always, Chief Librarian Tigurius.
Dialogue/c1battle33_end_02: The Emperor’s will is all that requires our focus.
Dialogue/c1battle33_start_01: Brother Incisus, I do not need my powers to see that something weighs heavily on your mind.
Dialogue/c1battle33_start_02_a: It’s these xenos and their silence.
Dialogue/c1battle33_start_02_b: They must be communicating somehow, at least with each other.
Dialogue/c1battle33_start_03_a: I urge you to set aside your concerns.
Dialogue/c1battle33_start_03_b: Better they stay silent than to poison our minds.
Dialogue/c1battle34_end_01: Our faith has seen us through once again.
Dialogue/c1battle34_start_01_a: This planet seems to be overflowing with xenos.
Dialogue/c1battle34_start_01_b: They may keep us from reaching Chapter Master Calgar in time.
Dialogue/c1battle34_start_02_a: We cannot know our place in the Emperor’s plans.
Dialogue/c1battle34_start_02_b: We can only play our parts as best we can.
Dialogue/c1battle35_end_01: Our faith shall always see us through.
Dialogue/c1battle35_start_01_a: The resistance from the Necrons is increasing.
Dialogue/c1battle35_start_01_b: This is a good sign. We must be drawing closer to the Chapter Master.
Dialogue/c1battle35_start_02: So, the harder the battle goes, the firmer your faith?
Dialogue/c1battle35_start_03: So it has always been and will always be.
Dialogue/c1battle36_end_01_a: A job well and thoroughly done.
Dialogue/c1battle36_end_01_b: For that, our reward is further foes to slay.
Dialogue/c1battle36_start_01: These clusters of smaller xenos frustrate me. I yearn for a bigger target.
Dialogue/c1battle36_start_02_a: All of the Emperor’s foes need dealing with.
Dialogue/c1battle36_start_03: So let us make quick work of them.
Dialogue/c1battle37_start_01: Look! They send even more of these swarms against us.
Dialogue/c1battle37_start_02: They will fare as well as the others.
Dialogue/c1battle37_start_03: What you cannot crush, I shall burn!
Dialogue/c1battle38_end_01_a: Now that smell has come to mean something else to me.
Dialogue/c1battle38_start_01_a: The stench of these xenos burning reminds me of my homeworld.
Dialogue/c1battle38_start_01_b: The stench from the dump-fires never abated there.
Dialogue/c1battle38_start_02: Were you glad to put that place behind you?
Dialogue/c1battle38_start_03_a: I was glad to be of service to the Emperor.
Dialogue/c1battle38_start_03_b: All other concerns paled by comparison.
Dialogue/c1battle39_end_02: May his ammunition hold out just as long.
Dialogue/c1battle39_start_01: I had hoped we would have seen some sign of your Chapter Master by now.
Dialogue/c1battle39_start_02: I can sense him out there. He yet lives.
Dialogue/c1battle39_start_03: Let us move quickly to ensure that he remains that way.
Dialogue/c1battle40_start_01: Listen! You can hear the Chapter Master battling in that direction.
Dialogue/c1battle40_start_02: We must reach him before he falls.
Dialogue/c1battle40_start_03_a: The Emperor is on our side.
Dialogue/c1battle41_end_01_a: I thought we only needed to draw the xenos away from your chapter master.
Dialogue/c1battle41_end_01_b: Is his life now in peril?
Dialogue/c1battle41_end_02_a: Matters change rapidly on the battlefield, I’m afraid.
Dialogue/c1battle41_end_02_b: We are all in peril now.
Dialogue/c1battle41_end_03: We appear to still be on the right track.
Dialogue/c1battle41_end_04: As long as we can hear the Chapter Master’s weapons, he yet lives.
Dialogue/c1battle41_start_01_b: Where the battle is the most desperate, that is where we shall find Chapter Master Calgar.
Dialogue/c1battle42_end_01: We must work more quickly if we are to reach the Chapter Master in time.
Dialogue/c1battle42_end_02_a: Let us pray that he can hold out.
Dialogue/c1battle42_end_02_b: Emperor - grant that we arrive at his side before it is too late.
Dialogue/c1battle42_start_01: Aleph-Null itself is leading the attack on Chapter Master Calgar.
Dialogue/c1battle42_start_03_b: It is far better to rescue than to avenge.
Dialogue/c1battle43_end_01: We shall cleanse this world with the light of the Emperor.
Dialogue/c1battle43_start_01: The land itself becomes more foul as we near this Aleph-Null.
Dialogue/c1battle43_start_02: The xenos have tainted it with their touch.
Dialogue/c1battle43_start_03: Let us scour this planet clean.
Dialogue/c1battle44_end_01: That is the last of them.
Dialogue/c1battle44_end_02: Nothing stands between us and the Chapter Master now.
Dialogue/c1battle44_start_01_a: I am in telepathic contact with the Chapter Master.
Dialogue/c1battle44_start_03_a: He will not surrender until death claims him.
Dialogue/c1battle44_start_03_b: We have no time to lose.
Dialogue/c1battle45_end_01_a: My gratitude for your assistance, brothers and sister!
Dialogue/c1battle45_end_01_b: With the way clear, I can now rejoin the main Ultramarines force and take command once again.
Dialogue/c1battle45_end_02: It is our honour to fulfil our duty, Chapter Master.
Dialogue/c1battle45_end_03: Your reward for a job well done is another vital request.
Dialogue/c1battle45_end_04: That is all we would ever seek.
Dialogue/c1battle45_end_05: May the Emperor’s light continue to shine upon you.
Dialogue/c1battle45_start_03_a: Now let us put an end to Aleph-Null. Together.
Dialogue/c1battle46_end_01: We have given the Chapter Master a chance to get clear.
Dialogue/c1battle46_end_02: Now he must do the same for us...
Dialogue/c1battle46_start_01: I have our orders from Chapter Master Marneus Calgar.
Dialogue/c1battle46_start_02: Can you share them with us, Chief Librarian?
Dialogue/c1battle46_start_03_b: First, we must draw these xenos toward us so the Chapter Master may depart.
Dialogue/c1battle47_end_01: That does not seem to have stemmed the flow of xenos.
Dialogue/c1battle47_end_02: The road to our goal shall be paved with Necrons.
Dialogue/c1battle47_start_01: If the Chapter Master is drawing the Necrons away from us, why are there still so many?
Dialogue/c1battle47_start_02: The xenos cover this planet like vermin.
Dialogue/c1battle47_start_03: Then we must exterminate them with all prejudice.
Dialogue/c1battle48_end_01: Our ultimate target is none other than Plasmancer Thutmose.
Dialogue/c1battle48_start_02_a: It wishes to record where we are heading and why – for its chronicle, Chief Librarian.
Dialogue/c1battle48_start_02_b: In that, it echoes my own thoughts.
Dialogue/c1battle48_start_03: I believe the answer shall please you.
Dialogue/c1battle49_end_01_a: I find revenge is a dish best served flaming hot.
Dialogue/c1battle49_end_01_b: And I have just the weaponry for that.
Dialogue/c1battle49_start_01: Thutmose? Isn’t that the plasmancer who ordered Imospekh to destroy your unit, sister?
Dialogue/c1battle49_start_02: Correct. And it seems the time to avenge them has finally arrived.
Dialogue/c1battle50_end_01_a: Do not let the plasmancer enrage you.
Dialogue/c1battle50_end_01_b: The Necrons will only use that against us.
Dialogue/c1battle50_end_02_a: My rage is already an inferno.
Dialogue/c1battle50_end_02_b: And it shall incinerate them all!
Dialogue/c1battle50_start_01_a: Foolish bone-bags. I have already destroyed your Battle Sisters.
Dialogue/c1battle50_start_01_b: Now I will bury you as well.
Dialogue/c1battle50_start_02: You will pay for your tricks, Plasmancer!
Dialogue/c1battle50_start_03: It is no trick to defeat inferior creatures.
Dialogue/c1battle51_end_01_a: This is all part of the plan, Brothers and Sister.
Dialogue/c1battle51_end_01_b: The more Thutmose focuses on us, the better.
Dialogue/c1battle51_start_01_b: Taunt Plasmancer Thutmose as much as you wish.
Dialogue/c1battle51_start_02: I worry that such tactics could be dangerous, Chief Librarian.
Dialogue/c1battle51_start_03_b: But for the Necrons, not us.
Dialogue/c1battle52_end_01_a: This planet may not be salvageable.
Dialogue/c1battle52_end_01_b: But we cannot let the Necrons have it.
Dialogue/c1battle52_start_01_a: These strange pylons worry me, Chief Librarian.
Dialogue/c1battle52_start_01_b: They seem to glow with blasphemous power.
Dialogue/c1battle52_start_02_a: You are right to be wary, Brother Incisus.
Dialogue/c1battle53_end_01: I wonder how much will remain of this planet when we’re done.
Dialogue/c1battle53_end_02: We can only save what is salvageable to start with.
Dialogue/c1battle53_start_01: It is a pity what the Necrons have done to this place.
Dialogue/c1battle53_start_02: They have much to pay for, both from before and in the course of this war.
Dialogue/c1battle53_start_03_a: Our fight against the Necrons is like a surgeon removing an infection.
Dialogue/c1battle53_start_03_b: We must cleanse the wound before it kills the patient.
Dialogue/c1battle54_end_01_a: Excellent. Keep the plasmancer’s attention focused on us.
Dialogue/c1battle54_end_01_b: All the better for the Chapter Master’s plan.
Dialogue/c1battle54_start_01_a: Keep throwing your filth at us, Thutmose!
Dialogue/c1battle54_start_02_b: You cannot count us, much less kill us.
Dialogue/c1battle54_start_03: We shall be happy to watch our tally grow.
Dialogue/c1battle55_end_01_a: I am grateful that your Chapter Master sent us after Thutmose.
Dialogue/c1battle55_end_01_b: I may even have suggested such an action to him.
Dialogue/c1battle55_start_01: What would you have done, Sister Vindicta, if our orders had not led us to Thutmose?
Dialogue/c1battle55_start_02: I would have requested permission to pursue him myself.
Dialogue/c1battle55_start_03_a: That would have been a pity.
Dialogue/c1battle55_start_03_b: No single one of us would be able to face up to such a force on our own.
Dialogue/c1battle56_end_01_a: Easy, Thutmose? We still stand, all of us. Where are your underlings now?
Dialogue/c1battle56_end_01_b: Their remains lie strewn in our wake.
Dialogue/c1battle56_start_01_a: Humans. You are so soft and breakable.
Dialogue/c1battle57_end_01_b: Does the cherub express its wishes or your own?
Dialogue/c1battle57_end_02_b: They are one and the same.
Dialogue/c1battle57_start_01_b: We are coming for your head!
Dialogue/c1battle57_start_03_b: Your request is about to be granted.
Dialogue/c1battle58_end_01_a: Plasmancer! Inform Overlord Anuphet that your brethren should make room for you!
Dialogue/c1battle58_start_01_a: If the idea was to anger the plasmancer into throwing everything they have against us...
Dialogue/c1battle58_start_01_b: It seems to have been a marvellous success.
Dialogue/c1battle58_start_02: Sister Vindicta is doing an excellent job at taunting our foes into our reach.
Dialogue/c1battle58_start_03: Our only duty then is to exact from them the full price of their mistake.
Dialogue/c1battle59_end_01: Thutmose! Is that all you have to challenge us with?
Dialogue/c1battle59_end_02_a: Approach me at your peril, meat puppets.
Dialogue/c1battle59_start_01_a: Have you lost your poor excuses for minds?
Dialogue/c1battle59_start_01_b: You are begging for death. I shall grant your wish.
Dialogue/c1battle60_end_01: Sister Vindicta, you have finally brought your battle sisters justice.
Dialogue/c1battle60_end_02_a: My sisters rest easier now, yes, but my last mission with them remains unfinished.
Dialogue/c1battle60_end_02_b: For that, we need to procure Overlord Anuphet’s head.
Dialogue/c1battle60_end_05: Overlord Anuphet! We have put an end to your plasmancer!
Dialogue/c1battle60_end_06: Our next objective is to put an end to you!
Dialogue/c1battle60_start_02_b: We will scour you from existence!
Dialogue/c1battle60_start_03_a: Listen, my sisters, as our weapons sing your song of vengeance!
Dialogue/c1battle60_start_03_b: Our choir shall reach the Emperor’s ears!
Dialogue/c1battle61_end_01: Chapter Master Calgar! I believe we have Anuphet’s full attention.
Dialogue/c1battle61_end_03: All is going according to plan.
Dialogue/c1battle61_start_01: Ultramarines: You shall pay for the destruction of my plasmancer!
Dialogue/c1battle61_start_02: I will strip your armour from your corpses and use it to rebuild Thutmose!
Dialogue/c1battle61_start_03: We do not fear you, Necron.
Dialogue/c1battle61_start_04: Our faith is our armour, and it cannot be torn from us by any means.
Dialogue/c1battle62_end_01_b: Calgar is not sending us to certain death.
Dialogue/c1battle62_end_02_a: I am heartened to hear that.
Dialogue/c1battle62_end_02_b: Going into battle with Overlord Anuphet, though, might be the closest thing.
Dialogue/c1battle62_start_01: What then is our role from here, Chief Librarian?
Dialogue/c1battle62_start_02: Certus? Do you worry that the Chapter Master plans to sacrifice us to win this battle?
Dialogue/c1battle62_start_03_a: I never worry about such things. I expect it.
Dialogue/c1battle62_start_03_b: If it happens, I will still fight to the end in the Emperor’s service.
Dialogue/c1battle63_end_01_a: Mocking the overlord may be working a little too well, Chief Librarian.
Dialogue/c1battle63_end_01_b: My services as a healer have never been in higher demand.
Dialogue/c1battle63_end_02_a: Such is the price of duty, Apothecary Incisus.
Dialogue/c1battle63_end_02_b: And we are all prepared to pay it.
Dialogue/c1battle63_start_01_a: Anuphet! Are these all the forces you have left to muster against us?
Dialogue/c1battle63_start_01_b: You seem to have allowed Thutmose to spend your best troops already.
Dialogue/c1battle63_start_02_a: Ultramarines: You have my attention now.
Dialogue/c1battle63_start_02_b: You will learn to regret that.
Dialogue/c1battle63_start_03_a: I expect I will soon procure your full attention!
Dialogue/c1battle63_start_03_b: As I wrench your skull from your neck!
Dialogue/c1battle64_end_01_a: Overlord Anuphet believes the Chapter Master is fleeing and that our brothers are guarding his escape.
Dialogue/c1battle64_end_01_b: In truth, Calgar is working his way toward this planet’s Dolmen Gate.
Dialogue/c1battle64_end_02: If he can shut that down, that would cut Anuphet off from any reinforcements!
Dialogue/c1battle64_start_01_a: I admit, it troubles me to be parted from the bulk of our forces.
Dialogue/c1battle64_start_01_b: I am accustomed to being in the thick of the most pitched battles.
Dialogue/c1battle64_start_02_a: Put your mind at ease, Sister Vindicta.
Dialogue/c1battle64_start_02_b: If all goes to plan, you may yet get your wish.
Dialogue/c1battle64_start_03: Then may your plan have the Emperor’s blessing.
Dialogue/c1battle65_end_01: Judging by the forces Anuphet is sending against us, we are succeeding exceedingly well.
Dialogue/c1battle65_start_02_a: The Necrons use Dolmen Gates to travel instantly between planets – even stars.
Dialogue/c1battle65_start_02_b: If the Chapter Master can close down the one here, Anuphet will be forced to stand alone.
Dialogue/c1battle65_start_03: All we need do is to keep Anuphet from realising that until it is too late.
Dialogue/c1battle66_end_01_a: The closer Calgar draws to the Dolmen Gate, the harder we must fight.
Dialogue/c1battle66_end_01_b: Don’t give Anuphet any opportunity to glance the Chapter Master’s way.
Dialogue/c1battle66_start_01_a: Ultramarines: Your Chapter Master is not coming to your aid.
Dialogue/c1battle66_start_02_a: That only means that your fight is now with us alone!
Dialogue/c1battle66_start_02_b: Kill us if you think you can. But know this: you shall pay dearly for the attempt!
Dialogue/c1battle67_end_01_a: Anuphet! Your pitiful toys are broken!
Dialogue/c1battle67_end_01_b: Send more against us if you dare!
Dialogue/c1battle67_start_01_a: The land here is changing again, growing darker.
Dialogue/c1battle67_start_01_b: We must be drawing closer to Anuphet.
Dialogue/c1battle67_start_02: Good. We have made him hunger for our arrival.
Dialogue/c1battle67_start_03: So let’s not keep him waiting.
Dialogue/c1battle68_end_01_b: As Chapter Master Calgar comes closer to his goal, Anuphet is bound to realise what we have done.
Dialogue/c1battle68_start_01_a: Ultramarines: Your dedication to being murdered astonishes me.
Dialogue/c1battle68_start_01_b: I always believed that humans placed a high value on their pitifully short lives.
Dialogue/c1battle68_start_02: Far more than our lives, we value your death.
Dialogue/c1battle69_end_01_b: You have bought us some valuable time.
Dialogue/c1battle69_end_02: I pray to the Emperor that it will be enough.
Dialogue/c1battle69_start_01_a: Anuphet! My flames hunger for vengeance in my sisters’ names.
Dialogue/c1battle69_start_01_b: Your awful reign is coming to an end!
Dialogue/c1battle69_start_02_a: Adepta Sororitas: Do you miss your sisters?
Dialogue/c1battle69_start_02_b: I will send you to join them soon.
Dialogue/c1battle69_start_03_a: Someday, I shall join them in death. True.
Dialogue/c1battle69_start_03_b: But you shall get there first!
Dialogue/c1battle70_end_01_a: Keep pressing forward, Brothers and Sister!
Dialogue/c1battle70_end_01_b: The Overlord’s attention is elsewhere. This is our chance!
Dialogue/c1battle70_start_01_a: Ultramarines: Where is your superior going?
Dialogue/c1battle70_start_01_b: No! He’s headed toward the Dolmen Gate!
Dialogue/c1battle70_start_02_a: Do not trouble yourself with Chapter Master Calgar!
Dialogue/c1battle70_start_02_b: You should be worrying about us instead!
Dialogue/c1battle71_end_01: Quickly now. We must press our advantage before Anuphet realises we have it.
Dialogue/c1battle71_start_01_a: Shall we continue to press forward, Brother Tigurius?
Dialogue/c1battle71_start_01_b: I thought perhaps we had already played our part.
Dialogue/c1battle71_start_02_a: Anuphet may be sending his forces to attack the Chapter Master and our battle brothers.
Dialogue/c1battle71_start_02_b: But where does that leave him?
Dialogue/c1battle71_start_03_b: The Emperor shines on us today!
Dialogue/c1battle72_end_01: It may not be long before Anuphet hears us knocking on his door.
Dialogue/c1battle72_end_02: By the time he does, let us pray that it will be too late.
Dialogue/c1battle72_start_01: These creatures do not seem any easier to defeat than before.
Dialogue/c1battle72_start_02_a: Anuphet still surrounds himself with the best of his Necrons.
Dialogue/c1battle72_start_02_b: But there are fewer of them to fight through now.
Dialogue/c1battle72_start_03: Thank the Emperor for such graces.
Dialogue/c1battle73_start_01: You have done well, my brothers!
Dialogue/c1battle73_start_02: We have reached the Dolmen Gate!
Dialogue/c1battle73_start_03: May the Emperor guide your ammunition, Chapter Master!
Dialogue/c1battle73_start_04: May his favour shine upon you as well!
Dialogue/c1battle74_end_02_a: Ultramarines: I welcome you with open arms.
Dialogue/c1battle74_start_01_a: Ultramarines: The loss of my gate shall not save you.
Dialogue/c1battle74_start_01_b: Before your Chapter Master can reach us, I shall destroy you all.
Dialogue/c1battle74_start_02_a: Come out to greet us then, Overlord!
Dialogue/c1battle74_start_02_b: We are happy for the opportunity to prove you wrong!
Dialogue/c1battle75_end_01_b: You and your battle brothers have accomplished great things in the Emperor’s name today!
Dialogue/c1battle75_end_02: We would not have stood a chance without the help of Sister Vindicta.
Dialogue/c1battle75_end_03: My sisters can rest easy now, knowing their sacrifice was not in vain.
Dialogue/c1battle75_end_04_a: This is but one campaign in our crusade against the Necron threat.
Dialogue/c1battle75_end_04_b: But this may be the one that has finally turned the tide.
Dialogue/c1battle75_start_01: Overlord Anuphet! It is a distinct pleasure to finally lay eyes upon you.
Dialogue/c1battle75_start_02: Ultramarines: I am appalled that you would dare violate my vision.
Dialogue/c1battle75_start_03_a: We would be pleased to ensure that such sights never trouble you again.
Dialogue/c2battle01_start_01_a: I, Haarken Worldclaimer, am returned to Cadia! I first came to this planet to proclaim its doom!
Dialogue/c2battle01_start_01_b: I come now with my battle brothers in the Black Legion to see that fate realised!
Dialogue/c2battle01_start_02_a: Destroying this world shall allow us to open the Cadian Gate that leads into the Warp.
Dialogue/c2battle01_start_02_b: From there we can throw wide the Eye of Terror and unleash Chaos upon the whole of the galaxy!
Dialogue/c2battle01_start_03_a: To make that happen, we must first destroy the Cadian capital, Kasr Kraf!
Dialogue/c2battle01_start_03_b: All who worship the false Emperor of Mankind shall fall before us!
Dialogue/c2battle02_end_01_a: You Cadians are all destined to die soon.
Dialogue/c2battle02_end_01_b: The artistry comes in determining how.
Dialogue/c2battle02_start_01_a: Emperor save us! The forces of Chaos are here!
Dialogue/c2battle02_start_01_b: Stand strong! If we fall, mankind falls with us!
Dialogue/c2battle02_start_02_a: You already stand in your graves, fools!
Dialogue/c2battle02_start_02_b: We are simply here to cover them!
Dialogue/c2battle03_end_01: Worldclaimer, explain! Why has Lord Abaddon sent us so far from the heart of the battle?
Dialogue/c2battle03_end_02_a: Do not dare question Lord Abaddon’s plans.
Dialogue/c2battle03_end_02_b: The screams of despair from our foes is reward enough.
Dialogue/c2battle03_start_01_a: We stand ready to give our lives to defend Kasr Kraf.
Dialogue/c2battle03_start_02_a: We shall take those worthless lives!
Dialogue/c2battle04_end_01_a: These fools put their trust in the false Emperor.
Dialogue/c2battle04_start_01_a: Lord Abaddon has honoured us with the task of clearing his way into Kasr Kraf.
Dialogue/c2battle04_start_01_b: From there he can decapitate Cadia’s leadership, and the planet is ours!
Dialogue/c2battle04_start_02: Our victory is never in doubt!
Dialogue/c2battle04_start_03_a: Prophecies do not come true on their own.
Dialogue/c2battle05_end_01: Curse the cowardice of those under the false Emperor’s sway!
Dialogue/c2battle05_end_02_a: No matter if they sent their mewling pleas for help.
Dialogue/c2battle05_end_02_b: We shall slaughter all who come to their aid.
Dialogue/c2battle05_start_03_b: But not yet for all of Cadia!
Dialogue/c2battle06_end_01_a: Do not bother bidding farewell to your compatriots, Skoden.
Dialogue/c2battle06_end_01_b: You shall be joining them in the grave soon enough!
Dialogue/c2battle06_start_02: Surrender, feeble-minded fool, and we shall make your death quick.
Dialogue/c2battle06_start_03_a: Ha! We don’t take orders from Chaos round here, do we?
Dialogue/c2battle06_start_03_b: You wanna take a shot at me, you need ta earn it.
Dialogue/c2battle07_start_01_a: Does Lord Abaddon’s plan actually require our haste?
Dialogue/c2battle07_start_01_b: Or do we have time to amuse ourselves with our victims?
Dialogue/c2battle07_start_02: Lord Abaddon has countless plans that intersect in ways that we are not privileged to understand.
Dialogue/c2battle07_start_03_a: Then we shall execute those plans like we execute our foes.
Dialogue/c2battle08_end_01: The wheel of Chaos spins ever faster.
Dialogue/c2battle08_start_01: Chaos may favour us today, but that favour can shift in an instant.
Dialogue/c2battle08_start_02: Time is not on our side.
Dialogue/c2battle08_start_03: Let us make haste as we lay waste to this hopeless planet.
Dialogue/c2battle09_end_01: Victory is sweeter when our foes surrender to despair before we crush them beneath our heels!
Dialogue/c2battle09_start_01_a: Isn’t there anything we can do to stop them?
Dialogue/c2battle09_start_02_a: Cry for help all you care to, weaklings!
Dialogue/c2battle09_start_02_b: No one shall attempt to save you worthless scum!
Dialogue/c2battle10_end_01_a: Cradle your resolve to your chests, you doomed fools.
Dialogue/c2battle10_meta_02: Lord Abaddon! We make swift progress, but we remain outside the walls of Kasr Kraf yet.
Dialogue/c2battle10_meta_03: Breach their walls, and do it soon. You know how I treat failures.
Dialogue/c2battle10_meta_04: I still breathe, Lord Abaddon, so I cannot have failed you yet.
Dialogue/c2battle10_start_01_a: You filthy heretics don’t scare us!
Dialogue/c2battle10_start_01_b: At least, you don’t scare me!
Dialogue/c2battle10_start_02_a: Chaos does not care how hard your feeble heart hammers.
Dialogue/c2battle10_start_02_b: We only wish to make it stop.
Dialogue/c2battle11_end_01_a: We cannot allow them slow us further.
Dialogue/c2battle11_end_01_b: Chaos calls, and we race to answer!
Dialogue/c2battle11_start_01_a: Relinquish yourselves to your fate, Cadia!
Dialogue/c2battle11_start_01_b: We cannot spare the time to watch you grovel!
Dialogue/c2battle11_start_02_a: We ain’t the sort to bow to no one but the Emperor!
Dialogue/c2battle11_start_02_b: He taught us ’ow to deal with monsters like you!
Dialogue/c2battle12_end_01_a: Our weapons thirst for ogryn blood!
Dialogue/c2battle12_start_01_a: Skoden does not comprehend the power of Chaos flowing through us.
Dialogue/c2battle12_start_01_b: His ignorance shall prove his death!
Dialogue/c2battle12_start_02: With luck, his misplaced bravado shall keep him from alerting the fortress city to our presence.
Dialogue/c2battle12_start_03: The faster he meets his end, the better.
Dialogue/c2battle13_end_01_a: Few foes dare stand between us and Skoden now.
Dialogue/c2battle13_start_01_a: The walls of Kasr Kraf grow ever nearer.
Dialogue/c2battle13_start_01_b: These Cadian fools cannot hope to stop us!
Dialogue/c2battle14_end_01_b: The moment of your doom is here!
Dialogue/c2battle14_start_01_a: Skoden! Come out and face us, you snivelling coward!
Dialogue/c2battle14_start_01_b: Your pitiful Emperor cannot save you now!
Dialogue/c2battle14_start_02_a: You filthy lot are in such a blasted rush to die.
Dialogue/c2battle14_start_02_b: You better start whining to yer fake gods for mercy right now.
Dialogue/c2battle15_end_01_a: Aagh! You filth are tougher than you look!
Dialogue/c2battle15_end_01_b: Sound the alarm, fellas! Alert Lord Creed!
Dialogue/c2battle15_end_03_a: The bullgryn has revealed our presence to his betters.
Dialogue/c2battle15_end_03_b: Our path will only grow more challenging from here.
Dialogue/c2battle15_end_04_a: Then we shall grow more vicious!
Dialogue/c2battle15_start_02_a: Go ahead! Beg your useless Emperor for aid!
Dialogue/c2battle15_start_02_b: The only answer you receive shall come from us!
Dialogue/c2battle16_end_01: Every victory brings us closer to our inevitable triumph!
Dialogue/c2battle16_start_01_b: But it will do Cadia little good.
Dialogue/c2battle16_start_02: The news of our arrival shall crush their spirits.
Dialogue/c2battle16_start_03: And then we shall crush their spines!
Dialogue/c2battle17_end_01: How has this world of weaklings resisted the forces of Chaos for so long?
Dialogue/c2battle17_start_01: Save yourselves, fools! Kasr Kraf is doomed to fall before the Black Legion!
Dialogue/c2battle17_start_02: The false Emperor cannot protect you here!
Dialogue/c2battle17_start_03: We shall cover Cadia with the corpses of Cadians!
Dialogue/c2battle18_end_01_a: Pay no attention to that Cadian psyker’s prattling.
Dialogue/c2battle18_end_01_b: They have not the courage to embrace Chaos as have we!
Dialogue/c2battle18_start_01: I have foreseen your future, daemons!
Dialogue/c2battle18_start_02: Kasr Kraf shall not fall at your hands!
Dialogue/c2battle18_start_03: We do not heed the false Emperor’s lies, psyker!
Dialogue/c2battle18_start_04: We shall not heed yours either!
Dialogue/c2battle19_end_01: I am never sated. I always hunger for more.
Dialogue/c2battle19_start_01: I weary of grinding these guardsmen into meat.
Dialogue/c2battle19_start_02_a: You wish for a more substantial meal for your claws?
Dialogue/c2battle19_start_02_b: As we serve Chaos, so shall it serve us!
Dialogue/c2battle20_end_01: Abaddon will not be satisfied until this whole planet is ablaze!
Dialogue/c2battle20_start_01: The lands around Kasr Kraf already burn!
Dialogue/c2battle20_start_02_a: Feed the flames! Let them grow higher!
Dialogue/c2battle20_start_02_b: They put the lie to the words of the false Emperor’s pawn!
Dialogue/c2battle21_end_01: We shall mock that psyker’s words with our deeds!
Dialogue/c2battle21_start_01: So, Worldclaimer! You put no value in that psyker’s prediction?
Dialogue/c2battle21_start_02_a: Such empty words are the last refuge of those destined for defeat.
Dialogue/c2battle21_start_02_b: Their false Emperor only produces lies and the liars to tell them!
Dialogue/c2battle22_start_01: Invaders! Your refusal to acknowledge your fate will not grant you triumph!
Dialogue/c2battle22_start_02: Tell all the lies you want, witch!
Dialogue/c2battle22_start_03: Your grovelling before your false Emperor will not save Cadia, nor you!
Dialogue/c2battle22_start_04: Every bolt we put into a guardsman is another nail in the Emperor’s coffin!
Dialogue/c2battle23_start_01: These Cadians seem to think their numbers can save them.
Dialogue/c2battle23_start_02: The more of them they send against us, the more I can twist to Lord Abaddon’s ends.
Dialogue/c2battle23_start_03: Kasr Kraft shall not stand before our might!
Dialogue/c2battle24_end_01_a: Are these the best you have to send against us, Cadia?
Dialogue/c2battle24_end_01_b: You should just lie down in your graves so we can bury you!
Dialogue/c2battle24_start_01_a: By their markings, these are supposed to be some of the finest warriors in the Cadian Guard.
Dialogue/c2battle24_start_02: Finally! A challenge that I can sharpen my claws on!
Dialogue/c2battle25_end_01: Keep trying, Cadians! I admire your persistence if not your skill!
Dialogue/c2battle25_start_01: These Cadians think they’ve drawn us into a trap, flanking us on three sides.
Dialogue/c2battle25_start_02: That merely gives us more choices of who to slaughter first!
Dialogue/c2battle26_end_01: I prefer facing foes like those. Ones who cannot flee.
Dialogue/c2battle26_start_01_a: We have them cornered in that bend of the river.
Dialogue/c2battle26_start_02: Come, Cadians! Come out and meet your doom!
Dialogue/c2battle27_end_01: Nothing could give me greater satisfaction than proving that witch wrong!
Dialogue/c2battle27_start_01: Come forth and face us, Psyker!
Dialogue/c2battle27_start_02: Let us put your prophecy to the test!
Dialogue/c2battle27_start_03: My gift has yet to forsake me!
Dialogue/c2battle27_start_04: You shall not take Kasr Kraf!
Dialogue/c2battle28_start_01_a: Witness these Cadians and their lascannons.
Dialogue/c2battle28_start_01_b: They think they can sustain themselves against the forces of Chaos with “teamwork”.
Dialogue/c2battle28_start_02: We shall disabuse them of such folly.
Dialogue/c2battle28_start_03: What of your prophecies now, Imperial witch?
Dialogue/c2battle29_end_01_a: To have our triumph thwarted at such a stage?
Dialogue/c2battle29_start_02: How could this be, Lord Abaddon?
Dialogue/c2battle29_start_03: We are about to breach Kasr Kraf’s fortifications!
Dialogue/c2battle29_start_04: Kasr Kraf has already fallen! Our campaign moves elsewhere now!
Dialogue/c2battle30_end_01: That puts that prophet’s prattling to an end!
Dialogue/c2battle30_end_02: But now, where shall the focus of our fury turn?
Dialogue/c2battle30_end_03_a: Are we not servants of Chaos?
Dialogue/c2battle30_end_03_b: If we cannot find trouble, it will surely find us!
Dialogue/c2battle30_start_02: Kasr Kraf may have fallen, but not at your hands!
Dialogue/c2battle30_start_03: You mock me at your peril, witch!
Dialogue/c2battle30_start_04: If Kasr Kraf cannot be my prize today, then your life shall serve as its substitute!
Dialogue/c2battle31_start_01_a: Kasr Kraf has fallen to Lord Abaddon’s forces!
Dialogue/c2battle31_start_02: You sound as if you believe this Black Crusade is all but over.
Dialogue/c2battle31_start_03: Our fight is not ended until the false Emperor is torn from his rotting throne!
Dialogue/c2battle32_end_01: Just point me toward this vermin’s next den!
Dialogue/c2battle32_start_01: Despite their defeat, these Cadians are dug into their planet like rats.
Dialogue/c2battle32_start_02: In that case, we shall root them out like the vermin they are!
Dialogue/c2battle33_end_01: The power of Chaos roars through us!
Dialogue/c2battle33_start_01: Worldclaimer! I have need of you once again!
Dialogue/c2battle33_start_02: We hunger to serve, Lord Abaddon!
Dialogue/c2battle33_start_03: Cadian Command has fallen back to the Elysion Fields!
Dialogue/c2battle33_start_04: Go to prepare them for my arrival!
Dialogue/c2battle33_start_05: We shall pave that road with their skulls!
Dialogue/c2battle34_start_01_b: In our assault on Kasr Kraf, did we not fail Lord Abaddon?
Dialogue/c2battle35_end_01_a: We are not privy to all of our lord’s plans.
Dialogue/c2battle35_end_01_b: After all, we do not serve Abaddon but Chaos itself!
Dialogue/c2battle35_start_01_a: Ha! If we had failed Lord Abaddon, you would be able to tell.
Dialogue/c2battle35_start_01_b: We would be dead at his hand!
Dialogue/c2battle35_start_02: You have the right of it, Angrax!
Dialogue/c2battle36_end_01: These fools only whet my appetite for more blood!
Dialogue/c2battle36_start_01_a: These Cadians have made a fatal error.
Dialogue/c2battle36_start_01_b: They stand between us and our goal!
Dialogue/c2battle36_start_02: They should have fled for the Elysion Fields with the other cowards!
Dialogue/c2battle37_end_01: If that represents Cadia at its best, then this war is already won.
Dialogue/c2battle37_start_01: Depart Cadia immediately, heretics, or we shall rain the Emperor’s wrath down on you!
Dialogue/c2battle37_start_02: Your threats are as empty as your capital city!
Dialogue/c2battle37_start_03: The further you back Cadia into a corner, the harder we shall fight!
Dialogue/c2battle38_end_01_b: The Black Legion knows no limits!
Dialogue/c2battle38_start_01: This Master of Ordnance believes he can stop us.
Dialogue/c2battle38_start_02: He only provides more hosts for my souls!
Dialogue/c2battle39_end_01_a: Let these imbeciles set their own planet ablaze.
Dialogue/c2battle39_end_01_b: They do the work of Chaos for us!
Dialogue/c2battle39_start_01: Your weakness will doom you all, Noble!
Dialogue/c2battle39_start_02: If you think a planetary bombardment is weak, I cannot help you, heretic!
Dialogue/c2battle39_start_03: You care for this planet. We care only for its destruction!
Dialogue/c2battle40_start_01: These fools cannot stop us from reaching their Elysion Fields.
Dialogue/c2battle40_start_02: And those fields shall offer them no shelter from our wrath!
Dialogue/c2battle41_start_01_b: A racket arises from whence we came...
Dialogue/c2battle41_start_03_a: Ignore it. Keep your focus on the battle ahead.
Dialogue/c2battle41_start_03_b: Nothing lies behind us but the bodies of our foes!
Dialogue/c2battle42_end_01: For a moment, let us enjoy the silence that death brings to our foes...
Dialogue/c2battle42_start_01: Do you hear that, heretics? It is the sound of hope!
Dialogue/c2battle42_start_02: The only thing you should hope for is a painless death!
Dialogue/c2battle42_start_03: Your false Emperor will not be granting that prayer!
Dialogue/c2battle43_start_01: What could cheer the few survivors left in Kasr Kraft?
Dialogue/c2battle43_start_02_a: Perhaps their despair has finally turned to madness.
Dialogue/c2battle43_start_02_b: Soon that is the only haven that will remain for them...
Dialogue/c2battle43_start_03_a: Those voices. They seem to be chanting something.
Dialogue/c2battle44_end_01_a: Whether these fools have seen a saint or are hallucinating through their final moments matters not.
Dialogue/c2battle44_end_01_b: Either way, we shall deliver to them their doom!
Dialogue/c2battle44_start_01: The Emperor has answered our prayers, heretics!
Dialogue/c2battle44_start_02: He has sent Celestine, the Living Saint, to effect our salvation!
Dialogue/c2battle44_start_03: The false Emperor himself could not save you now!
Dialogue/c2battle44_start_04: Enjoy your brief respite of hope while it lasts!
Dialogue/c2battle45_start_01_a: Master Noble! Pray to your Emperor! Pray to your Saint!
Dialogue/c2battle45_start_01_b: They are too late to save you!
Dialogue/c2battle45_start_02_b: But in time to stop you and your heretic lord!
Dialogue/c2battle45_start_03: You will be long dead before that issue is decided!
Dialogue/c2battle45_start_04_a: We give our lives willingly for our world!
Dialogue/c2battle46_start_01: What if that fool’s claim about Saint Celestine proves true?
Dialogue/c2battle46_start_02_a: It matters not. It will not bring him back.
Dialogue/c2battle46_start_02_b: And it will not keep us from our goal!
Dialogue/c2battle47_end_01_a: We cannot waste more time with this filth.
Dialogue/c2battle47_end_01_b: We must press toward the Elysion Fields with all haste!
Dialogue/c2battle47_start_01: Worldclaimer! The false Emperor has placed a stumbling block in your path.
Dialogue/c2battle47_start_02: I trust that you will find a way past this feeble saint of his.
Dialogue/c2battle47_start_03: We shall not fail you, Lord Abaddon!
Dialogue/c2battle47_start_04: See that you do not. I will arrive on this foul planet soon...
Dialogue/c2battle48_end_01: We shall break them over and over – as many times as it takes – until they are shattered!
Dialogue/c2battle48_start_01_a: There seems to be no end to these Cadians.
Dialogue/c2battle48_start_01_b: And the arrival of Celestine has lent strength to their will.
Dialogue/c2battle48_start_02: Just when it seemed we had broken them...
Dialogue/c2battle48_start_03: Then we shall break them again!
Dialogue/c2battle49_start_01_a: We are nearing the Elysion Fields!
Dialogue/c2battle49_start_01_b: Witness the blackstone pylons in the distance!
Dialogue/c2battle49_start_02_a: Legend has it that they are what keeps open the nearby gate into the Warp.
Dialogue/c2battle49_start_02_b: Will Lord Abaddon attempt to destroy them, you think?
Dialogue/c2battle49_start_03_a: That is a question best left to the Lords of Chaos.
Dialogue/c2battle49_start_03_b: All we need do is fight!
Dialogue/c2battle49_start_04_a: As I said, ignore the pylons. They cannot be killed.
Dialogue/c2battle49_start_04_b: Unlike the Cadians who dare face us.
Dialogue/c2battle50_end_01_a: We have been honoured with the most vital of tasks.
Dialogue/c2battle50_end_01_b: To slaughter everyone between us and this Creed!
Dialogue/c2battle50_start_01: Worldclaimer! As predicted, your ultimate goal has arisen in the Elysion Fields.
Dialogue/c2battle50_start_02: Give us our orders, Lord Abaddon! We are, as always, yours to command!
Dialogue/c2battle50_start_03: Your target is Lord Castellan Creed, the Imperial Commander and Governor Primus of Cadia.
Dialogue/c2battle50_start_04: Find him. Corner him. But do not kill him. That pleasure belongs to me!
Dialogue/c2battle51_end_01: Saint or no, we should revel in the glory of this battle!
Dialogue/c2battle51_start_01: We still have a long way to go to reach this Cadian lord.
Dialogue/c2battle51_start_02_a: Is that a note of fear in your voice, Master Archimatos?
Dialogue/c2battle51_start_02_b: Does the appearance of this saint concern you?
Dialogue/c2battle51_start_03_a: The prospect of meeting a saint on the field of battle should not concern any of us.
Dialogue/c2battle52_end_01: Whether it be their hopes or their heads, we shall leave no Cadian uncrushed!
Dialogue/c2battle52_start_01: These battles become fiercer the farther we go.
Dialogue/c2battle52_start_02: The arrival of the living saint seems to have raised the Cadians’ spirits.
Dialogue/c2battle52_start_03: Then we shall have to crush them again!
Dialogue/c2battle53_end_01: The wailing of our foes is but a prelude to the agony we shall wrest from that saint!
Dialogue/c2battle53_start_01_a: Do you think we can beat this false saint to the Elysion Fields?
Dialogue/c2battle53_start_01_b: Or shall we be forced to face her?
Dialogue/c2battle53_start_02: If she catches us before we reach Creed, then we shall relish Creed’s despair as we dismantle her.
Dialogue/c2battle53_start_03: And if we reach Creed first?
Dialogue/c2battle53_start_04_a: Then we shall enjoy her anguish as we dismantle him.
Dialogue/c2battle54_end_01_a: These cowards can call for all the help they like.
Dialogue/c2battle54_end_01_b: It only helps us destroy them faster!
Dialogue/c2battle54_start_01: Look to the skies! The weaklings are calling in strike after strike!
Dialogue/c2battle54_start_02_a: The cowards have not the might to challenge us on their own.
Dialogue/c2battle54_start_02_b: Let us teach them how right they are to fear us!
Dialogue/c2battle55_start_01: Now they hide behind their lascannons!
Dialogue/c2battle55_start_02_a: They wish to drive us away.
Dialogue/c2battle55_start_02_b: But their struggling only makes our triumph that much sweeter!
Dialogue/c2battle56_end_01: These craven fools bore me. Come and entertain us, you so-called saint!
Dialogue/c2battle56_start_01: Turn back, foul traitors! The Emperor commands it!
Dialogue/c2battle56_start_02: Come closer, little bird, that we may pluck your wings!
Dialogue/c2battle56_start_03: You have been given fair warning. The next time we meet, you shall pay the price!
Dialogue/c2battle57_start_01_a: This Celestine thinks she can cow us into surrender?
Dialogue/c2battle57_start_01_b: We who call the Warp our home? Ha!
Dialogue/c2battle58_end_01: This saint rings as hollow as her false Emperor’s words!
Dialogue/c2battle58_start_01_a: How can you cowards find inspiration in such a pathetic source?
Dialogue/c2battle58_start_01_b: She hovers over the field of battle while we slaughter the people she is sworn to protect!
Dialogue/c2battle59_end_01_b: She will strike at us now or not at all!
Dialogue/c2battle59_start_01_a: This Celestine is too much of a coward to face us!
Dialogue/c2battle59_start_01_b: We shall trample over the corpses of all of Cadia on our way to Castellan Creed!
Dialogue/c2battle60_start_01: In the Emperor’s hallowed name, I cast thee daemons out!
Dialogue/c2battle60_start_02: It will take more than hollow words to be rid of us, saint!
Dialogue/c2battle60_start_03_a: Then so be it, you loathsome creatures of Chaos!
Dialogue/c2battle60_start_03_b: It is here your treachery ends!
Dialogue/c2battle60_start_04_a: Coward! You flee at the approach of your doom!
Dialogue/c2battle60_start_04_b: Watch her fly, Cadia! Watch your hopes leave with her!
Dialogue/c2battle61_end_01_a: We shall not fail Lord Abaddon!
Dialogue/c2battle61_start_01: How goes your quest for Creed, Worldclaimer?
Dialogue/c2battle61_start_02: We have forced this so-called saint of theirs to withdraw.
Dialogue/c2battle61_start_03: Nothing stands between us and Creed now but the fools who cower around him!
Dialogue/c2battle61_start_04: Make quick work of them then. My arrival is imminent.
Dialogue/c2battle62_end_01_a: I have yet to fail in my predictions of our victory.
Dialogue/c2battle62_end_01_b: Today will not be that day!
Dialogue/c2battle62_start_01_a: We must move faster to pave the way for Lord Abaddon!
Dialogue/c2battle62_start_01_b: Slaughter everyone who dares step into our path! For Chaos!
Dialogue/c2battle63_end_01: This is the time to unfurl our banners and make all who witness us tremble in their tracks!
Dialogue/c2battle63_start_01: These remaining Cadians seem to have some steel in their spines yet.
Dialogue/c2battle63_start_02: All the better for sharpening my claws upon!
Dialogue/c2battle64_end_01: Your best isn’t good enough, Creed!
Dialogue/c2battle64_end_02: Pray to your false Emperor for mercy, for we shall show you none!
Dialogue/c2battle64_start_01: You filth shall not prevail against the Emperor’s faithful!
Dialogue/c2battle64_start_02: Bring out your faithful! Show them to us so that we may crush them!
Dialogue/c2battle64_start_03: You may have pressed our backs against the wall, heretics, but that is where Cadians fight best!
Dialogue/c2battle64_start_04: Colour Sergeant Kell! Let’s show these heretics our best!
Dialogue/c2battle65_end_01: I am thrilled to have provided so many with such dangerous enlightenment...
Dialogue/c2battle65_start_01: So, these vermin do still have some fight left in them!
Dialogue/c2battle65_start_02: That is a condition from which I am all too happy to cure them...
Dialogue/c2battle66_end_01: There are always more weeds to tend to...
Dialogue/c2battle66_start_01: These Cadian elites hide in the shadows of these blackstone pylons as if that would protect them.
Dialogue/c2battle66_start_02: It merely shows us where to look for these human weeds so we can tear them out!
Dialogue/c2battle67_end_01: As Lord Abaddon commands, so shall we make it!
Dialogue/c2battle67_start_01: Worldclaimer! How fares your assault on the Elysion Fields?
Dialogue/c2battle67_start_02: Lord Abaddon! The cowards are dug deep into their dens, but we shall root them out!
Dialogue/c2battle67_start_03: See that you do so soon. When I arrive, the way to Creed’s throat must be made clear.
Dialogue/c2battle67_start_04: Or I shall cut my path through you.
Dialogue/c2battle68_end_01: This is the most glorious of days!
Dialogue/c2battle68_start_01: They have fielded enough lascannons to destroy an entire battalion.
Dialogue/c2battle68_start_02_a: And they still shall not be sufficient to defeat us!
Dialogue/c2battle69_end_01: Today is a new day, and our saga shall have a new end!
Dialogue/c2battle69_start_01: You should flee now, Worldclaimer, while you still have the chance!
Dialogue/c2battle69_start_02: The forces of Chaos have never taken Cadia in millennia of attempts!
Dialogue/c2battle70_end_01_a: I hope you have not had your fill of battle yet, brothers!
Dialogue/c2battle70_end_01_b: There is yet more to come!
Dialogue/c2battle70_start_01: They seem to have saved their best forces for their final stand.
Dialogue/c2battle70_start_02: This is the kind of challenge for which I was created!
Dialogue/c2battle70_start_03_a: Feed your daemons, Archimatos! Slake your claws, Angrax!
Dialogue/c2battle71_end_01_a: They have thrown everything they have at us!
Dialogue/c2battle71_start_01: Heretics! No matter how you threaten us, we shall not yield!
Dialogue/c2battle71_start_02: Surrender would not save you! It would only make your death quicker!
Dialogue/c2battle71_start_03: Colour Sergeant Kell! Empty our cannons at them!
Dialogue/c2battle71_start_04: Leave nothing of them but ashes and dust!
Dialogue/c2battle72_end_01: Creed and his pathetic lot will be naught more than a footnote in the story of the 13th Crusade!
Dialogue/c2battle72_start_01_a: So this is mighty Cadia? The Emperor’s Fortress?
Dialogue/c2battle72_start_01_b: There is nothing to these fools but their lying names!
Dialogue/c2battle72_start_02: When we are done with them, even those will be forgotten!
Dialogue/c2battle73_start_01: Creed! We are here to demand the price for your insolence!
Dialogue/c2battle73_start_02: We shall be satisfied with nothing less than your head!
Dialogue/c2battle73_start_03: Then you shall be left wanting, heretic! As you always have!
Dialogue/c2battle74_end_01: We are through! Our goal is in sight!
Dialogue/c2battle74_start_01: Worldclaimer! Have you set the stage for my entrance?
Dialogue/c2battle74_start_02: We are about to breach Creed’s defences, Lord Abaddon!
Dialogue/c2battle74_start_03: See that it is in splinters when I arrive.
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_01_a: Lord Abaddon! We have made your way clear!
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_01_b: The barrier around Creed’s Skyshield is down!
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_02_a: As I am aware... Excellent work, Worldclaimer.
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_02_b: Now to put an end to this Creed and his useless resistance.
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_03_a: Warmaster of Chaos! You may have won this battle, but the war is far from over!
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_04_a: Cling to your sad devotion to that ancient religion, Creed.
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_04_b: Any survivors can inscribe the false Emperor’s lies on your tomb!
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_05: You must withdraw, Lord Creed! You carry the hopes of Cadia with you!
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_06_a: This is not the end, Abaddon! Far from it!
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_07_a: It’s too late for me. I give my life for yours and all of Cadia.
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_08_a: Such dedication to so unworthy a cause.
Dialogue/c2battle75_end_10_b: Creed may have escaped my wrath for now, but this planet shall be mine!
Dialogue/c2battle75_start_01: Creed and Kell! Your pathetic Emperor will soon curse your very names!
Dialogue/c2battle75_start_02: Filthy heretics! He will never be aware of yours!
Dialogue/c3battle01_end_02: We been so bored on dis wurld. Nuttin worth killin.
Dialogue/c3battle01_end_03: Now datz wurt gettin outta bed for!
Dialogue/c3battle01_start_03_a: Dere ain't s'pozed ta be any fun like dat on dis planet.
Dialogue/c3battle01_start_03_b: That'z why da Warboss stuck us here on Orruk!
Dialogue/c3battle01_start_04_a: Day musta forgot ta tell da Black Templars about dat!
Dialogue/c3battle01_start_05_a: Den wut is we waitin' for?
Dialogue/c3battle01_start_05_b: Kick Snappawrecka and his Killa Kan into gear!
Dialogue/c3battle01_start_06: Letz go tear us open a few of dem Humies!
Dialogue/c3battle02_end_02_a: We gotz Black Templars all over da place, boss!
Dialogue/c3battle02_start_01: Now den, wutz dis all bout?
Dialogue/c3battle02_start_02: Filthy xenos! You have plagued this planet for far too long!
Dialogue/c3battle02_start_03: Huh! It wuz quiet till you lot showed up 'ere.
Dialogue/c3battle03_end_01: I think dat's alla dem, boss!
Dialogue/c3battle03_end_02_a: Stow dat! Where dere's some Humies, dere's always more!
Dialogue/c3battle03_end_02_b: Dis is just da first course!
Dialogue/c3battle03_start_01_a: We ain't got time for dem questions now.
Dialogue/c3battle03_start_01_b: Dere's only one answer for Space Marines!
Dialogue/c3battle04_end_01_a: Wutz that sposed ta mean? Did dey beat da Warboss?
Dialogue/c3battle04_end_02_a: Dat wuld explain where deez humies come from.
Dialogue/c3battle04_start_01: This isn't the end of this, you filthy xenos!
Dialogue/c3battle04_start_02: Now that your betters have been dealt with, you shall all suffer the Emperor's wrath!
Dialogue/c3battle05_end_02_b: We got more 'eads that need crakkin!
Dialogue/c3battle05_start_01_a: With Wurldkilla outta da way, we need a new Warboss to lead the Waaagh.
Dialogue/c3battle05_start_02_a: Yeah, you and ever other boss in the galazy are gonna want that.
Dialogue/c3battle05_start_02_b: How we gonna make that happen?
Dialogue/c3battle05_start_03_a: We just gotta show 'em all whoz boss now!
Dialogue/c3battle06_end_01_b: Dey gotta back yer play to be Warboss now!
Dialogue/c3battle06_end_02: Good! Now letz find us some more clans to smack inta line…
Dialogue/c3battle06_start_01: I dunno, boss. Deez boyz tink dere boss should be Warboss steada you…
Dialogue/c3battle06_start_02_a: Well, we gotz an answer for dat, don't we?
Dialogue/c3battle07_end_01: SO MANY GROTS! SO MUCH FUN TA SQUISH!
Dialogue/c3battle07_end_03_a: Keep squishing dem! Have yer fun!
Dialogue/c3battle07_end_03_b: Dere's always more grots where deez came from!
Dialogue/c3battle07_start_01: Is squishing all deez grots gonna be enough to make you da Warboss?
Dialogue/c3battle07_start_02_a: Course not! For that, we need to take out all da Blak Tempaz on da planet. Claim it for da Orks.
Dialogue/c3battle07_start_02_b: But for that, we need to squish all deez grots first!
Dialogue/c3battle08_start_01: Deez grots are running wild. Like they ain't got no boss!
Dialogue/c3battle08_start_02_a: Dey took down their boss. Think dey in charge now.
Dialogue/c3battle08_start_02_b: Letz fix dat here and now. I'M DA BOSS NOW!
Dialogue/c3battle09_end_01_a: Deez ain't the last of them.
Dialogue/c3battle09_end_01_b: We gotz more bosses out dere who wants to be Warboss.
Dialogue/c3battle09_end_02_a: But we got Snotflogga's boyz with us now!
Dialogue/c3battle09_start_01: Snotflogga! Yer tanks ain't gonna save you from us!
Dialogue/c3battle09_start_02: TRY TO STOP US! WE LIKES IT WHENS YOUZ TRY!
Dialogue/c3battle10_end_01_b: Dey think Mork speaks to dem through dat totem of theirs.
Dialogue/c3battle10_end_02_a: Den we need to bust that totem up!
Dialogue/c3battle10_start_01_a: Deez boyz are dug in deep.
Dialogue/c3battle10_start_01_b: How we gonna root dem out?
Dialogue/c3battle10_start_02: We knock down da wall, den knock in dere 'eads!
Dialogue/c3battle11_end_01: Dat did it! Now they can't talk with Mork no more!
Dialogue/c3battle11_end_02: Uh-oh. Maybe he wuz da only thing keepin dem in line…
Dialogue/c3battle11_start_01_a: We really gotta sneak around to the back of dis place?
Dialogue/c3battle11_start_02: Itz da only way to get to that Mork totem of dere'z.
Dialogue/c3battle11_start_03: KILL DA TOTEM! KILL DA TOTEM!
Dialogue/c3battle12_end_02_a: Dat's all the boyz round here.
Dialogue/c3battle12_end_02_b: Now to see about dem Black Temperz…
Dialogue/c3battle12_start_01_a: Da boyz here is going crazy!
Dialogue/c3battle12_start_01_b: Maybe Mork's last words were to kill us?
Dialogue/c3battle12_start_02_b: Cuz we're gonna crak all those boyz heads!
Dialogue/c3battle13_end_01_a: Seems da Tempa boss is dis Hell-Break git.
Dialogue/c3battle13_end_02: Den we keep squishing Tempaz until he shows up!
Dialogue/c3battle13_start_01_a: Now we gotz all our boyz behind us, we're ready to start crakkin human 'eads.
Dialogue/c3battle13_start_01_b: Take us to yer leader so we can crak his 'ead too!
Dialogue/c3battle14_end_02_a: I think you've killed enough good people today.
Dialogue/c3battle14_end_02_b: I'm here for you now, foul beast!
Dialogue/c3battle14_start_01: Hell-Break! Come out 'n' face me ya bloody git!
Dialogue/c3battle14_start_02: He don't seem ta be anywhere round 'here.
Dialogue/c3battle14_start_03: Den we keep tearin' these gitz apart till he shows!
Dialogue/c3battle15_end_01_a: So much for dat. Least he wuzn't no coward.
Dialogue/c3battle15_end_01_b: Can't say so much for dat Hell-Break git.
Dialogue/c3battle15_start_01: Finally! Someone who'z worth killing showz up!
Dialogue/c3battle15_start_02_a: That's far enough, you filthy xenos!
Dialogue/c3battle16_end_01: Weez on da right path, right ta dat Hell-Break.
Dialogue/c3battle16_end_02_b: An' our scoutz ain't lookin so good out dere.
Dialogue/c3battle16_end_03_a: Wit all dat armor dey wear, deez Blak Tempaz must like da cold, so datz where we goze.
Dialogue/c3battle16_start_01_a: Dat Hell-Break git iz da hed Humie 'round 'ere.
Dialogue/c3battle16_start_01_b: Dat puts 'im at da top o' me To-Kill list.
Dialogue/c3battle16_start_02: We gonna hafta kill lotza Blak Tempaz to get ta him.
Dialogue/c3battle17_end_01_a: Dat took care o' dem sneaky li'l gitz.
Dialogue/c3battle17_end_01_b: Now, where da frozen Mork iz we?
Dialogue/c3battle17_start_01_a: Da scoutz can't find da way ta dis Hell-Break.
Dialogue/c3battle17_start_01_b: Dey sez da ice out dere ain't safe!
Dialogue/c3battle17_start_02: Den we find da way ourselfs!
Dialogue/c3battle17_start_03: Dis ain't about safe. DIS IS WAAAGH!
Dialogue/c3battle17_start_04: Den youz outta be happy about whatz comin our way!
Dialogue/c3battle18_end_01: Dat's dat. Now letz figga a way outta 'ere.
Dialogue/c3battle18_start_01_a: Dis don't look right. Weez stuck on dis stab o' land.
Dialogue/c3battle18_start_02_b: Dere's some Blak Tempaz right dere dat needz killin!
Dialogue/c3battle19_end_01_a: I wuzn't sure we wuz going da right way.
Dialogue/c3battle19_end_01_b: But now dere ain't no doubt!
Dialogue/c3battle19_start_01: Dat's the way! I can see all da way ta Hell-Break's from 'ere.
Dialogue/c3battle19_start_02: There they are! Neophytes! Hit them hard!
Dialogue/c3battle19_start_03: Show those filthy xenos no mercy!
Dialogue/c3battle20_end_02: I'm gonna be da Wurldkilla's-killaz killa!
Dialogue/c3battle20_start_01: Force them back. Yield no ground!
Dialogue/c3battle20_start_02: Just as we vanquished their Warboss on Sigma-Ulstari, we shall destroy them here!
Dialogue/c3battle20_start_03: Try it, Tempaz! I'm gunnin for da Wurldkilla's killaz!
Dialogue/c3battle21_end_01_a: Now dere ain't nuttin but ice between Hell-Break and us!
Dialogue/c3battle21_start_01: Da Tempaz iz using dat river for cover!
Dialogue/c3battle21_start_02_a: They fink datz gonna protect dem?
Dialogue/c3battle21_start_02_b: Ain't nuttin gonna keep us from killin dem!
Dialogue/c3battle22_end_01: Hey boyz! Break out dem juicy squigs fer roastin on stiks!
Dialogue/c3battle22_start_02_a: Dey figga datz gonna save dem?
Dialogue/c3battle22_start_02_b: We outta thank dem for warmin da place up!
Dialogue/c3battle23_end_01_a: Boyz! Dem Tempaz mighta split us up, but dat don't matter!
Dialogue/c3battle23_start_01: Dere tryin ta split us up wit dem fiyah shootas!
Dialogue/c3battle23_start_02: Let 'em try! We iz just as dangerous apart!
Dialogue/c3battle24_start_01: We needz ta get back togedda with da rest of da boyz!
Dialogue/c3battle24_start_02_a: First we gotta get past dis fiyah!
Dialogue/c3battle24_start_02_b: And den toss da Tempaz inta it!
Dialogue/c3battle25_end_01_a: Dis river can't stop us fer long.
Dialogue/c3battle25_start_01_a: Looks like da Tempaz run outta stuff ta burn.
Dialogue/c3battle25_start_02_b: Dis 'ere is da river dat leads to dere place!
Dialogue/c3battle26_end_01: All right, boyz! All togedda now!
Dialogue/c3battle26_start_01_b: We take dat, we can get all da boyz back wit' us again!
Dialogue/c3battle26_start_02_b: We getta kill all da Tempaz standin tween us an' it!
Dialogue/c3battle27_end_01: Dat Warboss of yerz. Da Emp-Roar?
Dialogue/c3battle27_end_02: Don't look like 'e's too much help!
Dialogue/c3battle27_start_01: We got dem Tempaz on da run!
Dialogue/c3battle28_end_01: We gotz deez Blak Tempaz trapped!
Dialogue/c3battle28_start_01: They may have flanked us, but the Black Templars always battle on!
Dialogue/c3battle28_start_02: The longer we hold them here, the better for our fellows!
Dialogue/c3battle28_start_03: Ha! I know dat kinda talk!
Dialogue/c3battle29_start_01_a: Ta get to deez Tempaz, we gotta cross dat lake!
Dialogue/c3battle29_start_01_b: We do dat an' dey can't escape!
Dialogue/c3battle29_start_03: Your heretic gods won't protect you from our wrath!
Dialogue/c3battle29_start_04: What kinda gitz beg dere godz fer help!
Dialogue/c3battle30_end_01_a: God-Swill, eh? Ain't no one swallowin dat!
Dialogue/c3battle30_start_01_a: Go ahead, you foul xenos! Do your worst to us!
Dialogue/c3battle30_start_01_b: May you find the price of Fedreus Godswyl's life too high to pay!
Dialogue/c3battle30_start_02: Ha! You can't put a price on good fun like dis!
Dialogue/c3battle30_start_03: BEST FUN TIME? PAY WIT BULLITS!
Dialogue/c3battle31_start_02: Filthy xeno! You'll pay for this!
Dialogue/c3battle31_start_03: If you dare, meet me in the place you filth call Gitz Gulch!
Dialogue/c3battle31_start_04: There we shall give you the fight you've been bellowing for!
Dialogue/c3battle31_start_05_a: Dat git finks he can threaten me wit a gud time?
Dialogue/c3battle32_end_01_a: Dey keep fallin back inta dat canyon.
Dialogue/c3battle32_end_01_b: Dat don't give dem no place ta run!
Dialogue/c3battle32_start_01: What could be taking you so long?
Dialogue/c3battle32_start_02: Do you fear us, xenos filth? You should!
Dialogue/c3battle32_start_03_a: You see dat stuff unda da ice?
Dialogue/c3battle32_start_03_b: I gotz an ungood feelin 'bout dis.
Dialogue/c3battle33_end_01: You are almost there, filth. Almost there...
Dialogue/c3battle33_end_02: Emperor forgive me for such tactics, but the situation is dire...
Dialogue/c3battle33_start_01: Keep afta dem! Dey can't git away!
Dialogue/c3battle33_start_02_a: Wut bout dis stuff in da ice?
Dialogue/c3battle34_start_01: DIS SEEM BAD. BAD BAD BAD.
Dialogue/c3battle34_start_02: Shut yer rusty trap! It ain't gonna be bad fer us.
Dialogue/c3battle34_start_03: We're gonna make it bad fer dem!
Dialogue/c3battle35_end_01_a: Dem Tempaz led us inta a trap!
Dialogue/c3battle35_start_02_a: Huh! Dere'z only a few o' dem 'ere...
Dialogue/c3battle35_start_03: NIDZ NIDZ NIDZ! ERE COME DA NIDZ!
Dialogue/c3battle36_end_01_a: I'm startin' ta fink deez Nidz wuz waiting fer us.
Dialogue/c3battle36_end_01_b: How long dey been froze unda da ice like dat?
Dialogue/c3battle36_end_02_a: Don't matta if da Nidz wuz here before da Tempaz. Or even before us!
Dialogue/c3battle36_end_02_b: We getz ta kill dem eida way!
Dialogue/c3battle36_start_01_a: Dey gotz more Nidz coming at us!
Dialogue/c3battle36_start_02_a: Dat just meanz dere'z more ta kill!
Dialogue/c3battle36_start_02_b: Let dem come ta us, and kill dem all!
Dialogue/c3battle37_end_01_a: Dey cut us off from da bulk of da boyz!
Dialogue/c3battle37_start_01_b: Dis don't seem all dat fair...
Dialogue/c3battle37_start_02_b: Least dey fight and don't play tricks like dem Tempaz gitz!
Dialogue/c3battle38_end_01: Dat'z wut I callz a good start!
Dialogue/c3battle38_start_01_a: Da Tempaz run! Da boyz run!
Dialogue/c3battle38_start_01_b: I'll give all dem gitz sumthin' ta be proppa 'fraid of!
Dialogue/c3battle38_start_02_b: We gotz ta kill da Nidz 'fore we can git dem gitz!
Dialogue/c3battle39_end_01: Weez right in a nest of dem big Nidz now, da wunz with all da armz!
Dialogue/c3battle39_end_02_a: Dat'z da kinda fight I been lookin' fer!
Dialogue/c3battle39_start_01_a: Snotflogga sez dere'z a shortbut back ta da base.
Dialogue/c3battle39_start_01_b: But it goez royt over dat froze-up lake!
Dialogue/c3battle39_start_02: Shorta iz betta. Let'z do it!
Dialogue/c3battle40_end_01: Wut da? Dey ain't slippin' round any more than we iz.
Dialogue/c3battle40_start_01_a: Da big Nidz 're busting straight up from da ground!
Dialogue/c3battle40_start_01_b: Maybe weez should draw dem out over da ice?
Dialogue/c3battle40_start_02_a: Good figgerin'! Follow us, Nidz! Weez ain't runnin' away from nobody.
Dialogue/c3battle40_start_02_b: Weez just wanta make sure we gotz the time to get ta killin' each o' ya!
Dialogue/c3battle41_start_01: Whoze hed do I gotta squish ta get stuff dun round 'ere?!
Dialogue/c3battle41_start_02: We slidez dat way, we can make it ta da base!
Dialogue/c3battle41_start_03: If youz wrong 'bout dis too, youz gonna be da next one I squishes!
Dialogue/c3battle42_end_01_a: Dat's da way ya duz it!
Dialogue/c3battle42_end_01_b: Follow me, boyz! We gonna kick deez Nidz outta 'ere!
Dialogue/c3battle42_start_01_a: Da Nidz is knokkin on da door!
Dialogue/c3battle42_start_01_b: We gotz ta rally da boyz!
Dialogue/c3battle42_start_02_b: Dis is da fight we been wantin'!
Dialogue/c3battle43_end_01_a: Oi! You Tempaz figger youz can follow dem Nidz inta our base and kick us 'round?
Dialogue/c3battle43_start_01_a: Lookit dat! The Tempaz is comin' right at us too!
Dialogue/c3battle43_start_01_b: Dey must fink da Nidz wuz gonna soffen us up!
Dialogue/c3battle43_start_02_a: Den dey'z in fer a big surprize!
