Dialogue/c3battle44_end_01_a: We gotz dem Tempaz trapped 'gainst dat cliff now.
Dialogue/c3battle44_start_01: Da Nidz 're killin' da Tempaz too!.
Dialogue/c3battle44_start_02_b: Save summa dem tin-can Tempaz fer uz, Nidz! We gotz dibz!
Dialogue/c3battle45_end_01_a: Datz it for dat tricky git. He got wut he had comin'!
Dialogue/c3battle45_end_01_b: But maybe he wuz onta sumthin wit dem buggy-nidz....
Dialogue/c3battle45_start_01: Look, boss! Dat Tempa dat wuz mockin youz iz wit dem!
Dialogue/c3battle45_start_02_a: You stubborn filth! Not even the insatiable hunger of the Tyranids could put an end to your insane assault!
Dialogue/c3battle45_start_02_b: No matter! I live only to execute the Emperor's will!
Dialogue/c3battle46_end_01: Deez ovva Tempaz keep gettin in da way!
Dialogue/c3battle46_end_02: BRING ME YER BOSS, YA GITZ!
Dialogue/c3battle46_start_01_a: Royt! We still ain't found dat Hell-Breaker
Dialogue/c3battle46_start_01_b: Dat git can't hide frum us forevva!
Dialogue/c3battle46_start_02: We needz ta look in new places.
Dialogue/c3battle46_start_03_b: Boyz! Go 'n' stretch ya legz! Find me dat Tempaz git!
Dialogue/c3battle47_end_01: If'n ya like killing dem Nidz, dey seem like dey keep makin more!
Dialogue/c3battle47_start_01_a: Mebbe dat Hell-Break iz in dis mountain?
Dialogue/c3battle47_start_01_b: Sure gotta a lotta Tempaz here.
Dialogue/c3battle47_start_02: An' a whole lotta dem Nidz too!
Dialogue/c3battle47_start_03: KILL DEM ALL! KILL DEM ALL!
Dialogue/c3battle48_end_01_a: Aw, nutz! We ran outta Nidz!
Dialogue/c3battle48_start_01_a: Da Nidz! Dey coming at us from both sidez!
Dialogue/c3battle48_start_02_a: All da betta! Come getcher deffs, ya gitz!
Dialogue/c3battle49_end_01_a: Da Tempaz tried ta get da Nidz ta fight us, royt?
Dialogue/c3battle49_end_01_b: Mebbe we can get da Nidz ta fight dem...
Dialogue/c3battle49_start_01_b: Da swarmy Nidz 're busting straight up from da ground!
Dialogue/c3battle49_start_02_a: Now dey gonna try da same wit us!
Dialogue/c3battle49_start_02_b: Ya know wut works best 'gainst fiyah?
Dialogue/c3battle49_start_04_a: Dat too, but I wuz finkin more tricksy.
Dialogue/c3battle49_start_04_b: Like dey tried to tricks us...
Dialogue/c3battle50_end_01: KILL DEM ALL! KILL DEM ALL!
Dialogue/c3battle50_start_01_a: We just gotta keep dem Nidz on our tail.
Dialogue/c3battle50_start_02_b: Wut happenz if dey catch us? Likes, um, nowz!
Dialogue/c3battle50_start_03: Den we getz ta kill dem all!
Dialogue/c3battle51_end_01: Dem Nidz 're beatin dem locals ta bitz!
Dialogue/c3battle51_start_01_b: And we still gotz da Nidz on our tail!
Dialogue/c3battle51_start_02_b: We gotz dat Hell-Break git ta find!
Dialogue/c3battle52_end_01: I luv it when a plan comes togedda.
Dialogue/c3battle52_start_01: Deez Nidz wanna eat da entire town.
Dialogue/c3battle53_end_01: By the Emperor! Where did these Orks come from?
Dialogue/c3battle53_start_01: Hold your ground against the Tyranid threat, Guardsmen!
Dialogue/c3battle53_start_03_a: Soundz like weez gettin' sumwherez, boyz!
Dialogue/c3battle54_end_01: Now, let's take dis Humie hideout o' dere's to pieces...
Dialogue/c3battle54_start_01: Focus your fire on the Orks!
Dialogue/c3battle54_start_02: All filthy xenos deserve the same fate!
Dialogue/c3battle54_start_03: Looks like we jumped ta da front of da line, boyz!
Dialogue/c3battle54_start_04: FIRST IN LINE! FIRST IN LINE!
Dialogue/c3battle55_end_01: The xenos have breached the gates!
Dialogue/c3battle55_end_02: Stop them! In the Emperor's name!
Dialogue/c3battle55_start_01: Black Templars! Let us take the battle to the Orks!
Dialogue/c3battle55_start_02: Drive these foul xenos from this land!
Dialogue/c3battle55_start_03_a: Startin' ta fink 'e don't like us, boyz!
Dialogue/c3battle55_start_03_b: Dat Tempaz finks weez a bigga threat den dose Nidz!
Dialogue/c3battle56_start_01: Excellent work! We have them right where we want them!
Dialogue/c3battle56_start_02: We gotz Gardz on da one side 'n' Tempaz on da two side!
Dialogue/c3battle56_start_03_a: Thanks, Humies! Dis beatz chasin' ya down!
Dialogue/c3battle56_start_03_b: Youz just runz royt ta us!
Dialogue/c3battle57_end_01_a: Dis is da kinda fun I'm talkin 'bout!
Dialogue/c3battle57_start_01: Hold them, Brothers! We must make our stand here!
Dialogue/c3battle57_start_02_a: Go ahead 'n' keep standin' royt dere!
Dialogue/c3battle57_start_02_b: Steada huntin' ya, weez can just kill ya!
Dialogue/c3battle58_start_01: Send in the Pyreblasters! Cleanse them with the fury of the Emperor's flames!
Dialogue/c3battle58_start_03_b: Weez runnin' toward dat Hell-Break git! Let's git 'em!
Dialogue/c3battle59_end_01_a: I'm finkin' Hell-Break betta check his krono.
Dialogue/c3battle59_start_01: Quit hidin' behind yer tin-can Humies, Hell-Break!
Dialogue/c3battle59_start_03: High Marshal Helbrecht isn't hiding behind anyone!
Dialogue/c3battle59_start_04: He's simply doesn't have time for filth like you!
Dialogue/c3battle60_end_01_a: Fer a Humie who didn't kill da Wurldkilla, you put up a good fight!
Dialogue/c3battle60_end_01_b: Too bad ya wasted dat talent protectin' dat Hell-Break git...
Dialogue/c3battle60_start_01_a: Say your prayers to your heretic gods, you disgusting xenos!
Dialogue/c3battle60_start_01_b: I will ensure they are made in vain!
Dialogue/c3battle60_start_02_a: Prayerz? Ha! I got one question, 'n' it'z fer you!
Dialogue/c3battle60_start_02_b: Are youz da Humie who kilt da Wurldkilla?
Dialogue/c3battle60_start_03_a: I am the the Emperor's chosen champion, blessed with visions of his glory!
Dialogue/c3battle60_start_03_b: And I am the blade he shall wield to strike you down!
Dialogue/c3battle60_start_04_a: Ya can just tell me no.
Dialogue/c3battle60_start_04_b: I'm gonna killz ya either way! WAAAGH!
Dialogue/c3battle61_end_01_a: Dis fightin' iz great fun, but beatin' down Humies and Nidz all at once?
Dialogue/c3battle61_end_01_b: We needz ta put an end ta it!
Dialogue/c3battle61_start_01_a: Weez ain't dun yet. Not by a long shot.
Dialogue/c3battle61_start_01_b: Hey, Hell-Break! Git yer scaredy Humie self out 'ere!
Dialogue/c3battle61_start_02_b: Mebbe we needz ta be louda!
Dialogue/c3battle62_end_01: So much fur doze big boomaz!
Dialogue/c3battle62_start_01_a: Dem Humies iz rainin' boomz down on us!
Dialogue/c3battle62_start_02_a: We gotz ta be smart 'bout it! A team o' sneakerz might get at 'em.
Dialogue/c3battle62_start_02_b: Let'z start sneakin'! No one else getz ta have that kinda fun but me!
Dialogue/c3battle63_end_01: Nuttin' like winnin' a good skrap!
Dialogue/c3battle63_start_01_a: Da Nidz caught up wit' us again!
Dialogue/c3battle63_start_01_b: Dey already mixin' it up wit' da Humies too!
Dialogue/c3battle63_start_02_a: Can't let a good skrap like dat go ta waste!
Dialogue/c3battle63_start_02_b: Let'z clobber dem both while dey ain't lookin'!
Dialogue/c3battle64_end_01_a: We got dem, but da Nidz kilt a lotta boyz too.
Dialogue/c3battle64_end_01_b: Da boyz ain't lookin' too happy...
Dialogue/c3battle64_start_01_a: Da Nidz iz comin' at us from all sidez!
Dialogue/c3battle64_start_01_b: Dey already gotz lotz o' our boyz!
Dialogue/c3battle64_start_02_a: Dat'z Waaagh!!! It runz good 'n' bad. When it'z bad, dere'z only one thing ta do.
Dialogue/c3battle64_start_03: KILL DEM ALL! KILL DEM ALL!
Dialogue/c3battle65_end_01_a: Dat knocked sum o' dem in line.
Dialogue/c3battle65_end_01_b: But we gotz more hedz ta krak still!
Dialogue/c3battle65_start_01_a: Da boyz 're sicka gettin' frozn 'n kilt!
Dialogue/c3battle65_start_02_a: You boyz fink yer tuff enuff ta take me on?
Dialogue/c3battle65_start_02_b: Well den, give it yer best shot!
Dialogue/c3battle65_start_03: KRAK DEM HEDZ! KRAK DEM HEDZ!
Dialogue/c3battle66_end_01: NO MORE HEDZ! NO MORE HEDZ!
Dialogue/c3battle66_start_01_a: A few boyz still don't wanna lissen ta ya.
Dialogue/c3battle66_start_01_b: Dey dug in on dat hill!
Dialogue/c3battle66_start_02_a: You boyz betta git yerselfs in line!
Dialogue/c3battle66_start_02_b: Or I'll krak all yer hedz royt open!
Dialogue/c3battle67_end_01_a: Deez Humies iz just slowin' us down.
Dialogue/c3battle67_end_01_b: We gotz ta get ta Hell-Break now!
Dialogue/c3battle67_start_01: Attention all Black Templars! We have reports of a Tyranid fleet approaching!
Dialogue/c3battle67_start_02: I, High Marshal Helbrecht, hereby order all Imperial units to report to their assigned transports for relocation of planetary forces!
Dialogue/c3battle67_start_03_a: Ya hear dat? Dat Hell-Break git finks he'z leavin'!
Dialogue/c3battle67_start_03_b: We needz ta put a stop ta dat!
Dialogue/c3battle68_end_01_a: Da tempul'z just on da far side of dat valley now.
Dialogue/c3battle68_end_01_b: I'm comin fer yer hed Hell-Break, ya git!
Dialogue/c3battle68_start_01_a: Da boyz sez da Humies holed up in a tempul and iz blastin' off from dere!
Dialogue/c3battle68_start_01_b: It'z just on da far side o' dem mountainz!
Dialogue/c3battle68_start_02_b: So weez going over dat mountain!
Dialogue/c3battle69_end_01_a: Weez ain't gonna let da Nidz have all da fun!
Dialogue/c3battle69_start_01: More Nidz! Dey tryin' ta reach da Humies too!
Dialogue/c3battle69_start_02: Back off, Nidz! Dem Tempaz gitz iz mine!
Dialogue/c3battle69_start_03: GET DEM NIDZ! GET DEM NIDZ!
Dialogue/c3battle70_end_01_b: Hell-Break! Git yer scrawny tin-canned carcass out 'ere!
Dialogue/c3battle70_start_01: Ya fink if da Humies iz all runnin' away dat ain't such a good sign?
Dialogue/c3battle70_start_02_b: Long as dem Humies are runnin' ta where weez can getz 'em, it workz fer me!
Dialogue/c3battle71_end_01_a: Quit hidin' in dat tempul, Hell-Break!
Dialogue/c3battle71_end_01_b: Yer Humie Emprer can't save ya now!
Dialogue/c3battle71_start_01: As if the Tyranids were not enough, now we must deal with Orks as well?
Dialogue/c3battle71_start_02: No matter! The Emperor's light will see us through! Hold the line!
Dialogue/c3battle71_start_03_a: Go 'n' give dat a try, Humies!
Dialogue/c3battle71_start_03_b: Dat line'z just one more fing weez gonna break!
Dialogue/c3battle72_end_01: BURY YOUZ ALL! BURY YOUZ ALL!
Dialogue/c3battle72_start_01: This is an accursed planet. I shall not miss it.
Dialogue/c3battle72_start_02: But before we leave, we shall cleanse it of the taint of these xenos!
Dialogue/c3battle72_start_03_a: Dis wuz an okay place till ya Humies stank it up!
Dialogue/c3battle72_start_03_b: Stick around and let us bury ya!
Dialogue/c3battle73_end_01_b: Ya gonna have ta get used to it!
Dialogue/c3battle73_start_01: We cannot let these Xenos ruin the evacuation!
Dialogue/c3battle73_start_02: Keep them pinned down! I can reach them and bring about their end by my own hand!
Dialogue/c3battle73_start_03_a: Now youz talkin'! Let'z settle dis 'ere and now!
Dialogue/c3battle74_end_01: I gotz ya right where I wantz ya, Hell-Break!
Dialogue/c3battle74_end_02: Git ready to die, ya useless git!
Dialogue/c3battle74_start_01: Keep your eyes up, Brothers! The Tyranids threaten us all too!
Dialogue/c3battle74_start_02: Perhaps we should leave these filthy xenos to devour each other!
Dialogue/c3battle74_start_03_a: Weez gonna take care of dem Nidz just fine!
Dialogue/c3battle74_start_03_b: But not till after I krak yer hed, Hell-Break!
Dialogue/c3battle75_end_01_a: Dey brought in dem gunships ta rescue demselfs!
Dialogue/c3battle75_end_02_b: I wanted Hell-Break's hed. All'z I got wuz his cape!
Dialogue/c3battle75_end_03_a: Ya got dat as a prize, and ya ran dem all off da planet.
Dialogue/c3battle75_end_03_b: Dat makes you da Warboss now!
Dialogue/c3battle75_end_04_a: It looks good on me, don't it, boyz?
Dialogue/c3battle75_end_04_b: Fit fer da best Warboss ever!
Dialogue/c3battle75_end_06: Now, wut wuz all dat grumblin' 'bout a fleet fulla Nidz...?
Dialogue/c3battle75_start_01_a: I shall not shy from you, xenos! I have already slain one Ork Warboss.
Dialogue/c3battle75_start_01_b: I am all too happy to slay another! For the Emperor!
Dialogue/c3battle75_start_02: Da rest of da Humies iz gittin' away!
Dialogue/c3battle75_start_03_a: Who carez 'bout dem? We got Wurldkilla's killa royt 'ere!
Dialogue/c3battle75_start_03_b: Time ta kill 'im and make me da Warboss! WAAAGH!!!
Dialogue/c4battle01_end_02_b: But the runes show it as clear as the reflections on your sword.
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_01: Once rulers of the galaxy, the Aeldari are now a dying race, grimly holding to the fragments of their former glory. They live on vast, planet-sized vessels, called Craftworlds, built to escape their doomed empire of old. Each is a self-sufficient, independent realm with its own culture, history and traditions.
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_02: The Aeldari of Saim-Hann walk a wild and dangerous path in the eyes of other Craftworlds. Despite their ferocious temperament, the Wild Rider hosts of Saim-Hann are proud and disciplined warriors, striking lethal blows like serpents with breathtaking speed.
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_03: Eldryon. You come to me with a formal request, but your eyes speak of dire portents.
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_04_a: Your perception rivals my powers, Aethana. Both are true.
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_04_b: I come with grave tidings, and I need your help.
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_05_a: Your mood carries the severity of a dying star.
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_05_b: What did the skeins of fate tell you, Farseer?
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_06: I had a terrifying vision. It showed how Saim-Hann, the place of our birth and haven for our souls, will be invaded.
Dialogue/c4battle01_start_07: Invaded by the foul sorcerers of the Changer of Ways, the profane Mon-keigh called the Thousand Sons.
Dialogue/c4battle02_start_01: Farseers are the most powerful and revered of all Aeldari Psykers and can use their vast psychic capabilities to read the skeins of fate and see the possibilities of the future. Thus they guide the Aeldari along a path that ensures their survival by manipulating events throughout the galaxy.
Dialogue/c4battle02_start_02: A conflict on the planet Buanthar shifted suddenly. Now the paths lead to this future.
Dialogue/c4battle02_start_03: I saw how they will attack directly out of the Empyrean, laying waste to all we hold dear.
Dialogue/c4battle02_start_04: And even though we fought full of vigour and determination...
Dialogue/c4battle03_end_01: Even our immortal heroes were pushed back eventually.
Dialogue/c4battle03_start_01: Despite all effort, I saw our forces decimated.
Dialogue/c4battle03_start_02: I cried when our loved ones were slaughtered and despoiled.
Dialogue/c4battle04_end_01: But in the end, even the Phoenix Lords at our side fell.
Dialogue/c4battle04_start_01: I saw us muster a valiant last stand.
Dialogue/c4battle04_start_02: Our fury has been that of the Bloody-Handed.
Dialogue/c4battle05_end_01_a: Enough! Snap out of this gloom, Farseer!
Dialogue/c4battle05_end_01_b: There must be something we can do!
Dialogue/c4battle05_end_02_a: Indeed. There is one path to prevent this. One chance for our survival.
Dialogue/c4battle05_end_02_b: That is why I require your aid and your fury.
Dialogue/c4battle05_end_03_a: War calls! And the Wild Host answers!
Dialogue/c4battle05_end_04_a: Gather your forces and lead them to Buanthar. I will be there.
Dialogue/c4battle05_end_04_b: We need to be precise, quick and silent. I hope the coltais has prepared you well, Aethana.
Dialogue/c4battle05_end_05: It will be done, Eldryon. Saim-Hann will prevail!
Dialogue/c4battle05_start_01: The vision showed Daemons desecrating our home.
Dialogue/c4battle05_start_02: If we do not act, not even the souls of our ancestors will be safe...
Dialogue/c4battle05_start_03: ... I hear their screams, as the vile sorcerers sacrifice them to pry forbidden knowledge from Saim-Hann's Infinity Circuit.
Dialogue/c4battle06_end_01_b: Now tell me why she is here, Farseer!
Dialogue/c4battle06_start_01_a: Eldryon, I received your message. My Rangers are ready.
Dialogue/c4battle06_start_01_b: But you did not tell me that I would be commanded by the Autarch next to you...
Dialogue/c4battle06_start_02: What is this, Farseer? Why is this vow breaker here?
Dialogue/c4battle06_start_03_a: Focus! Keep your ire for the enemy!
Dialogue/c4battle06_start_03_b: We have to secure this zone and keep the Webway hidden. Then we talk.
Dialogue/c4battle07_end_01: Good. We will now strike at several key battles to ensure the Imperium can win this.
Dialogue/c4battle07_end_02: If that is the path we must take, then strike we will.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_01: The Webway is a series of pathways that exists between the material realm and the warp. This labyrinth dimension still connects many Aeldari planets and craftworlds to one another, but the baleful energies of the Fall created dead ends, treacherous tendrils and endless mazes.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_02_a: The Changer of Ways besieges this world which is currently held by the humans of the Imperium.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_02_b: We must eliminate one of the Thousand Sons' appalling warriors before it can land a critical blow against the Imperium's defences.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_03: Then we strike it swift and deadly like the Serpent.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_04_a: No, Aethana, a direct assault is too risky.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_04_b: We will let the humans clear a path for us before we strike.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_05: So we ally with Mon-keigh and vow breakers instead. Times are truly dire...
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_06: We need Calandis and her Rangers to move unseen. She knows this planet like no other.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_07_a: Do not waste your efforts, Eldryon. Her mind is ablaze with only the past.
Dialogue/c4battle07_start_07_b: Follow me ... if it is not too much to ask...
Dialogue/c4battle08_end_01: These primitive savages are no match for the Wild Host!
Dialogue/c4battle08_end_02_a: Aethana, control your warrior's pride. We cannot lose focus.
Dialogue/c4battle08_end_02_b: It is not the place and time to indulge in lust for blood, or it will be our blood that is spilled.
Dialogue/c4battle08_end_03_a: You should show more trust for the forces you command, Farseer!
Dialogue/c4battle08_end_03_b: Nothing stands against the Serpent of Saim-Hann!
Dialogue/c4battle08_start_01: We have to take down this group, too. The Imperials will come this way.
Dialogue/c4battle08_start_02: Kinsmen of Saim-Hann, you heard him. Let Khaine kindle your fury and cull them down.
Dialogue/c4battle09_end_01: Oh thank the Emperor! In his wisdom he pitted our enemies against each other!
Dialogue/c4battle09_end_02: The path is clear now. With me, advance!!!
Dialogue/c4battle09_end_04: The Emperor. Misguided simpletons. If only they knew the true nature of their "Emperor"...
Dialogue/c4battle09_end_05: It matters not. Let us continue.
Dialogue/c4battle09_start_01_a: Eldryon, the battle here has already started.
Dialogue/c4battle09_start_01_b: We are too late to take out the forces of the great enemy.
Dialogue/c4battle09_start_02: We still have to intervene! The Imperium must win here!
Dialogue/c4battle10_end_01_a: You told us why you brought the Blei-deòradi. But why me?
Dialogue/c4battle10_end_01_b: You knew we would clash! This affects our clarity in battle.
Dialogue/c4battle10_end_02: It had to be you. The runes showed me that the only way to survival contains you commanding our warriors.
Dialogue/c4battle10_end_04: In preparation for war, many Saim-Hann warriors make verbal agreements with their kin, which they seal by drinking from each other’s slashed wrists. To break one of these vows is to become Blei-deòradi, disgraced exiles.
Dialogue/c4battle10_start_01_a: It pains me to spill our noble blood for these primitive savages.
Dialogue/c4battle10_start_01_b: They surely would betray us the first moment they could. Like this Blei-deòradi over there.
Dialogue/c4battle10_start_02_a: The path of the Outcast has led me here, Autarch!
Dialogue/c4battle10_start_02_b: I am shunned and jested at for nearly a hundred years now, only because to you winning is more important than protecting your own kin.
Dialogue/c4battle10_start_03: Still I came to save our people!
Dialogue/c4battle10_start_04: Not protecting kin? Nine souls are lost because of you! We relied on you!
Dialogue/c4battle10_start_05: I was on foot and was ambushed! I pleaded for you to bide your time!
Dialogue/c4battle10_start_06: Enough. We must work together or there will be yet more Aeldari souls to mourn!
Dialogue/c4battle11_end_01: It is done, Farseer. Just point us to the next battle.
Dialogue/c4battle11_start_01: They are fighting on ancient wraithbone, without even knowing what their clumsy feet trample down.
Dialogue/c4battle11_start_02_a: For once I share your feelings, Outcast.
Dialogue/c4battle11_start_02_b: We should call upon the full might of Saim-Hann to make them pay for this disgrace.
Dialogue/c4battle11_start_03_a: No! Grander bloodshed is not the path to salvation here.
Dialogue/c4battle11_start_03_b: As much as it pains me, none of that matters.
Dialogue/c4battle11_start_04: Only the destruction of the Thousand Son warrior is important now.
Dialogue/c4battle12_end_01_a: Aethana, Eldryon. Two Phoenix Lords have arrived on Saim-Hann.
Dialogue/c4battle12_end_01_b: The Harvester of Souls and the Storm of Silence.
Dialogue/c4battle12_end_02: Two of them? Now? Dire portents indeed.
Dialogue/c4battle12_end_03: It cannot be a coincidence. If I did not believe you before already, there is no more denying it now, Eldryon.
Dialogue/c4battle12_end_04: Should we not rejoice in their arrival? These warriors of legend come to our aid!
Dialogue/c4battle12_start_01_a: Good. The humans are cleaving a path through the forces of the Changer of Ways.
Dialogue/c4battle12_start_01_b: But as predicted, they start calling upon the Empyrean for reinforcements.
Dialogue/c4battle12_start_02: Daemons... as if all this wasn't enough yet.
Dialogue/c4battle12_start_03: We have to destroy them, before they can slow down the Imperial forces.
Dialogue/c4battle13_end_01: We guard the perimeter. Go ahead, Eldryon.
Dialogue/c4battle13_start_01: The Phoenix Lords were the very first of the Exarchs. Each founded one of the shrines of the Asuryani, and is the embodiment of an Aspect of the warrior god Khaine. They are immortal, for when a Phoenix Lord is slain, another Aeldari inherits their panoply of war and assumes their identity.
Dialogue/c4battle13_start_02_a: I had not foreseen the Phoenix Lords' arrival so soon.
Dialogue/c4battle13_start_02_b: That might change everything! I need to scry the runes again.
Dialogue/c4battle13_start_03: Then let us take out the enemy quickly, to buy you more time.
Dialogue/c4battle14_end_01: Well done. The window to strike at the Thousand Sons warrior opens now.
Dialogue/c4battle14_start_01_a: The Phoenix Lords have seen the same vision and will stand with us.
Dialogue/c4battle14_start_01_b: The runes still show a path to prevent the attack. We must continue!
Dialogue/c4battle14_start_03: Fate still changed, we must also cut off the Daemonic incursion afterwards.
Dialogue/c4battle14_start_04: The Imperials are now attacking the foothold of the Thousand Sons.
Dialogue/c4battle14_start_05: We can change this fate after all! Though first we have to take out one more defence line.
Dialogue/c4battle15_end_01: The abomination is destroyed. Is it right to feel relieved now?
Dialogue/c4battle15_end_02_a: Relish this moment of victory, Calandis. Gather strength from it.
Dialogue/c4battle15_end_02_b: But the fight is not over yet. We still have to stop a ritual that connects this world with the Empyrean.
Dialogue/c4battle15_start_01: Quickly now, and focus! We cannot falter.
Dialogue/c4battle15_start_02_a: Riders of Saim-Hann! The hour is upon us. Strike like the Serpent and shatter them on the anvil of Vaul!
Dialogue/c4battle15_start_02_b: And we have to fight in unity, Outcast. Can I trust you today?
Dialogue/c4battle15_start_03: First enemy is down. Are you coming?
Dialogue/c4battle16_end_01: We have to leave with haste.
Dialogue/c4battle16_end_02_a: The Thousand Sons perform a profane ritual that breaches the barrier to the Empyrean.
Dialogue/c4battle16_end_02_b: We need to stop this, before corruption spreads, for it has already started.
Dialogue/c4battle16_end_03: The Warp, also called Empyrean, is a dimension of pure psychic energy and raw emotions that underlies the material universe. It brings great opportunity, for it allows faster than light travel. But it also brings great danger, for it is the realm of the Chaos Gods and their Daemonic legions, ever hungry for the souls of the living.
Dialogue/c4battle16_start_01: Once the XVth Legion of Imperial Astartes, the Thousand Sons were seekers of knowledge. This noble curiosity was their doom, as it turned them into a powerful pawn of the Chaos God Tzeentch and its grand designs. Now they scour the galaxy for arcane knowledge, no price too steep and no deed too unthinkable to claim their prize.
Dialogue/c4battle16_start_02: Rejoice, Wild Riders! For the enemy lies broken at your feet!
Dialogue/c4battle16_start_03_a: It is an important victory, but we should not rejoice in the act of killing.
Dialogue/c4battle16_start_04_a: I fear your lesson has to wait, Eldryon.
Dialogue/c4battle17_end_01: 3rd Platoon to Company Command. Do you read?
Dialogue/c4battle17_end_02: I have to report a rout...
Dialogue/c4battle17_start_01: Enlighten me again ... we are killing the Imperials now? Did we not just help them?
Dialogue/c4battle17_start_02_a: The Imperium has to take the cult in their midst seriously.
Dialogue/c4battle17_start_02_b: The cults need some initial wins for this process to quicken.
Dialogue/c4battle17_start_03: So we weaken the Imperials before the cult forces arrive.
Dialogue/c4battle17_start_04: It does not matter which Mon-keigh we kill. Let us begin.
Dialogue/c4battle18_end_01: 2nd Platoon to Company Command. Do you read?
Dialogue/c4battle18_end_02: There is no one at the rendezvous point.
Dialogue/c4battle18_end_03: Is this a jest? Because it is not funny! Do I have to repeat the demonstration of the proper use of a vox caster?
Dialogue/c4battle18_start_01: A rout? What in the Emperor's name...
Dialogue/c4battle18_start_02: You are stationed 378 miles away from the front line. How can there be a rout?
Dialogue/c4battle18_start_03: I... I don't know sir. I was scouting the perimeter... and now they are all gone!
Dialogue/c4battle18_start_04: So you failed to keep up your schedule?
Dialogue/c4battle18_start_05: Your delay and unadulterated misuse of vital communication lines will be recorded and duly punished, trooper!
Dialogue/c4battle18_start_06: These Mon-keigh are hard to make sense of... did it work?
Dialogue/c4battle18_start_07: ... Let us repeat to be sure.
Dialogue/c4battle19_end_01: 1st Platoon to Company Command. Do you read?
Dialogue/c4battle19_end_03: The Munitorum relay point has been overrun, sir.
Dialogue/c4battle19_end_04: By the Throne! How often do I have to tell you maggots, that the vox ca... *shot*
Dialogue/c4battle19_end_05: Speak, trooper! This heretic will not delay you anymore.
Dialogue/c4battle19_end_06: Finally someone with will and fervour.
Dialogue/c4battle19_start_01_a: How could these primitive savages ever conquer the galaxy?
Dialogue/c4battle19_start_01_b: The planet could break beneath them and they would still ignore it because it "cannot be".
Dialogue/c4battle19_start_02_b: They should soon realise the traitors in their midst.
Dialogue/c4battle20_end_01: Canoness! The traitors attacked another position.
Dialogue/c4battle20_end_02: But our reinforcements caught them by surprise and made prisoners to interrogate.
Dialogue/c4battle20_start_01: The Chaos God Tzeentch, also known as the Changer of Ways, brings sorcery, mutation, intrigue, ambition, knowledge, destiny and deceit. Especially empowered by the desire for change and ambition for advancement among mortals, everyone is a pawn in his myriad layered plans.
Dialogue/c4battle20_start_02_a: My rangers report that the imperials start investigating the cult in force, now.
Dialogue/c4battle20_start_02_b: Though I cannot shake the feeling that we are pulling more strings that we can control...
Dialogue/c4battle20_start_03: What is this, Outcast? Are you even considering betraying the Seers now?
Dialogue/c4battle20_start_04_a: Please, we must focus, we cannot be our own undoing!
Dialogue/c4battle20_start_04_b: It is time to set up a trap for the cult. We attack their target before they arrive, alarming the Imperials.
Dialogue/c4battle21_end_01: The Path of Command is for those with a desire to develop complex military tactics and grand strategy. The Autarchs tread this Path and lead the entire military forces of their craftworld when a threat makes itself known. They are expected to have completed several other Paths already, including at least once the Path of the Warrior.
Dialogue/c4battle21_start_01_b: But we need to strike at the cult now without getting caught in the Imperial's wrath.
Dialogue/c4battle21_start_02_b: Appoint the targets and we shall take them out with untold speed and ferocity!
Dialogue/c4battle22_end_01: I ... owe you, Outcast. Thank you.
Dialogue/c4battle22_end_02_a: Say and think what you will, you are still my kin.
Dialogue/c4battle22_end_02_b: No one is left behind on my watch. Not even you.
Dialogue/c4battle23_end_01_a: I need to scry the runes again.
Dialogue/c4battle23_end_01_b: We cannot lose control of the situation.
Dialogue/c4battle23_end_02: First we need to make sure the group over there does not get away!
Dialogue/c4battle23_start_01: Some young, eccentric or disgraced Asuryani cannot bear the constraints imposed by craftworld life, and elect to leave the Craftworld and travel the stars. Most tread this perilous Path of the Outcasts as Rangers. As such they investigate alien planets, search for lost webway gates or artefacts and hunt down threats, until some eventually return home.
Dialogue/c4battle23_start_02_a: Eldryon! My Rangers report that the Imperials approach the Webway Gate.
Dialogue/c4battle23_start_02_b: Their search for the cult must have increased their scrutiny.
Dialogue/c4battle23_start_03_a: This is worrying. The future paths are converging.
Dialogue/c4battle23_start_03_b: But we cannot lose access to the Webway Gate.
Dialogue/c4battle23_start_04: Indeed. Calandis, take out their communication tool. Then we strike.
Dialogue/c4battle24_end_01: They will come searching for their lost soldiers.
Dialogue/c4battle24_end_02: Not if they are distracted on all fronts.
Dialogue/c4battle24_start_01_a: Windriders! Cut off their escape route!
Dialogue/c4battle24_start_01_b: Rangers, rain fire from that hill.
Dialogue/c4battle24_start_02: Everyone else, with me! They cannot get out of here!
Dialogue/c4battle25_end_01_a: A marvellous strike of the Serpent. Thank you, my kin.
Dialogue/c4battle25_end_01_b: But I need more time to commune with the council. The future became uncertain!
Dialogue/c4battle25_start_01_a: Our strike left the Imperials vulnerable in this section.
Dialogue/c4battle25_start_01_b: And the cult is bolstered by Daemons.
Dialogue/c4battle25_start_02: Then we have to even the odds. Guide our path, Eldryon.
Dialogue/c4battle25_start_03: Use my Rangers as your eyes.
Dialogue/c4battle25_start_04: And the Wild Riders are your sword!
Dialogue/c4battle26_end_01: Aethana! These reckless decisions unravel our fate!
Dialogue/c4battle26_end_02_a: I am aware of my actions, Farseer!
Dialogue/c4battle26_end_02_b: But you cannot guide us if you are dead! I needed to act.
Dialogue/c4battle26_end_03_a: I ... you are right. But we need to coordinate.
Dialogue/c4battle26_start_01_a: Aethana, another Imperial search group is closing in.
Dialogue/c4battle26_start_01_b: But Eldryon is still scrying the runes.
Dialogue/c4battle26_start_02_a: ... Take them out! Their communication first!
Dialogue/c4battle26_start_02_b: We have to protect the Farseer!
Dialogue/c4battle27_end_01: I can sense your futile meddling, Aeldari!
Dialogue/c4battle27_end_02: Whatever you do, wherever you are. Your efforts will fail! It has been foreseen!
Dialogue/c4battle27_start_01_a: I have pierced through the foul illusions of the Thousand Sons.
Dialogue/c4battle27_start_01_b: I have finally found the location of the ritual.
Dialogue/c4battle27_start_03_a: The Imperials are on the way to stage the distraction we need.
Dialogue/c4battle27_start_04: They will find no hindrance. Wild Host, we ride out again!
Dialogue/c4battle28_end_01: Just hold out a little bit longer, Eldryon!
Dialogue/c4battle28_start_01_a: I have to be careful. The cult leader is an Infernal Master of the Thousand Sons.
Dialogue/c4battle28_start_02: Does he know of our attack?
Dialogue/c4battle28_start_03_a: No, not yet. But I don't know how much longer I can hide our presence.
Dialogue/c4battle28_start_03_b: He scours the Empyrean, searching for us.
Dialogue/c4battle28_start_04: We are on the way to him.
Dialogue/c4battle29_end_01: What are they doing here? Why are they defiling this sacred place!?
Dialogue/c4battle29_end_02: They are using the Wraithbone as a conduit for their vile ritual.
Dialogue/c4battle29_end_03: Blood runs ... anger rises... death wakes. War calls!
Dialogue/c4battle29_start_01: Psykers are able to call upon the raging energies of the warp and manifest these as psychic powers, enabling them to all sorts of miraculous deeds or acts of unimaginable destruction. However, these powers come at great risk, for uncaring use of warp can cause catastrophic collateral damage and invite the terrors of Daemonic possession.
Dialogue/c4battle29_start_03: I assume it was you, who revealed us to the minions of the Corpse Emperor.
Dialogue/c4battle29_start_04: But whatever your role is in this, it ends now!
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_01_a: It is done! It is really done!
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_01_b: I... I need to rest now.
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_02: What is ... this? Aethana, is this...?
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_03_a: The Crest of Barantharal! Why? How did it end up here?
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_03_b: We thought it was lost forever!
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_04: The soulstones in it are still intact.
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_05_a: Your family created it on that day, did they not?
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_05_b: In memory of the nine lost souls... again, I am so sorry.
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_06_a: Your excuse won't bring them back, Blei-deòradi!
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_06_b: We have to bring it home!
Dialogue/c4battle30_end_07: I concur. But we have to be careful. We don't know what vile sorcery has touched it!
Dialogue/c4battle30_start_01_a: NO! I will not see our work of decades undone by your dying race, Aeldari!
Dialogue/c4battle30_start_01_b: You can't even start to fathom what is at stake here!
Dialogue/c4battle30_start_02: Lash out as you will. Your foul quest ends here, abomination!
Dialogue/c4battle31_end_01: How did the Thousand Sons get here?!
Dialogue/c4battle31_end_02: I don't know! The runes did not speak of this!
Dialogue/c4battle31_start_01: Calandis. I am glad seeing you exploring the paths of Saim-Hann again.
Dialogue/c4battle31_start_02_a: Eldryon! I have to admit, it is a bit overwhelming.
Dialogue/c4battle31_start_02_b: So many memories come back... the beautiful ones, but also these bitter reminders of conflict.
Dialogue/c4battle31_start_03_a: I can imagine. Some wounds take a long time to heal. But...
Dialogue/c4battle31_start_03_b: What was this explosion? And the cries!?
Dialogue/c4battle31_start_04: We are under attack! Defensive positions!
Dialogue/c4battle32_end_01_a: A rift to the Empyrean opened in the Halls of Barantharal.
Dialogue/c4battle32_end_02_a: The crest... oh no... our doom is upon us!
Dialogue/c4battle32_end_02_b: How could I be so blind?!
Dialogue/c4battle32_start_01_a: Daemons! Wild Riders, rally around me, we need to keep the high ground!
Dialogue/c4battle33_end_01: This is insanity! How do they intend to stand against the full might of a Craftworld?
Dialogue/c4battle33_end_02_a: Let them come. Our warhosts will cut down every last one of these foul Daemons!
Dialogue/c4battle34_end_01_b: This foul sorcery should be no match against your combined psychic might! Isn't it true Eldryon!?
Dialogue/c4battle34_end_02_a: The council is separated and besieged, some of them slain already.
Dialogue/c4battle34_end_02_b: We can't channel our efforts this way...
Dialogue/c4battle34_end_03_a: They knew exactly what will happen... and when...
Dialogue/c4battle34_start_01: Lady Aethana, we cannot reach the other Autarchs or Exarchs!
Dialogue/c4battle34_start_02: Look over there! What is this terrifying fire?! What did they do?
Dialogue/c4battle34_start_03_a: They manifested a barrier out of infernal warpflame and walled off the core of the Craftworld!
Dialogue/c4battle34_start_03_b: We are trapped, in our own home! Our warhosts are locked out on the other side.
Dialogue/c4battle35_end_01: You ... are right, Aethana. My despair is of no help to us.
Dialogue/c4battle35_end_02_a: Guide us, Eldryon. Lend us your singing spear against their vile sorcery.
Dialogue/c4battle35_end_02_b: We all share the guilt of being tricked by the enemy and bringing the Crest here. Together.
Dialogue/c4battle35_end_03_a: The Outcast speaks true. We trusted you then, we still trust you now.
Dialogue/c4battle35_start_01_a: How could I be so blind?
Dialogue/c4battle35_start_01_b: I was so focused on the future. I did not spot the malefic shadow that hid its connection to the past.
Dialogue/c4battle35_start_02_a: It was their capricious plan all along.
Dialogue/c4battle35_start_02_b: They sacrificed their own for this ruse. It was all about the Crest.
Dialogue/c4battle35_start_03: I ... failed. I doomed us all!
Dialogue/c4battle35_start_05_a: As long as I draw breath I will bring death to these abominations with the wrath of the bloody handed!
Dialogue/c4battle35_start_05_b: And so will you. This is a command!
Dialogue/c4battle36_end_01: This is the Spear of Eldanesh. Can you repeat that command?
Dialogue/c4battle36_end_02: The firing vectors you gave us would hit the craftworld.
Dialogue/c4battle36_end_03_a: This is Autarch Aethana Barantharal. The command is intentional.
Dialogue/c4battle36_end_03_b: We need drastic actions to overcome this attack.
Dialogue/c4battle36_end_04: Fire. Crash through the hull. We need a breach to land our forces from outside to get around the enemies defences.
Dialogue/c4battle36_start_01_a: We cannot prevent their actions with foresight and cannot break through their sorcery...
Dialogue/c4battle36_start_01_b: ... but we are still the serpent. We strike fast ... from unforeseen directions.
Dialogue/c4battle36_start_02: Eldryon, try to hail the fleet. We hold the ground meanwhile.
Dialogue/c4battle37_end_01: What destruction... Let us honour their sacrifice with victory.
Dialogue/c4battle37_start_03: Quick, we need all the strength we still can muster to secure the landing site.
Dialogue/c4battle38_end_01_a: Saim-Hann will not fall during my watch!
Dialogue/c4battle38_end_01_b: Not now, not when I have only just returned home.
Dialogue/c4battle38_start_02_a: Wild Riders. This might be our last race!
Dialogue/c4battle38_start_02_b: Make sure that it will be a glorious spectacle worthy of our names!
Dialogue/c4battle39_end_01: The first Solaris cruiser is on its way.
Dialogue/c4battle39_start_01: They are everywhere, I am losing focus...
Dialogue/c4battle39_start_03: They have outpaced me, we are separated!
Dialogue/c4battle40_end_01: What?! Where did the rest go?
Dialogue/c4battle40_start_01_b: Push these vile Daemons back, we need to buy more time to land the Aspect hosts.
Dialogue/c4battle41_end_01: We got this group. But the rest translocated again!
Dialogue/c4battle41_start_01: Behind us! Regroup and fall back!
Dialogue/c4battle42_end_01: It seems to be one of the mutant abominations!
Dialogue/c4battle42_start_01_b: Eldryon, how can we stop this?! This way they will grind us down before we can land our forces.
Dialogue/c4battle42_start_02_a: Their sorcerers orchestrate this from afar.
Dialogue/c4battle42_start_02_b: I can sense the psychic energies forming. We need to eliminate their empyrean conduit!
Dialogue/c4battle42_start_03: More specific, Farseer! Who or what shall I slice with my blade?
Dialogue/c4battle43_end_01: So many slaughtered ... we have to guard their soulstones!
Dialogue/c4battle43_end_02: You heard the Ranger! Support the landing vessels!
Dialogue/c4battle43_end_03: I found the mutant beast that serves as their conduit for the spell!
Dialogue/c4battle43_start_01: Aethana, the first landing vessels are on the way!
Dialogue/c4battle43_start_02: No, too early! We are not ready yet.
Dialogue/c4battle44_end_01_b: I will alter the target, so we can cut them down in a crossfire.
Dialogue/c4battle44_start_01_a: It is this foul beast on that Daemon, in the midst of their forces.
Dialogue/c4battle44_start_01_b: We need to threaten it to force its translocation sorcery, so I can break their link.
Dialogue/c4battle44_start_02: Give me cover, I'll aim for its head!
Dialogue/c4battle45_end_01_a: The beast is down! Cut down the rest!
Dialogue/c4battle45_end_01_b: We need to secure the landing breach.
Dialogue/c4battle45_end_02_a: That was impressive, Eldryon. Be proud of your deeds.
Dialogue/c4battle45_end_02_b: Gather strength from this moment of victory.
Dialogue/c4battle45_end_03: Ha, thank you, Calandis. I will heed your advice.
Dialogue/c4battle45_end_04_a: Our forces are landing. We have an army now.
Dialogue/c4battle45_end_04_b: Let us throw the invaders back into the dark abyss they came from!
Dialogue/c4battle45_start_01: NOW! I have unmade their foul warpcraft.
Dialogue/c4battle45_start_02: Calandis! It's head is yours! Go!
Dialogue/c4battle46_end_01: Xenos! You should not have involved your brittle fleet. They too now face destruction.
Dialogue/c4battle46_end_02: Hubris! How can this monster pose a threat to our entire fleet?
Dialogue/c4battle46_end_03: Beware, yet more baleful sorcery may be upon us!
Dialogue/c4battle46_start_02: It appears I stand corrected, Aethana.
Dialogue/c4battle46_start_03_a: I will forever mourn the souls that sacrificed themselves performing the tragic manoeuvre you devised...
Dialogue/c4battle46_start_03_b: ... however I cannot deny that it brought us desperately needed time and a chance to emerge victorious.
Dialogue/c4battle46_start_04: I feel your pain, Farseer. May fate spare me from ever having to impose such a command again.
Dialogue/c4battle47_end_01: We are receiving a transmission from a Mon-keigh vessel.
Dialogue/c4battle47_end_02: This is Apocalypse Class Battleship Purity of Wrath.
Dialogue/c4battle47_end_03: Your unprovoked treachery will not go unpunished.
Dialogue/c4battle47_end_04: Revealing your position while destroying Imperial vessels in the vicinity of our battlefleet's arsenal was a grave mistake.
Dialogue/c4battle47_end_05: One that will be your last.
Dialogue/c4battle47_start_01: Aethana! The fleet has intercepted a human distress beacon in close proximity to the Craftworld.
Dialogue/c4battle47_start_02_a: We cannot delay our Warhosts. The hour of battle is upon us!
Dialogue/c4battle47_start_02_b: Some misbegotten Mon-keigh are of no concern.
Dialogue/c4battle47_start_03_a: The strands of fate did not foretell such an event... what vile scheme is this?
Dialogue/c4battle48_end_01_a: Our fleet detects the approach of a large number of human vessels.
Dialogue/c4battle48_end_01_b: An entire armada poses an insurmountable peril to our embattled craftworld!
Dialogue/c4battle48_end_02_b: By what arcane sorcery have I been blinded? To be so oblivious to the threads that now unravel before us?
Dialogue/c4battle48_end_03_a: It is undoubtedly the culmination of the Thousand Sons' scheming.
Dialogue/c4battle48_end_03_b: We must hunt them down and eradicate them.
Dialogue/c4battle48_start_01_b: The Imperial Navy fields battleships the size of cities with enough firepower to level planets. Supported by an armada of support vessels, they vanquish their foes with unwavering determination and brutal force. While the Aeldari vessels are swift and deadly void hunters, these strengths do not favour attritional engagements.
Dialogue/c4battle48_start_02_a: Why have we attacked the humans?
Dialogue/c4battle48_start_02_b: It cannot be our intention to fight this war on two fronts.
Dialogue/c4battle48_start_03_a: It is not. I gave no command for such an action.
Dialogue/c4battle48_start_03_b: No Autarch of Saim-Hann would reveal the Craftworld's position so carelessly.
Dialogue/c4battle48_start_04_a: Indeed. This perplexing web of events bears the mark of the Thousand Sons' Sorcerer.
Dialogue/c4battle48_start_04_b: This must be a result of their doing.
Dialogue/c4battle49_end_01_a: Continue to seek out our enemies, Farseer.
Dialogue/c4battle49_end_01_b: We will deliver them a swift death.
Dialogue/c4battle49_end_02: We guard you with the might of the warhost!
Dialogue/c4battle49_start_01: You must find a way to put an end to their machinations, Eldryon. Our warriors will hold them at bay.
Dialogue/c4battle49_start_02_a: Give me some time. I must scry the Empyrean for traces of the enemy's sorcery.
Dialogue/c4battle49_start_02_b: The immaterial tides are roiling. The truth evades me within the maelstrom caused by this battle.
Dialogue/c4battle49_start_03: You shall have your wish! Wild Host, rally to my side!
Dialogue/c4battle50_end_01_a: It appears we have found temporary solace here.
Dialogue/c4battle50_start_01_b: These duplicitous sorcerers conjure it from deep within our Craftworld.
Dialogue/c4battle50_start_02_a: There was no distress beacon. The humans were misled. Their minds and machines deceived.
Dialogue/c4battle50_start_02_b: Our veil of concealment was lifted and they were lured to our position.
Dialogue/c4battle50_start_04: I need time to locate the exact source of the illusion and avert our fate.
Dialogue/c4battle50_start_05: We have been encircled, we must reposition!
Dialogue/c4battle51_end_01: My fury will not abate until every abomination lies dead at my feet.
Dialogue/c4battle51_end_02: Transform your fury into a source of strength Aethana, control it, and wield it like a savant of war.
Dialogue/c4battle51_end_03: Your words hold wisdom, Farseer, but I fear I will lose the battle to temper my wrath.
Dialogue/c4battle51_end_04_b: The Chaos God Slaanesh is an insatiable deity, embodying excess, perfection and hedonism. It corrupts and lures the living with their darkest desires to feed from their souls. Forever destined to be consumed by Slaanesh, the Aeldari harbor the souls of their dead in Spirit Stones to escape their doom.
Dialogue/c4battle51_start_01_a: The Sorcerer's exertion in the Empyrean revealed their location. Once more they commence a vile ritual.
Dialogue/c4battle51_start_01_b: With it they sustain their deceitful illusion close to the Halls of Barantharal.
Dialogue/c4battle51_start_02_a: How much further must they defile the name of my Kinband!
Dialogue/c4battle51_start_02_b: I will be their reaper. I will rend their dust-filled husks asunder and scatter them from the halls of my ancestors!
Dialogue/c4battle51_start_03_a: Aethana! Do not allow your anger to blind you.
Dialogue/c4battle51_start_03_b: Do not let the raging fires consume you, wield your fury as a searing weapon!
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_01_a: They will fall before our blades again and again!
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_01_b: We shall be a firestorm of vengeance that scours every last trace of these abominations from our home.
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_02_a: I would have us rather stay in the shadows.
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_02_b: There is no glory in recklessly throwing ourselves into a fight we cannot win. We should learn from our past mistakes!
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_03: Are you committed to eroding the thin layer of my respect you have gained, Outcast?
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_04_a: No Aethana, forgive me. I only wish for you to wield the full potential of our might!
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_04_b: Acting single minded we are mere embers. United, at your command, we can bring forth a burning victory!
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_05_a: Calandis is right. We all walk our own perilous paths. We must not forget why, lest we be reminded with doom.
Dialogue/c4battle52_end_05_b: Respect that each path is different, but still a vital part of the Serpent's unsurpassable might!
Dialogue/c4battle52_start_01_a: Our journey through the shadows must end here.
Dialogue/c4battle52_start_01_b: The enemy blocks our path to the Halls of Barantharal. We can no longer avoid a direct confrontation.
Dialogue/c4battle52_start_02_a: As it shall be. Cowering in darkness does not befit our campaign of retribution.
Dialogue/c4battle52_start_02_b: They shall feel the wrath of Saim-hann burning as bright as the stars!
Dialogue/c4battle53_end_01_a: The Halls of Barantharal are still beyond our reach.
Dialogue/c4battle53_end_01_b: We must cut through the heart of the main battlefield, where our forces have pushed the enemy back.
Dialogue/c4battle53_end_02: In the aftermath we will find a direct path that allows us to press on swiftly.
Dialogue/c4battle53_start_01_a: The fleet alarms me that the Imperial vessels are launching an attack.
Dialogue/c4battle53_start_01_b: We have to hasten our efforts!
Dialogue/c4battle53_start_02: The High Admiral is looking forward to adding the destruction of a Craftworld to his list of achievements. A rare trophy!
Dialogue/c4battle54_end_01: We have reached our destination, I see them!
Dialogue/c4battle54_start_01: Forward, Wild Riders. We must move faster, still!
Dialogue/c4battle54_start_02: Readily. It pains me to witness the wake of destruction this horrible battle left behind.
Dialogue/c4battle54_start_03: The skeins reveal another repugnant group of surviving warpspawn ahead of us.
Dialogue/c4battle54_start_04: Overrun them! They will not find us slowed down!
Dialogue/c4battle55_end_01: The ritual is stopped. But I cannot sense a trace of their disdainful Sorcerer.
Dialogue/c4battle55_end_02_a: Now that the illusion is banished, convincing the Imperial fleet is of the gravest importance.
Dialogue/c4battle55_start_01: There! They conjure their misbegotten sorcery from this plaza.
Dialogue/c4battle55_start_02_a: It is time to end this! Wild Riders:
Dialogue/c4battle56_end_01_a: Eldryon, are your actions bearing fruit?
Dialogue/c4battle56_end_01_b: More Daemons are clawing their way out of the Empyrean!
Dialogue/c4battle56_end_02: Soon, Aethana! Bending the roiling energies here to our benefit is a very complex endeavor.
Dialogue/c4battle56_start_01: Your duplicitous pleas are meaningless, alien filth. You will receive no mercy.
Dialogue/c4battle56_start_03: Foolish Mon-Keigh! These short-sighted actions will only serve to benefit the Great Enemy!
Dialogue/c4battle56_start_04: So predictable. There is no illusion needed to misguide the lapdogs of the Corpse Emperor.
Dialogue/c4battle56_start_05_a: We must end this sorcerer. Our future paths depend on his defeat.
Dialogue/c4battle56_start_05_b: Though first we must avert the misguided humans. If their minds cannot comprehend reason, then we shall have to convince them through other means.
Dialogue/c4battle56_start_06: I require your protection once more.
Dialogue/c4battle57_end_01: You do not know what you are meddling with here, xenos witch!
Dialogue/c4battle57_end_02: Were you so naive to believe I would let you just undo my creation?
Dialogue/c4battle57_end_03: Now that you have shown yourself, you will perish for your insolence.
Dialogue/c4battle57_end_04_a: My spell revealed us in the Empyrean!
Dialogue/c4battle57_end_04_b: It lures the ravenous Daemons to hunt us!
Dialogue/c4battle57_start_01_b: A broad bio-dome with groves of tall wraithbone trees that reach out into space. It is to here that the most ancient Farseers retreat, their minds so closely linked with the Craftworld's core that their physical bodies grow dormant. Gradually they take root and turn entirely to crystal, their spirits preserved forever within the Infinity Circuit.
Dialogue/c4battle57_start_02_a: My actions are succeeding. Our fleet hails me, stating that the Imperial vessels have ceased their fire and are retreating.
Dialogue/c4battle57_start_02_b: Not a moment too early. My powers bear a heavy toll this day. I feel the call of my predecessors...
Dialogue/c4battle57_start_03_a: You are the salvation of Saim-Hann!
Dialogue/c4battle57_start_03_b: How did you deceive these presumptuous Mon-keigh?
Dialogue/c4battle57_start_04_a: I turned the dissipating ritual energies into a new illusionary distress beacon.
Dialogue/c4battle57_start_04_b: A delusive signal that indicates a vast fleet of the Thousand Sons is attacking a nearby system of significant importance.
Dialogue/c4battle57_start_05: A true display of brilliance. With this we...
Dialogue/c4battle58_end_01: You can't possibly dare to challenge me alone.
Dialogue/c4battle58_end_02: I will crush your pathetic will.
Dialogue/c4battle58_start_01_a: We have to fall back, we are too exposed.
Dialogue/c4battle58_start_01_b: Move swiftly to reunite with our warhost!
Dialogue/c4battle58_start_02_a: Hold, the dreaded sorcerer is almost within our grasp.
Dialogue/c4battle58_start_02_b: Grant me more time, Aethana, and I shall direct your Wind Riders to fall upon him like a raging storm.
Dialogue/c4battle59_end_01: How does it feel to be betrayed and cut down by your own brothers?
Dialogue/c4battle59_end_02: I can feel your souls crumbling and your minds lost in despair. It is so easy to break you.
Dialogue/c4battle59_end_03_a: Illusions and lies! He seeks to battle our minds!
Dialogue/c4battle59_end_03_b: These are not our kin but foul conjurations sent to unnerve us.
Dialogue/c4battle59_end_04_a: His imprudent hubris will be his downfall, for his prolonged taunts allowed me to find his trace in the Empyrean!
Dialogue/c4battle59_end_04_b: We will come for him and we will end his schemes with vengeful fury!
Dialogue/c4battle59_start_01: There are the Blei-deòradi! They brought the doom to our home!
Dialogue/c4battle59_start_02: Guardians of Saim-Hann, stand down! We are not the enemy!
Dialogue/c4battle59_start_03: Show them how the true Serpent strikes!
Dialogue/c4battle59_start_04_a: No, they cannot conceivably attack us! We are their Kin!
Dialogue/c4battle59_start_04_b: In exile or not, I have spent my life protecting Saim-Hann. For them to turn upon us now, of all times, why?
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_01: What a terrible foe to face. My soul is still trembling from the terrors that monster brought upon us.
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_02: You fought well Calandis. Rest assured that we have overcome their treacherous machinations.
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_03_a: My deeds pale against your efforts, Eldryon. Several times your wisdom and powers averted our ensured demise.
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_03_b: How are you faring amidst these horrible trials?
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_04_a: My soul reels from the endeavours, as your senses must tell you. My mind and body are drained by my efforts to control the Empyrean.
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_04_b: I long to find sanctuary within the Dome of Crystal Seers.
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_05_a: However, the urgency of the moment leaves no time for rest. Too much is at stake!
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_05_b: I must press on until the safety of Saim-Hann is restored again.
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_06_a: Then let us reunite with our warhost and end this dreaded Invasion!
Dialogue/c4battle60_end_06_b: Forward, Wild Riders of Saim-Hann, Victory is in our grasp!
Dialogue/c4battle60_start_01_a: The tale of Aeldari foresight is a myth. You’re as predictable as any other species.
Dialogue/c4battle60_start_01_b: You call yourself seers and leaders, but yet you simply walk up here to be culled like worthless weeds.
Dialogue/c4battle60_start_02_a: Enough of this. Let us end this monster with haste.
Dialogue/c4battle60_start_02_b: Wild Host, ride forth to glory and to vengeance!
Dialogue/c4battle60_start_03: Pathetic. Witness the Changer of Ways' true power, xenos!
Dialogue/c4battle61_end_01_b: A psychic power grid that runs through each craftworld's wraithbone core. From here, the spirits of the fallen Aeldari can still be engaged with by their kin, and so live on as ghostly echoes, safe from She Who Thirsts, in a twilight existence that allows them to watch over the living.
Dialogue/c4battle61_start_01_a: The machinations of the Thousand Sons are still no clearer to me...
Dialogue/c4battle61_start_01_b: What do they seek to gain from all this?
Dialogue/c4battle61_start_02_a: The target of their dark ambition may be within the souls of our fallen...
Dialogue/c4battle61_start_02_b: They may seek the Infinity Circuit.
Dialogue/c4battle61_start_03_a: Such a transgression cannot be allowed to pass.
Dialogue/c4battle61_start_03_b: We will stop at nothing to vanquish every last trace of them before they reach the Infinity Circuit.
Dialogue/c4battle61_start_04_a: It is paramount that we liberate the Seer Council.
Dialogue/c4battle61_start_04_b: Only in unity with them can we reveal the truth of their duplicitous intentions.
Dialogue/c4battle62_end_01_a: Are we too late? The depths of depravity these daemons will sink to is never ending.
Dialogue/c4battle62_end_01_b: Guardians, aid the wounded council. Eldryon, assist them.
Dialogue/c4battle62_end_02_a: We did all that was in our might!
Dialogue/c4battle62_end_02_b: The Seer Council endured and overcame the onslaught. Saim-Hann did not fall today!
Dialogue/c4battle62_start_01: The foul warp abominations that besiege our Seer Council are in my sights.
Dialogue/c4battle62_start_02: Such suffering, each loss more tragic than the last...
Dialogue/c4battle62_start_03_a: Guardians, drive these miserable warpspawn into the plaza!
Dialogue/c4battle62_start_03_b: Wild Riders, bring the swift fury of Khaine upon them!
Dialogue/c4battle62_start_04_a: Eldryon, Calandis, we have our purpose!
Dialogue/c4battle62_start_04_b: Make for the Seer Council, scythe down all who stand before us.
Dialogue/c4battle63_end_01_a: Aethana, do not allow vengeance to overcome you...do not lose sight of your path.
Dialogue/c4battle63_end_01_b: We need your experienced command to eradicate this foe!
Dialogue/c4battle63_end_02_a: The endless terror we have to witness obscures all other emotions.
Dialogue/c4battle63_end_02_b: Yet this anger will not overcome us. We will channel it to fuel our strength!
Dialogue/c4battle63_end_03: They shall witness our burning fury, swiftly and without remorse.
Dialogue/c4battle63_start_01_a: The Seer Council is weakened, but they will commune with the Infinity Circuit.
Dialogue/c4battle63_start_01_b: With the guidance of our ancestor's spirits they may trace the Thousand Sons' true agenda from the skeins of fate.
Dialogue/c4battle63_start_02_a: May their efforts yield purpose, Farseer. For time is of the essence.
Dialogue/c4battle63_start_02_b: I will hunt down the remaining abominations. None shall be allowed to obstruct the Seer Council further!
Dialogue/c4battle63_start_03: My fury shall be as the stars themselves, each and every warpspawn shall be found wanting before my wrath.
Dialogue/c4battle64_end_01_b: Have we been played for fools? Our efforts in vain, each victory just distractions in the larger war?
Dialogue/c4battle64_end_02_a: I wield weapons and armies capable of laying low entire planets.
Dialogue/c4battle64_end_02_b: Yet I have failed to defend the heart of our Craftworld...
Dialogue/c4battle64_end_03: Am I truly fit to walk the Path of Command...?
Dialogue/c4battle64_start_01_a: The enemy's plan is revealed to me, my kin.
Dialogue/c4battle64_start_01_b: It is as we feared, the Thousand Sons covet our Infinity Circuit.
Dialogue/c4battle64_start_02: They seek to extort the knowledge of our ancestors with their twisted sorcery.
Dialogue/c4battle64_start_03: How is this possible? They are not Aeldari!
Dialogue/c4battle64_start_04_a: I do not know. But the Infinity Circuit is suffering from the daemonic powers used for this perverse interrogation.
Dialogue/c4battle64_start_04_b: The Seer Council has been unable to ascertain the source of the enemy's actions.
Dialogue/c4battle64_start_05: Ambush! More warpspawn are converging upon us!
Dialogue/c4battle65_end_01_a: Eldryon. Calandis. I am grateful for your steadfast council.
Dialogue/c4battle65_end_01_b: I wish our path were a brighter one, but I am glad that we walk together.
Dialogue/c4battle65_start_01_a: There is no other Aeldari I'd follow into battle against such a foe, Aethana.
Dialogue/c4battle65_start_01_b: To give into doubt's black heart now is victory for the great enemy.
Dialogue/c4battle65_start_02_b: We have fallen prey to the foul machinations of the Great Conspirator, but the fate of this war has yet to be decided.
Dialogue/c4battle65_start_03_a: You are as wise and right as always, Farseer.
Dialogue/c4battle65_start_03_b: Let's us mete out our unrestrained vengeance upon these abominations.
Dialogue/c4battle66_end_01: These crystalline growths... To see Wraithbone mutilated like this...
Dialogue/c4battle66_end_02: Remain vigilant, Calandis. This corruption is perilous indeed.
Dialogue/c4battle66_start_01_a: A portion of the Craftworld has been severed from the Infinity Circuit.
Dialogue/c4battle66_start_01_b: We must purge the corruption, lest more precious Aeldari souls be lost to She Who Thirsts...
Dialogue/c4battle66_start_02: The Serpent will strike, wherever the Seer Council demands!
Dialogue/c4battle67_end_01_b: The veil is thin here. Do not hesitate to end me, should the Empyrean's grip overwhelm me.
Dialogue/c4battle67_end_02_a: You shall not yield to it in this final moment, Farseer!
Dialogue/c4battle67_end_02_b: This stands as your Autarch's direct command!
Dialogue/c4battle67_start_01_a: The Craftworld's suffering is truly dire this day.
Dialogue/c4battle67_start_01_b: I must chart a course through fate to ascertain the foe's next move. Please, give me all the time you can.
Dialogue/c4battle67_start_02: Rest assured, no daemon spawn will be spared our blades until you can guide us, Farseer.
Dialogue/c4battle68_end_01_a: I will see my blade, slick with the sorcerer's blood for this.
Dialogue/c4battle68_end_01_b: You have my word. Such atrocity cannot go unheeded.
Dialogue/c4battle68_end_02_a: Ahriman follows a preposterous quest to access the Black Library.
Dialogue/c4battle68_end_02_b: As long as we draw breath, it is a fool's errand. He will not gain the forbidden knowledge he seeks.
Dialogue/c4battle68_end_03_b: Within the labyrinthine depths of the Webway, shrouded in veils of mystery, lies the fabled Black Library. A repository of ancient knowledge, it houses the forbidden texts and secrets about the realms of Chaos and beyond. Guarded by the enigmatic Harlequins, it eludes the grasp of Ahriman... for now.
Dialogue/c4battle68_start_01: This foul perversion of the Warp...
Dialogue/c4battle68_start_03_a: These vile invaders seek to access our ancestor's souls and harbour their collective knowledge...
Dialogue/c4battle68_start_03_b: But to what end is still unclear...
Dialogue/c4battle68_start_04_a: Wait, I can but make out a single name, amongst the terror and agony of our fallen kin...
Dialogue/c4battle68_start_04_b: Repeated in a desecrated chorus: Ahriman.
Dialogue/c4battle68_start_05_a: The Arch-Sorcerer must be aboard the Craftworld. He is behind these heinous acts.
Dialogue/c4battle68_start_05_b: His actions shrouded in a sanctum inside the Warpflame barrier!
Dialogue/c4battle68_start_06: Beware! More Daemons are pouring out of the Empyrean!
Dialogue/c4battle69_end_01_a: A treacherous path, but one I fear we must walk.
Dialogue/c4battle69_end_01_b: ...Unless we instead aid the Seer Council in hastening the Barrier's collapse?
Dialogue/c4battle69_end_02_b: Once the barrier is no-more, the Warhost shall join us and end the miserable Sorcerer's existence.
Dialogue/c4battle69_end_03: A prize I will gladly give my soul for, to save Saim-hann.
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_01_a: How do we foil this Warpflame Barrier?
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_01_b: It prevents us from annihilating this Sorcerer and ridding the galaxy of his stain forever more...
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_02: The Seer Council is concentrating their efforts to undo the barrier, but they need more time.
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_03_a: I must find Ahriman's sanctum. His ritual must be thwarted.
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_03_b: Once I locate him, we must bring the full force of the Craftworld upon him and swiftly.
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_04_a: We can traverse the Webway - lost paths reveal themselves to me...
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_04_b: Though if the Sorcerer has learnt of them, they too will be rife with danger...
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_05_b: There is every chance we find ourselves overrun by Daemons or forever lost to a long forgotten path of the Webway... But we have no choice.
Dialogue/c4battle69_start_06_a: Then our decision is made, let us make haste.
Dialogue/c4battle70_end_01_a: A brief respite from this madness.
Dialogue/c4battle70_end_01_b: Calandis, are you familiar with this wayward path?
Dialogue/c4battle70_end_02_b: My steps will act as your steadfast beacon in the roiling turmoil.
Dialogue/c4battle70_end_03_a: Then our fate rests with you, Outcast.
Dialogue/c4battle70_end_03_b: Onwards, my kin! The Sorcerer shall not foresee the Serpent's strike!
Dialogue/c4battle70_start_01_a: The entrance to the Webway is just ahead.
Dialogue/c4battle70_start_01_b: Yet the enemy appears to react to us, have they foreseen our plans?
Dialogue/c4battle70_start_02_a: I am loathe to say it, but we confront one of the most powerful sorcerers in the galaxy.
Dialogue/c4battle70_start_02_b: His mastery of divination is exceptional... for a Mon-keigh.
Dialogue/c4battle70_start_03: It will be difficult to outmaneuver him.
Dialogue/c4battle71_end_01_a: We have arrived at the Sanctum.
Dialogue/c4battle71_end_01_b: Eldyron, guide us to the Sorcerer so that we may end his life.
Dialogue/c4battle71_start_01_b: At their zenith there was no limit to the Aeldari's power. Knowing no more bounds, they descended into unthinkable depravity of such enormity, that a new Chaos God formed in the Empyrean. The birth of Slaanesh was so violent, it wiped out the Aeldari empire in an instant and devastated the galaxy along with the ambitions of many younger races.
Dialogue/c4battle71_start_02_a: This path is a disquieting one to tread.
Dialogue/c4battle71_start_02_b: These fragments of our bygone glory appear like a dark reflection of a future in which we have failed...
Dialogue/c4battle71_start_03_a: Be careful, Eldryon! We must focus on our every step!
Dialogue/c4battle71_start_03_b: Follow the path as I have, and meticulously, any deviation could see you lost.
Dialogue/c4battle71_start_04: More Daemons! They will not hold us back!
Dialogue/c4battle72_end_01_b: He has foreseen all of this?
Dialogue/c4battle72_end_02: Pay him no heed, Outcast. His sorcery will soon be no more.
Dialogue/c4battle72_end_03: You cannot possibly understand what work takes place here.
Dialogue/c4battle72_start_02: Nevermind, my brothers will delay you.
Dialogue/c4battle73_end_01: Misguided. You already waste what little time you have.
Dialogue/c4battle73_end_02: No actions you take will undermine me here.
Dialogue/c4battle73_start_01_a: Ahriman seeks to delay us with foul illusions, but they are nothing I cannot perceive.
Dialogue/c4battle73_start_01_b: Still, be on your guard. Daemons hide within these falsehoods!
Dialogue/c4battle73_start_02: Then we shall vanquish them like all the foul spawn before.
Dialogue/c4battle73_start_03_b: I vow to you, as sister of the Wild Host, that no foe shall be hidden from my sight or escape my wrath.
Dialogue/c4battle73_start_04_b: With bonded blood, we shall ensure Saim-Hann's survival. Both the living and the dead!
Dialogue/c4battle74_end_01: While this is not the Rhana Dandra, we shall strike a vicious blow against the Great Enemy this day!
Dialogue/c4battle74_end_02_b: The Aeldari prophecy of the End Times foretells the ultimate cataclysm that will consume the galaxy and Empyrean alike. It speaks of the final battle between Chaos and the remaining Aeldari, where gods clash, worlds shatter, and the fate of all races will be decided.
Dialogue/c4battle74_start_01_a: You have guided us well, Calandis. The Sorcerer is ahead.
Dialogue/c4battle74_start_01_b: Only a scant few of his followers remain before us.
Dialogue/c4battle74_start_02: They shall fall like all the others. Vengeance will be ours!
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_01_a: I have obtained all I needed, Xenos.
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_01_b: May your pitiful race continue to dwindle into nothingness.
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_02: He... has fled. How could he escape our vengeance?
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_03_a: The Architect of Fate is ever duplicitous...
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_03_b: The depths of their madness are beyond comprehension.
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_05: The Seer Council sends word that the other remaining forces have fled, the Daemonic incursions have ceased.
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_06: Yet we cannot falter, to heal from the tragedy and desecration will be no small task.
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_07_a: Calandis, you have faced this horror alongside Saim-Hann. I and our kin, thank you.
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_07_b: Should you wish to tread a different path, know that the Outcast is not the only one available to you.
Dialogue/c4battle75_end_08_b: While my return was only at the behest of great suffering, I am glad to be one with the Craftworld once again.
Dialogue/c4battle75_start_01_a: Well then. Attack, if you must.
Dialogue/c4battle75_start_01_b: It does not matter either way. You are but gnats before me.
Dialogue/c4battle75_start_02_a: Why, sorcerer? What prize warrants this horrendous devastation?
Dialogue/c4battle75_start_02_b: Your forces lie shattered to our feet, dying in vain for what delusionary ambition?
Dialogue/c4battle75_start_03_a: Knowledge. A future free of the ignorance that this galaxy is riddled with.
Dialogue/c4battle75_start_03_b: Surely you of all the ill fortuned races should understand this?
Dialogue/c4battle75_start_04_a: I tire of barbed words and madness.
Dialogue/c4battle75_start_04_b: Face us, Sorcerer so that I may rend your soul myself.
Dialogue/ce1battle01_start_01_b: Many forge worlds have existed for tens of millennia, bound together by layers of religious fealty and contracts of technological trade. The majority of a Forge World's solid ground surface is covered in thousands of years of built-up, massive industrial complexes, while the rest of the planet is reduced to exploited, barren landscapes or toxic wastelands. Nothing can match the quality and quantity of a forge world's industrial output and as such they are highly guarded strategic assets and often a primary target for enemy operations.
Dialogue/ce1battle01_start_02: My revered brothers, the plan worked. The frothing hordes of the World Eaters have caused an ample distraction.
Dialogue/ce1battle01_start_03: A blessed message, brother! The path to the northern forge structure is finally ripe for our onslaught.
Dialogue/ce1battle01_start_04: Oh, how I am looking forward to witnessing our master's gifts bring silence to this world.
Dialogue/ce1battle04_start_01: My brothers, we are detecting movement by the Mechanicus wretches to reinforce their command post.
Dialogue/ce1battle04_start_02: Let us greet them with our finest gifts.
Dialogue/ce1battle06_end_01_b: Once forcibly indentured labourers or else vat-grown in mass flesh farms, Skitarii serve their forge world zealously loyal and fanatically devoted to the Cult Mechanicus. Their masters refashion their bodies as needed, replacing fallible flesh with titanium servo-motors and bionic musculature, and define protocols and parameters for their engagements. Though they are not mindless automatons. Experienced Skitarii Marshals can conduct independent operations while Sicarian Ruststalkers hunt as sinister gladiatorial assassins.
Dialogue/ce1battle06_start_01: There is the Marshal that organizes their forward defenses, my brothers.
Dialogue/ce1battle06_start_02: He looks so fragile. I wonder how far his pieces will fly when he bursts apart.
Dialogue/ce1battle07_start_01: This canyon will be the best vector for our advance. It leads us into the belly of their aching machine.
Dialogue/ce1battle11_end_01_b: Tech-Priests declaim the hand of the Machine God in every aspect of Human technology, in the fundamental forces of the universe and in their own ability to comprehend such concepts. The Omnissiah is the Machine God made manifest, and the Adeptus Mechanicus believe the Emperor to be this manifestation, thus revering him not only as the Master of Mankind, but as an avatar of omniscience. Though there are subcults and factions with differing interpretations and doubts, casting an ever-present shadow of potential schism.
Dialogue/ce1battle12_start_01: My revered brothers, their planetary defense cannons are still hindering our fleet from proceeding.
Dialogue/ce1battle12_start_03: Have faith, brother. We have reached the northern forge. Their defenses will be given their long deserved final rest.
Dialogue/ce1battle17_end_01_b: The faith of the Cult Mechanicus is founded on dogma and rote, repeated maniacally without change over more than ten thousand years, while true understanding of many of their practices has long since vanished under a smothering blanket of ritual and half-remembered mummery. Priests soothe the intractable machine spirits of cogitators, reignite the fiery hearts of recalcitrant generatoria and forge the material used by the Imperium’s armies as much with sprays of holy incense and binharic chants as with technical skill.
Dialogue/ce1battle17_start_01: Thus we invoke the Master of All Knowledge.
Dialogue/ce1battle17_start_03: Shed your powers upon this machine.
Dialogue/ce1battle17_start_05: Invest this device with your holy charge. *sprinkles the unguents*
Dialogue/ce1battle17_start_07: Unspeakable! Defend the divine work! Eradicate the heretics!
Dialogue/ce1battle19_start_01: My brothers, our forces have broken through another section, close to your position.
Dialogue/ce1battle19_start_02: But the servants of the false emperor insist on resisting heavily.
Dialogue/ce1battle19_start_03: We will flank them and show them how futile it is to resist the true god.
Dialogue/ce1battle22_end_01_b: As acts of worship, Tech-Priests routinely replace what they see as fallible flesh with bizarre mechanical augmentation, seeing it as a way to move closer to the Machine God, and toward perfection. Tech-Priests also create the Servitors that perform a plethora of mundane or dangerous tasks throughout the Imperium. These are vat-grown, criminal, or just unlucky Humans, that are chemically and surgically lobotomized and melded with simple bionics to produce living tools, void of any memory or personality, that fulfill a single purpose for the rest of their existence.
Dialogue/ce1battle22_start_02: We found their commanding priest, brothers. But I do not understand his pleas.
Dialogue/ce1battle22_start_03: Be assured that he wishes for us to end the last remnants of his frail flesh.
Dialogue/ce1battle23_start_01: Grandfather Nurgle smiles on us today, brothers. Your glorious advance silenced their cannons.
Dialogue/ce1battle23_start_02: Yet our forces are reporting that the servants of the corpse emperor are falling back to the wastelands.
Dialogue/ce1battle23_start_03: Curious, what do they seek to defend there?
Dialogue/ce1battle26_start_01_a: It seems we found a hidden complex!
Dialogue/ce1battle26_start_01_b: Let us bring it down with magnificent decay!
Dialogue/ce1battle30_end_01: This inconvenience will cost you tenfold, abominable heretics!
Dialogue/ce1battle30_end_02: You have invoked the Machine God's wrath and he will cleanse your disgusting stain from this world with its full might!
Dialogue/ce1battle30_end_03_a: Hollow words from a hollow mind. This world will be brought low and grow into a bountiful garden of Nurgle!
Dialogue/ce1battle30_end_03_b: And it will receive its long deserved silence.
Dialogue/ce1battle30_start_01_b: Archmagos Dominus Belisarius Cawl was already old at the birth of the Imperium and served the Machine God in many roles, both known and unknown to his peers. It is rightfully said that he has forgotten more knowledge than all but the most studious adepts could ever hope to learn. Cawl remains a tech-savant, a genius at the forefront of whatever field he trains his brilliant mind upon. But it is in his role as Magos Biologis that Cawl’s greatest mastery lies - for example it was he who brought forth the Primaris Space Marines.
Dialogue/ce1battle30_start_02: Foul Heretics! This interruption here is improbable but fully intolerable and insufferable.
Dialogue/ce1battle30_start_03: Further delay of the Machine God's work cannot be accepted. Commencing purge solution.
Dialogue/ce1battle30_start_04: For the legion, for the Primarch, for Nurgle, we also shall end this futile work!
Dialogue/ce1cbattle01_end_01_b: The Red Planet is the foundation stone of the Adeptus Mechanicus, and is vaunted as one of the holiest of all celestial orbs by its adherents, second only to Terra itself. Mars’ arrogant Tech-Priests see themselves as the most blessed of the Machine God’s followers, to which all others must pay an exacting measure of respect – and resources. Surrounding Mars’ equator and incorporating the moon of Phobos is the Ring of Iron, most notable for the huge warships built along its length in gigantic suspended docks.
Dialogue/ce1cbattle02_end_01_b: The Collegia Titanica sets the ground trembling with the strides of their God-Engines, which can level whole city blocks with a single, apocalyptic salvo. Titans are the supreme fighting machines of the Imperium. They are metal giants, protected by fields of almost impenetrable energy, crewed by devoted warriors and armed with the mightiest weapons Imperial Tech-Priests can devise. Through the Imperium and beyond nothing inspires the same kind of awe and fear.
Dialogue/ce1cbattle03_end_01_b: In their pursuit of knowledge and technology, the Adeptus Mechanicus and their legions of cyborg servants launch holy fleets to explore the frontiers of the Imperium. Led by Tech-Priests steeped in all manner of arcane expertise, the acquisition of archeo-tech, biological specimens, rarefied resources, ancient lore or the merest rumours of a STC fragment is pursued with the determination of the truly fanatical.
Dialogue/ce2battle01_end_01: Tyranid bioforms. This is a bad omen.
Dialogue/ce2battle01_end_02: How? There is no hive fleet in orbit.
Dialogue/ce2battle01_end_03: It matters not in this moment. We have a mission. Go.
Dialogue/ce2battle01_start_01_b: The first warning that most worlds have of the Tyranids’ approach is the Shadow in the Warp. Settling like a colossal and terrible pall across countless worlds, it heralds the coming of the Tyranid hive fleets. It is a nightmarish phenomenon that has proved a cripplingly effective weapon against many of the galaxy’s sentient races.
Dialogue/ce2battle01_start_02_b: Its nullifying psychic static chokes astropathic communication, spreading paranoia and fear amongst the prey and leaving worlds isolated in the face of the swarm. Psykers are the worst affected, for their strange senses are far more susceptible to this insidious assault.
Dialogue/ce2battle01_start_03: This is Lieutenant Titus. Strike squad Ultor made planet fall. Proceeding to forward base. Any update?
