Dialogue/ce2battle01_start_04: Affirmative, Ultor. No readings from the forward base or the Apothecary Biologis. Vox is dead.
Dialogue/ce2battle01_start_05: Still no astropathic contact in the whole sector. Proceed with caution!
Dialogue/ce2battle03_end_03: Our base was overrun by these xenos. And wherever we go, all commanders or vox relays are dead!
Dialogue/ce2battle03_end_04_a: A monster is hunting the officers, some said.
Dialogue/ce2battle03_end_04_b: Clearly the ramblings of panicked minds!
Dialogue/ce2battle03_start_01: Protect the vox, we have to get a message through.
Dialogue/ce2battle03_start_02: There are too many! Throne, where did they come from?
Dialogue/ce2battle04_start_01: Ultor. A Blood Angels detachment arrived and transmitted this message. Relaying it now.
Dialogue/ce2battle04_start_02: To all Imperial Forces: We have tracked a Tyranid fleet on route to your system and are rerouting forces to pursue it.
Dialogue/ce2battle04_start_03: We have dispatched a rapid strike group to bolster your defenses until our main fleet arrives to slay the beast in orbit.
Dialogue/ce2battle04_start_04: Hold fast! Give no inch to the vile Xenos, for this is the place where we vanquish it into oblivion!
Dialogue/ce2battle04_start_05_a: I want to pity the beast that is hunted by the Lord Regent himself.
Dialogue/ce2battle04_start_05_b: These Tyranids, though, deserve every last ounce of his wrath!
Dialogue/ce2battle05_start_01: These Tyranids must have been dormant here and are now stirred up by the approaching hive fleet.
Dialogue/ce2battle05_start_02: Persistent creatures! Let us root them out for good!
Dialogue/ce2battle06_end_01_b: The first blows struck by invading Tyranids come from unexpected quarters. Vanguard organisms that have infiltrated the planet, like Genestealers, Lictors or in rare cases even a Deathleaper, erupt suddenly from hiding to eviscerate the personnel of defence emplacements or command facilities.
Dialogue/ce2battle06_end_02_b: Guided by cunning instinct and the tendrils of the Hive Mind, the Tyranid invaders bring horror to the prey world. Hive ships slide from the darkness like oceanic predators rising to feed, disgorging untold trillions of warrior organisms to begin the hunt.
Dialogue/ce2battle06_start_01: Lictor! This is the beast that hunts the officers!
Dialogue/ce2battle06_start_02: This is no mere Lictor. Stay away from the bushes!
Dialogue/ce2battle07_end_01: By the Emperor... watch the skies! Xenos spores blot out the sun!
Dialogue/ce2battle07_end_02: Do not falter, brother. Our duty prevails.
Dialogue/ce2battle07_start_01: Ultor, come in! The hive fleet has arrived.
Dialogue/ce2battle07_start_02: We are coordinating efforts with the Blood Angels strike force. Stay vigilant!
Dialogue/ce2battle08_start_01: Lieutenant Titus, come in. We face planet wide invasion.
Dialogue/ce2battle08_start_02: Imperial bases are attacked on all fronts. What are your orders?
Dialogue/ce2battle08_start_03_b: You heard the Lord Regent, give no inch to the Xenos, for its end is imminent.
Dialogue/ce2battle08_start_04_a: Bolster the defenses wherever you can. Make every life count!
Dialogue/ce2battle08_start_04_b: I will continue Ultor's mission, for obtaining the sample is crucial for the war.
Dialogue/ce2battle10_start_01: To all forces! We need reinforcements!
Dialogue/ce2battle10_start_02: We must have slain thousands but there is no end of them!
Dialogue/ce2battle10_start_03: Negative! We are getting overrun here, we can spare no soldiers!
Dialogue/ce2battle10_start_04: We cannot delay our mission further, brothers. We have to move on.
Dialogue/ce2battle11_end_01_b: Amidst the harrowing spectacle that is a Tyranid attack, there is an insidious pattern to be observed: The first waves consist of chitinous tides of Termagants and Hormagaunts flinging themselves at the enemy’s defences. This allows the Hive Mind to corral the prey, to exhaust their ammunition and spirit, and to test where their defences are staunchest.
Dialogue/ce2battle11_end_02_b: The nature of the next invasion swarm adapts depending on the resistance the Hive Mind has met. Whether it is tunnelling horrors, a crusher stampede of giant armoured monsters, venom-spouting tentacled creatures or waves of agile flying beasts darkening the skies, the Hive Mind breeds and fields the right counter to the enemy's defences with terrifying intellect.
Dialogue/ce2battle11_start_02: It seems we killed enough to be deemed a primary threat.
Dialogue/ce2battle11_start_03: Good! Let them send all their foul creations, for we will vanquish them all and stall their advance.
Dialogue/ce2battle11_start_04_a: Be careful what you wish for, sergeant.
Dialogue/ce2battle11_start_04_b: Slay their warrior beasts, or else we get overrun!
Dialogue/ce2battle12_start_01: Ultor, come in! We have found new records of the Apothecary Biologis in the remains of an outpost.
Dialogue/ce2battle12_start_03: You have my thanks, brothers. What is your status?
Dialogue/ce2battle12_start_04: Guard losses are substantial, but we still hold all vital positions. The local corps of sanctioned Psykers was a powerful defensive asset.
Dialogue/ce2battle12_start_05: The attacks have ebbed down. It is strangely quiet now.
Dialogue/ce2battle12_start_06: They prepare the next wave. Support the psykers! They will be a prime target!
Dialogue/ce2battle15_start_01: This is Strike Team Ultor. Approaching the last known position of the Apothecary Biologis. Status update?
Dialogue/ce2battle15_start_03: I repeat. This is strike team Ultor. Status update!
Dialogue/ce2battle15_start_05: Emperor protect. What has hit them?
Dialogue/ce2battle17_end_01_b: Some Tyranids serve as synaptic conduits or nodal relays through which a portion of the Hive Mind’s iron will flows, overriding the natural instincts of the swarm to direct the teeming warrior-beasts to function as a single, gestalt organism on the battlefield.
Dialogue/ce2battle17_end_02_b: Some of the Synapse beasts even wield highly developed psychic capabilities, allowing the Hive Mind to bring down foes who seek to fight a more metaphysical war.
Dialogue/ce2battle17_start_01: Brothers! The vile xenos surrounds us!
Dialogue/ce2battle17_start_02: The auspex are clear, Bellator. There is no enemy!
Dialogue/ce2battle17_start_03: No, I can feel… the enemy! It is inside my mind!
Dialogue/ce2battle17_start_04: Sergeant Bellator! Focus on my voice! You are under psychic attack.
Dialogue/ce2battle17_start_05_a: You are steel! You are the Emperor's wrath! You are his light against the darkness.
Dialogue/ce2battle17_start_05_b: You will prevail! This is an order!
Dialogue/ce2battle17_start_06_a: Aaarrrrghhhh! Get out of my head!
Dialogue/ce2battle17_start_06_b: Vile Xenos! I will destroy this beast!
Dialogue/ce2battle18_start_01_a: The death of the Synapse creature sent the lesser beasts here into disarray.
Dialogue/ce2battle18_start_01_b: Push forward fast, before a new monster takes control.
Dialogue/ce2battle20_start_01: To all forces: Fall back to the hive city. We will shatter their onslaught from its walls!
Dialogue/ce2battle20_start_02: I repeat! Fall back immediately! We need every last man and woman defending the city!
Dialogue/ce2battle20_start_03_a: By the Emperor, look at the horizon!
Dialogue/ce2battle20_start_03_b: Foul Xenos structures emerge already. They start feeding.
Dialogue/ce2battle21_start_01: To anybody that can hear me! Help! Help us! They eat us from the inside!
Dialogue/ce2battle21_start_02: I can feel it in my belly already! Help!
Dialogue/ce2battle21_start_03: Faster! We need to reach the samples before the swarm consumes everything!
Dialogue/ce2battle22_end_01_b: With the prey world’s fortifications toppled and its defenders reeling, the Tyranids begin their gruesome feast. Assimilation Swarms hunt down enduring pockets of resistance to devour, their advance preceded by carpets of Rippers that engulf the wounded and dead of alike.
Dialogue/ce2battle22_end_02_b: Microscopic spores transform the biosphere of the planet, starting to dissolve all planetary life together with dead Tyranid bodies into raw biomass ready to be devoured. Biological gruel flows up fat feeding tubes to replenish the waiting hive ships, who suckle at the world like fat ticks until nothing remains but a lifeless orb to be left hanging, cold and dead in the void.
Dialogue/ce2battle22_start_01_a: There is the Apothecary Biologis and his squad.
Dialogue/ce2battle22_start_01_b: By the Emperor, all slain by the ravenous Xenos!
Dialogue/ce2battle22_start_02_a: They did their duty in the name of the Emperor.
Dialogue/ce2battle22_start_02_b: Protect me! I have to obtain their gene seeds and the samples.
Dialogue/ce2battle23_start_01: We have the samples. But we might lose the planet before we can get them out. How shall we proceed?
Dialogue/ce2battle23_start_02_b: This might slow the swarm down enough until the liberator fleet arrives.
Dialogue/ce2battle23_start_05_a: We access Imperial bases and retrieve the data logs from their auger arrays.
Dialogue/ce2battle23_start_05_b: We may be able to locate the creature via its movement patterns.
Dialogue/ce2battle25_start_01: Here. Tyrant Guard sightings. We have a location.
Dialogue/ce2battle27_start_01: Is there no end to their numbers?!
Dialogue/ce2battle27_start_02: We are getting close. Keep a low profile!
Dialogue/ce2battle30_end_01: Well fought brothers! You gave this world a chance.
Dialogue/ce2battle30_end_02_a: Though it is not over yet.
Dialogue/ce2battle30_end_02_b: The enemy reels, but we have to hold out until its executioner arrives.
Dialogue/ce2battle30_end_03: Whilst we draw breath, we stand!
Dialogue/ce2battle30_start_01_b: The influence of the Hive Mind stretches across battlefields, worlds and even the vastness of the void itself. Wherever the grotesque bio-ships of the hive fleets swarm to attack, the presence of the Hive Mind moves with them and allows them to hunt and fight with supernatural synchronicity.
Dialogue/ce2battle30_start_02_b: The Hive Mind is as far beyond the understanding of the galaxy’s sentient races as they are beyond the comprehension of the cattle they farm and butcher. This – it seems – is all that biological life represents to the Hive Mind; not equals to be communicated with, but simple prey to be found and then devoured.
Dialogue/ce2battle30_start_03: There is the beast! Let us bring it down!
Dialogue/ce2cbattle01_end_01_b: Behemoth, Kraken, Leviathan - Aptly named by scholars like mythical monsters, each hive fleet displays different colouration and uses distinctive hunting patterns and strategies, almost as though each were an attempt by the Hive Mind to refine different methods of predating the galaxy’s sentient life forms.
Dialogue/ce2cbattle01_end_02_b: Should a tendril of a hive fleet be shattered, its survivors become splinter fleets – lesser echoes of the former threat, small enough to slip away into the void and regather their strength. In time, a splinter fleet will attack again, having devoured enough biomass to replenish its ranks, and often benefitting from the lessons of its primogenitors’ defeat.
Dialogue/ce2cbattle02_end_01_b: Every warrior organism is fashioned by the ineffable alien will of the Hive Mind. Their flesh and chitin is endlessly mutable, honed into whatever form will prove most lethal to their prey.
Dialogue/ce2cbattle02_end_02_b: The utterly alien nature and rapid adaptability of this organic technology is more than a match for even the most advanced prey races. It allows the Tyranids to drag their victims into a feverish arms race in which most prey are ill-equipped to keep pace, and that soon sees them outmatched, outmanoeuvred and fatally outnumbered.
Dialogue/ce2cbattle03_end_01_b: Tyranid guns, blades, transport craft, even their void ships—are all living beings. Their equipment often takes the form of grotesque symbiotes grafted to their host creature for use in battle. The ammunition fired by Tyranid weapons is similarly organic, be it voracious chitin-armoured beetles, gouts of concentrated acids or eruptions of bioelectricity.
Dialogue/ce2cbattle03_end_02_b: Clad in chitinous plates, chameleonic abilities or veiling clouds of spores and armed with a panoply of horror - from blades that gnaw the flesh of their victims, weaponised parasites to tailored toxins - the Tyranids display an infinite capacity for turning the mechanisms of life to the task of spreading death.
Dialogue/ce3battle01_end_01: These miners dare rise up against the Emperor! Heresy!
Dialogue/ce3battle01_start_01_b: The T'au Empire's greatest strength is its unifying philosophy – the T'au'va or Greater Good. They believe it is their duty and privilege to spread this creed to every corner and culture of this dark galaxy, and will let none stop them from bringing enlightenment to the stars.
Dialogue/ce3battle01_start_02_b: With very few exceptions, every T’au believes wholeheartedly in giving all that they have to the advancement of the Greater Good. So completely have the T’au absorbed its concept that it has come to shape their entire society, and even their physical and mental makeup. Guided by their Ethereal masters, they are divided into castes, each with its own strictly delineated responsibilities to the Empire.
Dialogue/ce3battle01_start_03: Rise brothers and sisters! Our time has come at last. It is our Day of Ascension!
Dialogue/ce3battle01_start_04_a: Rise against your oppressors and their False Emperor! Rise and show them that you will suffer no more!
Dialogue/ce3battle01_start_04_b: Rise! Rise and fight like you have never fought before!
Dialogue/ce3battle01_start_05: Rise! Rise! The Star Children will lead us to glory!
Dialogue/ce3battle02_start_01: Subjects of the Emperor! This is your last chance. Lay down your weapons or we... *shot*
Dialogue/ce3battle02_start_02: They have no power over us anymore. Forward!
Dialogue/ce3battle02_start_03: The Star Children are coming. I can feel it! The angels are close now!
Dialogue/ce3battle03_end_01_a: Xybia, I am sssorry to share worry in this glorious moment...
Dialogue/ce3battle03_end_01_b: ...but we have picked up the signaturesss of a fleet in our syssstem.
Dialogue/ce3battle03_end_03: I fear that is not the casssse...
Dialogue/ce3battle03_end_04: We are approaching the mining planet that refuses the T'au'va, Shas'o.
Dialogue/ce3battle03_end_05: Awaiting final report of the Water caste envoys.
Dialogue/ce3battle03_end_06: Proceed as planned. We follow protocol.
Dialogue/ce3battle03_start_01: We are facing planet wide insurrection! Stand your ground! The Emperor protects!
Dialogue/ce3battle03_start_02: We are getting overrun here. Fall back to the bastion. Fall back!
Dialogue/ce3battle04_end_01: You might hear rumours that T'au are here to support us. Heed not their lies!
Dialogue/ce3battle04_end_02: Hold fast and purge the xenos regardless in what form they come!
Dialogue/ce3battle04_end_03_a: For once I have to agree with the oppressors.
Dialogue/ce3battle04_end_03_b: We should greet these aliens with the orbital defences that our brothers and sisters have conquered!
Dialogue/ce3battle04_start_02_a: Another enemy has arrived to test our loyalty!
Dialogue/ce3battle04_start_02_b: Fear not, my brothers and sisters. It is but one final test of the Star Children.
Dialogue/ce3battle05_end_01: Perfect Mont'ka, Shas'o! Our forces have shattered the orbital defences and established footholds on the planet with minimal losses.
Dialogue/ce3battle05_end_02: Well done, Shas'vre. Establish perimeters and launch reconnaissance missions.
Dialogue/ce3battle05_end_03: We have to find out more about the ongoing conflict between the humans.
Dialogue/ce3battle05_start_01: Shas'o, all diplomatic efforts of the Water caste have failed.
Dialogue/ce3battle05_start_02: The humans remained stoically aggressive and in other places unusually evasive. They even fired on the envoy vessels.
Dialogue/ce3battle05_start_03: The humans also appear to be fighting among themselves.
Dialogue/ce3battle05_start_04: Misguided Gue'la. One day they will fully understand our purpose.
Dialogue/ce3battle05_start_05: Regrettably it is not today. Engage in orbit. Crisis teams, prepare for launch.
Dialogue/ce3battle06_end_02: These T'au are destroying all that we fight for! Have the angels deserted us?
Dialogue/ce3battle06_end_03: The angels will come, Xybia. Don't doubt your senses. We just have to hold out a bit longer!
Dialogue/ce3battle06_end_04_b: The battlesuit is emblematic of the T’au way of war and has near limitless martial applications. It embodies the philosophy of overcoming any challenge through the innovative application of superior technology. For those finest warriors of the Fire caste to whom it is granted, it is badge of honour and weapon of war both - it is the Hero's Mantle.
Dialogue/ce3battle06_end_05_b: A Fire Warrior has to rise to the ranks of Shas'ui or Shas'vre to gain the privilege of piloting a battlesuit. Meanwhile a Shas'o, a highly experienced military commander of the T'au Empire, can field especially advanced versions to battle. They are often organized as parts of Hunter Cadres, the dependable and adaptable mobile mainstay of most T’au deployments.
Dialogue/ce3battle06_start_01: The aliens brought battle walkers! They are decimating us here!
Dialogue/ce3battle06_start_02: Stay in cover! Send in more fighters and surround them!
Dialogue/ce3battle07_start_01: I have never seen such xenosss before. Might they have … usesss?
Dialogue/ce3battle07_start_02: That is secondary now! We must learn all we can about this new threat and strike back!
Dialogue/ce3battle07_start_03: Make sure you capture sssome of them alive!
Dialogue/ce3battle08_start_01: Small groups of Gue'la broke through our perimeters! They endanger our supply lines.
Dialogue/ce3battle08_start_02: According to bio-sign readings, some of these humans are abnormally strong.
Dialogue/ce3battle08_start_03: Increase drone surveillance. We will find these infiltrators and their leaders. For the Greater Good!
Dialogue/ce3battle10_end_01: Some of these Gue'la have three arms and other mutations.
Dialogue/ce3battle10_end_02: They fight with a savagery unlike those we have fought before!
Dialogue/ce3battle10_end_03: Stay calm, Shas'ui. Support is on the way.
Dialogue/ce3battle11_end_01_b: The T’au make extensive use of machine intelligences they call drones. Most drones consist of an armoured shell protecting an AI core. Anti-gravitic motors and jet-thrusters provide speed and agility, while additional systems specialise the drones for a large variety of battlefield roles.
Dialogue/ce3battle11_end_02_b: The markerlight is a data-beam projector and targeting system used to triangulate the foe’s location, so as to undermine their cover positions or guide remote-strike weaponry down upon them. So useful is this system that it has been adapted for handheld use but can also be mounted on drones, battlesuits and vehicles.
Dialogue/ce3battle11_start_02: Destroy them all! They will not stand in the way of our ascension!
Dialogue/ce3battle12_end_01: Hollan, stop with your experiments! We need everyone to force the Kroot back!
Dialogue/ce3battle12_end_02: ...alright. I'll tend to the wounded. Defeating the xenosss will be our gift to the Sstar Children.
Dialogue/ce3battle12_start_01: The mutated humans are still advancing, using non-standard guerrilla tactics. They are proving quite effective.
Dialogue/ce3battle12_start_02: I fear we have to re-evaluate our approach. Where is Darkstrider?
Dialogue/ce3battle12_start_03: Shas'o, it appears he has taken some Kroot auxiliaries and is already on the planet.
Dialogue/ce3battle12_start_04: Xybia! Judh! Kroot have destroyed several supply trucks! We are running out of ammunition here!
Dialogue/ce3battle14_end_01: Analysing the samples, the database confirms a genetic cross-match to "Tyranid" bioforms.
Dialogue/ce3battle14_end_02: That explains a lot. They are infected.
Dialogue/ce3battle14_start_01: The Kroot are successfully disrupting the human lines.
Dialogue/ce3battle14_start_02: I am sending some samples of these humans. Find out why they are so strong.
Dialogue/ce3battle14_start_03: Shas'el! Your successes aside, how often do I have to tell you to follow protocol?! You must not reroute troops without proper communication!
Dialogue/ce3battle14_start_04: They might be essential to other maneuvers! Can you not see how this can lead to disaster?!
Dialogue/ce3battle14_start_05: My sincere apology, Shas'O. I had to act quickly to not lose more of our warriors down here.
Dialogue/ce3battle14_start_06: My decisions were solely intended for the Greater Good.
Dialogue/ce3battle16_end_01: Something is off. They are focusing on delaying and pinning us.
Dialogue/ce3battle16_start_01: Our main weapons depot is under attack! We must defend it!
Dialogue/ce3battle17_end_01: They are like no Gue'la I have ever fought. I barely made it out.
Dialogue/ce3battle17_end_02: Get a med-pod ready for him!
Dialogue/ce3battle17_end_03: I am going down to the planet myself to guide our maneuvers.
Dialogue/ce3battle17_end_04: The situation demands a different approach.
Dialogue/ce3battle17_end_05_b: The T'au recognise that many aliens possess physical or mental abilities that allow them to serve the Greater Good in ways the T’au themselves cannot. It is for these reasons that the T’au make widespread use of alien species to supplement their armies, as well as many other arms of their civilisation.
Dialogue/ce3battle17_end_06_b: Most ubiquitous amongst all these alien auxiliaries are the Kroot, who are skilled trackers, infiltrators and wilderness fighters. They are experts in fieldcraft who swiftly master the perils and boons of each new ecosystem they encounter. When fighting for the T’au, the Kroot act as scouts, ambushers, skirmish screens, terror troops and counter-offensive close-combat reserves.
Dialogue/ce3battle17_start_01: They must be trying to distract us. Quick, fall back! I can sense another group outflanking us!
Dialogue/ce3battle18_end_01: Their walkers and drones took us by surprise with their stealth tech! We are taking heavy losses!
Dialogue/ce3battle18_end_02: Ambushes at multiple fronts. They have shifted tactics. Be careful!
Dialogue/ce3battle18_start_01: Take heart, sisters and brothers - the foe retreats. This is YOUR day, press the advantage!
Dialogue/ce3battle20_end_01: They always seem to be one step ahead!
Dialogue/ce3battle20_end_02: The multi-staged Kauyon you prepared proves to be very effective, Shas'o.
Dialogue/ce3battle20_end_03: But a core of their forces still remains.
Dialogue/ce3battle21_end_01: Shas'o, we just discovered a large underground complex.
Dialogue/ce3battle21_end_02: The infected humans are retreating to it after their severe losses.
Dialogue/ce3battle21_end_03: That must be their main hideout. We can end this with a swift Mont'ka before they regather their strength.
Dialogue/ce3battle21_start_01_a: Do not let the enemy dictate where to strike! It is time to turn their game around.
Dialogue/ce3battle21_start_01_b: Lure them into the depths. Fight on our ground!
Dialogue/ce3battle21_start_02: Isaak… the underground city will collapse under the heavy fighting.
Dialogue/ce3battle21_start_03: It is a sacrifice worth making.
Dialogue/ce3battle22_end_01: Shas'o? I have reestablished the link. Shas'o, please respond!
Dialogue/ce3battle22_end_02_b: Kauyon, which roughly translates as the patient hunter, is the oldest of the T’au ways of war. This style of combat relies upon employing one or more lures to draw the enemy in, before closing the jaws of the trap upon the foe once they have committed.
Dialogue/ce3battle22_end_03_b: Mont’ka is the other leading T’au military philosophy, and it is both aggressive and risky to execute. Translating as the killing blow, this strategy centres around highly mobile attack forces identifying key targets and assailing them with overwhelming force before withdrawing to safety.
Dialogue/ce3battle22_start_01_a: These caverns will be their tomb! Their death's an offering to the Star Children!
Dialogue/ce3battle22_start_02: Shas'o, the humans are using explosives on their own tunnels! You must -- [static]
Dialogue/ce3battle22_start_05: There! The explosions isolated the T'au leader! We must attack now!
Dialogue/ce3battle23_end_02: The XV22 is severely damaged, but I am alive. We fall back.
Dialogue/ce3battle23_end_03: The collapsing tunnels buried thousands of their own, too. Such a horrid and wasteful strategy.
Dialogue/ce3battle23_end_04: Though we cannot underestimate this foe and repeat such mistakes of rashness.
Dialogue/ce3battle23_end_05: Deep scan for more underground structures! We have to improve our knowledge of the terrain.
Dialogue/ce3battle23_start_01: I can sense that their leader is still alive. Find her! Don't let her escape!
Dialogue/ce3battle24_start_01: To all Imperial forces: Our foes withdraw. Now!
Dialogue/ce3battle24_start_02: The Emperor provided us this chance to strike back. Do not fail him!
Dialogue/ce3battle26_start_01: Shas'o, the humans are fighting among themselves again. Imperial forces are closing in on our own positions.
Dialogue/ce3battle26_start_02: Fall back to secondary defensive lines. Draw them into our fire. For the Greater Good!
Dialogue/ce3battle26_start_03: Let the alien and the oppressor slay each other! Their fall only quickens our inevitable rise!
Dialogue/ce3battle28_start_01: Shas'o, we have finished the deep scans. We have mapped the results to the battle and surveillance reports of our pathfinders.
Dialogue/ce3battle28_start_03: Very good. Isolate the leaders of the infected Gue'la and focus on them.
Dialogue/ce3battle29_end_01: Our scans indicate structural weaknesses in the Imperial factory atop their hideout.
Dialogue/ce3battle29_end_02: Toppling it will collapse a large part of the infected human's tunnels beneath and open up more angles to attack.
Dialogue/ce3battle29_end_03: Send in a XV104. Bring down the factory with long range fire. For the Greater Good!
Dialogue/ce3battle29_start_01: Xenos forces close in on us! To me, devoted brothers and sisters. Shield us!
Dialogue/ce3battle29_start_02: We will not exchange one oppressor for the next!
Dialogue/ce3battle30_end_01: The Star Children will smile upon this victory! The Day of Ascension will be upon us, soon!
Dialogue/ce3battle30_start_01_b: From ion weapons, railguns and smart missiles to shield generators, stealth fields and nanocrystalline alloys: The T’au utilise a wide range of different weaponry and equipment, their arsenals growing in size and capability with each passing season as the Earth caste develop more advanced technologies at breakneck pace.
Dialogue/ce3battle30_start_02_b: The T’au look to technology, training and devotion to the Greater Good to stack the odds in their favour. Fire Warriors, Gunships and Battlesuits, supported by advanced drones, sensors and networks, steered by brilliant military commanders and inspired by the wisdom of the Ethereals; this is a war machine honed to perfection.
Dialogue/ce3battle30_start_03: Do not falter! We must stop this thing before it destroys everything we hold dear!
Dialogue/ce3battle30_start_04: We will bring it down and let it be a shining beacon for our coming victory!
Dialogue/ce3cbattle01_end_01_b:
The Earth caste comprises the artisans, engineers, farmers and labourers of the T’au. It is they who fashion the sophisticated technologies and forward-leaping innovations that are so prevalent throughout every level of T’au society.

The Water caste makes up merchants, traders, ambassadorial corps and silver-tongued diplomats, moving fluidly among the other castes and any aliens of the T’au Empire.
Dialogue/ce3cbattle01_end_02_b:
The Air caste fill the role of pilots and spaceship crews, transporting goods and warriors to where they are needed or pushing back the boundaries of known T’au space.

The Fire caste constitutes the warriors of T’au society. It is the duty of these soldiers to protect the other castes, and to eliminate any foes foolish enough to oppose the will of the T’au Empire.
Dialogue/ce3cbattle02_end_01_b: The rise of the T’au can be seen to develop through distinct phases of exploration, conquest and settlement known as Spheres of Expansion. By now five in number, each is marked by a long build-up of resources and materiel, after which continual waves of exploratory missions and military campaigns follow.
Dialogue/ce3cbattle02_end_02_b: Each has spurred massive leaps in technology and understanding. Each has also come with its own traumas and costs, which T’au civilisation has borne with characteristic stoicism. For the Greater Good demands the tireless expansion of the T’au Empire. It is not enough to wait for the peoples of the galaxy to come in search of enlightenment.
Dialogue/ce3cbattle03_end_01_b: The Ethereal caste stand apart from their people. They rule the T’au as a wise and patient adult might guide spirited, if occasionally wayward, youths to realise their truest potential. Sometimes serene and benevolent, other times hard and stern as stone, it is the Ethereals who divine the needs of the Greater Good, and who decree the ways in which the T’au Empire may bring it about.
Dialogue/ce3cbattle03_end_02_b: For their part, the T’au view the Ethereals with a reverence bordering on the religious. Secular rulers; priests; grand galactic strategists: the Ethereals are all these things, and the respect they are paid is absolute.
Dialogue/ce4battle00_start_01_b: They are the grind of rotted bone crushed beneath trudging yet tireless feet. They are the wet rattle of pestilent breath, the shriek of rusted gears chewing meat, the hurricane drone of all the wings of all the flies that ever hatched. They are the relentless swing of the reaper's scythe. They are the Death Guard. They are Doom.
Dialogue/ce4battle00_start_02_b: The Death Guard advance amidst rolling smog banks of spore-thick fumes and whirling flies. Blessed by the Plague God Nurgle and commanded by their Daemon Primarch Mortarion, these mutated warriors are incredibly resilient and unleash the grim powers of alchemy, sorcery and supernatural contagion to wither and ruin their foes.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_end_01: Heretic filth. Death is too good for them.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_end_02: They are ravaged by taint and disease...
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_01_b: Many Death Guard warbands set out aboard squadrons of plague ships to spread Nurgle's gifts across the stars. They let the Warp's currents carry them wherever the Plague God wills, emerging from the Empyrean and looking with grim delight upon whatever worlds their patron deity has laid at their feet for conquest.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_02_b: Some plague ships are ancient crafts that have withstood millennia in service to Mortarion's sons, miserable with battle scars, diseased mutations and malevolent warp-taint. Others are more recent additions to the Plague Fleet, seized from enemies, infused with the blessings of Nurgle. Some are even gargantuan space hulks plucked from the tides of the Warp and pressed into service.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_03: Sororitas, we must destroy this space hulk abomination before it endangers the cardinal worlds of this system.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_04: If you wish to recover your relics, you must do so before the space hulk is destroyed. We cannot wait.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_05_a: Understood. The Emperor is with us.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_05_b: The signal we believe is coming from the relic-site is strong. We shall not fail.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_06_a: This place is evil. A place of horrors.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_06_b: Its destruction will be a holy act in the God-Emperor’s name.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_07: Hundreds of ships, crushed together and corrupted by the warp. It will be infested with monsters and heretics.
Dialogue/ce4battle01_start_08: Good. I shall burn them all.
Dialogue/ce4battle02_end_01: More of them. Not just a rabble. They were organised.
Dialogue/ce4battle02_end_02: Be alert. There is more to this than appears.
Dialogue/ce4battle03_end_01: Praise the Emperor. Thank you for blessing us with Your strength.
Dialogue/ce4battle03_end_02_a: This is Canoness Roswitha Esther to all Imperial forces in the space hulk:
Dialogue/ce4battle03_end_02_b: We have encountered Heretic Astartes. Be warned.
Dialogue/ce4battle03_start_02: Heretic Astartes. Plague Marines. Emperor be with us!
Dialogue/ce4battle03_start_03: Death to the False Emperor. Decay to the False Imperium!
Dialogue/ce4battle04_end_02_b: Their pox-touch is evident everywhere. This is the most corrupt vessel I have ever seen.
Dialogue/ce4battle04_start_01: More bar our path. I shall clear them with holy flame.
Dialogue/ce4battle04_start_02: We have smote them before. We will do so again.
Dialogue/ce4battle05_end_01_b: The God-Emperor has granted us the opportunity to purge a great many of his foes.
Dialogue/ce4battle05_start_01: Battle-Sisters? In the name of the throne do you hear me?
Dialogue/ce4battle05_start_02: Yes! We can hear you again. We have encountered Heretic Astartes Death Guard.
Dialogue/ce4battle05_start_03: As have we. They infect this space hulk like a virus.
Dialogue/ce4battle06_end_02: A Blightlord Terminator. The rot runs even deeper than I thought.
Dialogue/ce4battle06_end_03: It fell easily enough to sacred, purifying flame. If there are more, we will kill them just the same.
Dialogue/ce4battle06_end_04_a: The Emperor is with us. But he expects us to use the wits, faith and skill he has blessed us with.
Dialogue/ce4battle06_end_04_b: Remain vigilant. This is far from over.
Dialogue/ce4battle06_end_05_b: The Death Guard are one of the Traitor Legions that turned against the Imperium during the Horus Heresy. They have fought the Long War against the armies of the Emperor's realm ever since. Fuelled by bitterness and corrupted utterly in body and soul by the repulsive gifts of the Plague God Nurgle, they are amongst the greatest threats faced by the Imperium of Mankind.
Dialogue/ce4battle06_end_06_b: Squads of Plague Marines serve as the septic heart of almost all Death Guard armies. Mortarion's redoubtable, adaptable, highly trained infantry are imbued with the supernatural blessings of Nurgle; they are unstoppable on the advance and immovable in defence.
Dialogue/ce4battle06_start_01: Plague and infection seem to have seeped into the vessel itself…
Dialogue/ce4battle06_start_02: The corruption is palpable here. It makes me sick.
Dialogue/ce4battle06_start_03_a: As I would have hoped, little daughter of the False Emperor *gurgling laugh*
Dialogue/ce4battle06_start_03_b: This is our domain… this vessel-carcass is ours to infect…
Dialogue/ce4battle07_end_02: God-Emperor, grant thine blessings to my unguents.
Dialogue/ce4battle07_end_04: Nothing is working… the corruption’s foulness here disrupts my remedies.
Dialogue/ce4battle07_end_05_a: All I can grant is the Emperor’s mercy. Be at peace, brave Sister.
Dialogue/ce4battle07_start_02: Sister!... Sister!... Answer me! In the name of the Emperor, I order you to answer.
Dialogue/ce4battle07_start_03_a: They are lost, Canoness. They are with the God-Emperor now.
Dialogue/ce4battle07_start_03_b: And we will be, too, if we do not slay what has appeared before us.
Dialogue/ce4battle08_start_01: The Death Guard have summoned Daemons to fight beside them!
Dialogue/ce4battle08_start_02: There is no depravity they will not sink to. Emperor, lend us your light.
Dialogue/ce4battle08_start_03: Make my faith Your blade, make my body a vessel for Your wrath!
Dialogue/ce4battle10_end_04: They are corrupted beyond all recognition.
Dialogue/ce4battle10_end_05: Yes, Sister. I have seen this before. The Death Guard are not just vectors of warp-born disease and decay.
Dialogue/ce4battle10_end_06_a: They are also debased breeders and experimenters. These must be the results of their sick work.
Dialogue/ce4battle11_end_02: Disgusting creature. Thank the God-Emperor he is no more.
Dialogue/ce4battle11_end_03: Praise the Throne. You fought bravely, Sisters.
Dialogue/ce4battle11_end_04_a: The battle is just beginning, Sisters.
Dialogue/ce4battle11_end_04_b: That vile specimen’s work lives on. We must destroy it all. The Emperor demands it.
Dialogue/ce4battle11_end_05_b: Nurgle is the Chaos God of plagues, the patron deity of disease, despair and - to some mortals at least - cyclical life, death and rebirth. His worshippers most commonly depict him as a mountainous hulk of rancid fat and buboes, head crowned by rotting antlers, forever hunched over his cauldron of infinite poxes.
Dialogue/ce4battle11_end_06_b: There are many ways to worship Nurgle: The brewing of virulent plagues, the foul perversion of the surgeon's craft, sharing the abundance of unfettered sickness with armies of foes; the champions of the Death Guard practise these and many other expressions of the Plague Lord's faith, each vying to outdo the others in virulence.
Dialogue/ce4battle11_start_01: I see you’ve found my pets…
Dialogue/ce4battle11_start_02: Foul heretic! We will send you back into the disgusting abyss from which you crawled. What you did…
Dialogue/ce4battle11_start_03: It was necessary, little Sisters. I have learned much from their sacrifice and furthered the cause of beautiful decay.
Dialogue/ce4battle11_start_04_a: I wonder… what might the products of my Grandfather-given genius do to you, little upstarts?
Dialogue/ce4battle11_start_04_b: What might I glean from your agonising deaths?
Dialogue/ce4battle12_start_01_a: The battle is just beginning, Sisters.
Dialogue/ce4battle12_start_01_b: Our casualties are mounting. I’ve lost contact with several squads of our Battle Sisters.
Dialogue/ce4battle12_start_03: It gets worse. Word is coming from the planets. Diseases are spreading rapidly. It is no coincidence.
Dialogue/ce4battle12_start_05: Progress is hard. The Death Guard’s ways are treacherous, and their numbers are great.
Dialogue/ce4battle12_start_06: As we have found. Our advance is slowing, but we remain sure and steadfast. The God-Emperor is with us.
Dialogue/ce4battle12_start_07: Battle comes. May the Emperor guide your aim and blade!
Dialogue/ce4battle15_start_01: They pour from every corridor and tunnel!
Dialogue/ce4battle15_start_02: They will burn! Feel the searing heat of the God-Emperor’s righteous hatred!
Dialogue/ce4battle16_end_02: I will burn the cause of this infernal racket to ash.
Dialogue/ce4battle16_end_03_a: You will have your chance, I’ve no doubt of that, Sister.
Dialogue/ce4battle16_end_03_b: For that, too, is the work of the Death Guard.
Dialogue/ce4battle16_start_01: *There is a sound of a tolling bell, a single ‘bong’*
Dialogue/ce4battle16_start_02: What in the Emperor’s name is that?
Dialogue/ce4battle16_start_03: I think I have an idea… I pray that I am wrong.
Dialogue/ce4battle17_end_01: I am but the harbinger… you have not yet seen our true magnificence…
Dialogue/ce4battle17_end_02: It matters not, disgusting traitor, I will see it scoured from the galaxy!
Dialogue/ce4battle17_end_03: You have my full blessing, Sister.
Dialogue/ce4battle17_end_05_b: The mere presence of the Death Guard on the field of battle spreads weakness, corrosion and infection among the foe. In such conditions, any wound or battle damage can prove fatal. Even those Death Guard weapons not actively firing ammunition imbued with supernatural diseases or alchemical agents become more lethal as a result.
Dialogue/ce4battle17_end_06_b: The grotesque mutants known as Poxwalkers are created when a cocktail of Nurgle's most repulsive plagues combine. Victims of this malaise find their bodies mutating and decomposing all at once, until eventually their features contract into an awful rictus grin. Minds trapped within twisted husks that no longer obey their commands, they stagger forth in packs to spread their lord's gifts.
Dialogue/ce4battle17_start_02_a: Hark the ringing disharmony of the tocsin of Grandfather Nurgle!
Dialogue/ce4battle17_start_02_b: Listen, and weep tears of delectable pus and bile!
Dialogue/ce4battle17_start_04: Behold, beautiful corruption! Gaze upon glorious pestilence!
Dialogue/ce4battle18_end_02: Nurgle will need a new one before we leave this space hulk.
Dialogue/ce4battle18_start_01: Oh, what glorious march! They walk for the Herald of Nurgle.
Dialogue/ce4battle18_start_02: And they die by the Emperor’s hand!
Dialogue/ce4battle19_start_01: Damn this warp-cursed vessel! The path ahead is blocked! We don’t have time for this!
Dialogue/ce4battle19_start_02: Calm yourself, Sister. We will find a way around. We will not leave without the relics.
Dialogue/ce4battle21_end_02: Who have you failed, heretic? Who is your depraved master?
Dialogue/ce4battle21_end_03: The Host… The Host… The Host of the Destroyer...
Dialogue/ce4battle21_end_04: What does that mean? Their very words make my mind itch.
Dialogue/ce4battle22_end_01: Enough. My task here is completed. The contagions are combined as Nurgle envisions.
Dialogue/ce4battle22_end_02: I have worlds to plague. You will be mine when the Grandfather wills.
Dialogue/ce4battle22_end_04: Preserve your strength, Vindicta. We still need it to recover the relics. We are close.
Dialogue/ce4battle22_end_05_b: Typhus is a mighty champion and true devotee of Nurgle, marching among his own horde of followers and shambling masses of Poxwalkers. He is the host of the Destroyer Hive, a parasitic gift of Nurgle whose swarming horror he can unleash to wreak havoc upon his foes.
Dialogue/ce4battle22_end_06_b: From his flagship, the Terminus Est, he leads a nomadic fleet upon an endless pilgrimage of pestilence. Typhus does Nurgle's work first and always, and he fights with the rest of his Traitor Legion only when their goals align with his own. Some amongst the Death Guard even believe that, when the Legion first fell into the worship of Nurgle, it was Typhus' doing.
Dialogue/ce4battle22_start_03: The pox-ridden dead are mine to command. I will add you to my ranks!
Dialogue/ce4battle23_end_01: Kill by kill, we cleanse this place.
Dialogue/ce4battle23_start_01: The signal is as strong as ever, but it’s corrupted and mangled. We are close to the relics. I pray they are safe.
Dialogue/ce4battle23_start_02: We are. This ship we are in now is Adepta Sororitas.
Dialogue/ce4battle23_start_03: It deserved a better fate than to be a depraved playground for the Death Guard.
Dialogue/ce4battle23_start_04: It is good, the Black Templars will put it out of its misery.
Dialogue/ce4battle25_end_02: The corruption of this fell place seeps even into our vox channels.
Dialogue/ce4battle27_end_02: I cannot make out a word. God-Emperor, bless us with the gift of your cleansing clarity.
Dialogue/ce4battle27_end_03: We push on; the relics are close.
Dialogue/ce4battle28_end_01: *vox static* Mort-... -march… on… space hul-  *vox static*
Dialogue/ce4battle28_end_02: The Black Templars are trying to warn us… but what about?
Dialogue/ce4battle29_end_01: The relics! Here they are, intact! Praise the throne!
Dialogue/ce4battle29_end_03: MORTARION! THE DAEMON PRIMARCH IS ABOARD THE SPACE HULK
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_01: My warriors have explosives primed around multiple warp drives. Get out now!
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_02: This system is already doomed; its cardinal worlds are awash with disease.
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_03: Destroying this hulk will only hurl debris laced with yet more bountiful corruption into every planet.
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_04: There is nothing you can do. My holy mission here is over. The Grandfather will do as he sees fit.
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_05: Sororitas! Confirm this message! You have to get out. Now!
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_06: We found… Mortarion. There was nothing we could…
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_07: You stood against that monster and survived? Truly, your faith is strong. You will need it in the battles to come.
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_08_b: Embittered and malevolent beyond the mortal capacity to hate, Mortarion is a supernatural entity of unimaginable malice. Wherever he is summoned forth into realspace, he unleashes suffering on an apocalyptic scale. Cloaked and cowled, wreathed in a miasmal decay and wielding a colossal scythe, he truly is the Death Lord of Humanity's deepest fears.
Dialogue/ce4battle30_end_09_b: Even when being caught in endless loathing and grievance, Mortarion still possesses strategic wisdom garnered from millennia of warfare, the singular intellect of a Primarch and the supernatural insights of a true daemon lord. Where Mortarion commands, few beings in the entire galaxy can counter his spitefully brilliant battle plans. Fewer still can battle with the Death Lord in person and long survive.
Dialogue/ce4battle30_start_01_a: Your false faith burns bright. You have befouled this holy vector of glorious decay with it long enough.
Dialogue/ce4battle30_start_02_a: Your skin will run like pus. Your eyes will pop like boils. Your bones shall rot to mulch.
Dialogue/ce4battle30_start_02_b: And you shall thank the Grandfather.
Dialogue/ce4cbattle01_end_01_b: For all their slow degeneration, the Death Guard have retained many war engines and mighty champions that first went into battle at the dawn of the Imperium. These have been augmented with empyric might and joined by new and gruesome daemonic entities of virulence and ruin.
Dialogue/ce4cbattle01_end_02_b: Fashioned from rusted iron, swathed in plague flies, propelled by minds that seethe with bitterness and bile, they shower the enemy with the putrid gifts of Nurgle while soaking up the punishment that would see conventional war engines destroyed several times over.
Dialogue/ce4cbattle02_end_01_b: Reality rings like a struck bell as it rebels against the sheer wrongness of Nurgle's daemons. When they are summoned from the depths of the Empyrean to fight by the side of the Plague God's chosen Legion, the veil of reality splits like the belly of a bloated corpse, spilling forth these befouling entities.
Dialogue/ce4cbattle02_end_02_b: Slouching and capering, squirming and lumbering, these rot-bringing abominations are death to all who face them. Such malevolent entities spread warp-taint by their mere presence and can reduce enemy hosts to bubbling slop in minutes.
Dialogue/ce4cbattle03_end_01_b: The Death Guard, by now, are a far cry from the army that fought in the Legion Wars. What organisational statutes they do still obey are dictated as much by ritual significance as any genuine strategic or logistical considerations. Nurgle's sacred number is seven, so many squads of Plague Marines enter battle seven warriors strong for this same reason.
Dialogue/ce4cbattle03_end_02_b: Mortarion also maintains seven Plague Companies in Nurgle's honour. Each of them has its own traditional strategic and tactical emphases and - most horrifyingly - a signature plague that seethes through its ranks and spreads to any foe who draws too close.
Dialogue/ce5battle01_end_01: They burn! They scream! They die!
Dialogue/ce5battle01_end_02: This is a world white with ice. We will make it white with skulls!
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_01_b: To the masses of Humanity, the God-Emperor is the central figure of faith and protection, and his worship is unified under the Imperial Creed. This galaxy-spanning religion is administered by the Ecclesiarchy, officially the Adeptus Ministorum, which oversees rites, rituals and offerings across the Imperium. It serves as a unifying presence across Imperial society.
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_02_b: The Ecclesiarchy constructs places of worship, tends to the spiritual needs of the faithful and spreads the Imperial Creed to newly rediscovered or resettled worlds. Led by the Ecclesiarch and supported by cardinals, priests and missionaries, it enforces adherence to the faith and suppresses heresy.
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_04: I have been waging war here for months.
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_07: Can you not finish what you started, Archimatos?
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_08: Simply charging into battle is not the way of my Legion.
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_09_a: You never had the stomach for real bloodshed, witch!
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_09_b: Where is this slaughter you promised?!
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_10: You will find plenty of it here, World Eater.
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_11: The False Emperor’s faithful are here in droves. All ripe for the axe.
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_12_a: We will find them! We will kill them!
Dialogue/ce5battle01_start_12_b: Blood for the Blood God! Skulls for the Throne of Khorne!
Dialogue/ce5battle02_start_01: You are unleashed, Azkor! Kill and Destroy!
Dialogue/ce5battle03_end_01: Is that all you can do?
Dialogue/ce5battle03_end_02: I expected better from the hounds of Angron!
Dialogue/ce5battle03_end_03: You called upon us because you were too weak to kill these mewling corpse-worshippers!
Dialogue/ce5battle05_end_01: You’ve stirred the nest, now, World Eaters *laughs, then vox cuts out*
Dialogue/ce5battle05_end_02: Even more reason to not trust him.
Dialogue/ce5battle05_end_03_b: They have led our Legion to failure before.
Dialogue/ce5battle06_end_01_a: Behold the limp flames of the False Emperor!
Dialogue/ce5battle06_end_01_b: See how they splutter and die before Khorne's wrath!
Dialogue/ce5battle06_end_03_b: Most Battle Sisters go to war clad in power armour comparable to that of the Adeptus Astartes. The core of Adepta Sororitas forces consists of squads armed with Godwyn-Deaz-pattern boltguns, flamers, storm bolters or meltaguns. Their strength lies in resilience and adaptability, allowing them to hold or advance in extreme conditions to secure their objectives.
Dialogue/ce5battle06_end_04_b: Specialist units such as Dominions operate at the forefront, using close-range firepower and mobility to breach enemy lines and shatter key targets. Following these assaults, Battle Sister squads secure and defend captured ground. Retributor squads provide heavy fire support, wielding weapons designed to destroy infantry, fortifications and armoured vehicles, ensuring the advance.
Dialogue/ce5battle06_start_01: Your bloody rampage of sin and slaughter ends here, Heretic.
Dialogue/ce5battle06_start_02: May cleansing fire purge your blasphemous existence from the galaxy!
Dialogue/ce5battle06_start_03_a: I will make your flesh melt and your bones ashes!
Dialogue/ce5battle08_end_01_a: We will bring Khorne’s gaze to this world!
Dialogue/ce5battle08_end_01_b: May the Blood God bless us with his frenzy!
Dialogue/ce5battle11_end_01_a: Smell their flesh burn! Hear their meat sizzle and pop!
Dialogue/ce5battle11_end_01_b: I will taste it. I will taste it!
Dialogue/ce5battle11_end_03: Weak. So weak, nothing remains of her.
Dialogue/ce5battle11_end_04: She is ashes! Khorne, accept my offering!
Dialogue/ce5battle11_end_05_b: Heresy, witchcraft and mutation remain constant threats within the Imperium, and the Adeptus Ministorum is charged with rooting out such corruption wherever it arises. Its priests are granted wide authority to punish those suspected of crimes against the Imperial Creed.
Dialogue/ce5battle11_end_06_b: When such measures fail and widespread heresy threatens an Imperial world, the Adepta Sororitas are deployed. Known as the Sisters of Battle, they are the defenders of the Ecclesiarchy and the most devout servants of the Imperial Creed. They project the will of the Ecclesiarch across the Imperium, enforcing the Emperor’s judgement with force and faith.
Dialogue/ce5battle11_start_01_a: God-Emperor, give us Your strength to smite Your hideous foes.
Dialogue/ce5battle11_start_01_b: Bless our weapons. Steel our souls. Fill our hearts with courage.
Dialogue/ce5battle11_start_02: And if You choose it, we die filled with righteous hatred knowing we did so following Your perfect will.
Dialogue/ce5battle11_start_03: I will stop your path of blood and murder, Heretic Astartes filth. Die.
Dialogue/ce5battle12_end_01: Wade through their corpses! Take their skulls!
Dialogue/ce5battle14_end_01_a: The flames of Khorne hunger and they feast!
Dialogue/ce5battle14_end_01_b: They consume flesh and bone and souls!
Dialogue/ce5battle15_end_01_a: Is there no better foe! No Champion worthy of my axe?
Dialogue/ce5battle16_end_01: Such ferocity, wasted in shackled service. Contemptible.
Dialogue/ce5battle16_end_02: The Blood God’s blessings fall heavily here!
Dialogue/ce5battle16_end_03_a: The bodies pile high... blood flows in torrents. Glorious.
Dialogue/ce5battle16_end_04: He sees us! Sees us burn and kill!
Dialogue/ce5battle17_end_02_b: Across the Imperium, many loyal servants of the God-Emperor have been canonised, often through martyrdom in service to the Imperial Creed. On rare occasions, a living individual is granted sainthood, reflecting the Imperium’s martial and faith-driven ways.
Dialogue/ce5battle17_end_03_b: To be named a Living Saint by the Ecclesiarch, an individual must perform undeniable miracles in the presence of the faithful. Such manifestations of divine power have included holy fire, stigmata and the resurrection of the fallen. Given their devotion to the God-Emperor, several Living Saints were once Sisters of the Adepta Sororitas.
Dialogue/ce5battle17_start_03: Cursed healer! I will see her work undone!
Dialogue/ce5battle17_start_04: The Emperor is with us, heretics!
Dialogue/ce5battle17_start_05: I will take your head! I will lay your skull before the Skull Throne!
Dialogue/ce5battle17_start_07: They burn with our faith in the Emperor!
Dialogue/ce5battle18_start_01: If you want a better fight, World Eater, there is plenty more to come.
Dialogue/ce5battle20_end_01: How they charge! Desperate to kill! Throwing themselves upon our blades!
Dialogue/ce5battle20_end_03: Good! Blood will spill! Skulls will pile!
Dialogue/ce5battle21_end_02: The Abbess… will smite you… in the Emperor’s… name...
Dialogue/ce5battle21_end_05: *chainaxe roars and saws long and deep into flesh*
Dialogue/ce5battle22_end_04: The war is not over, filth. I will not yield this world. She will not yield this world.
Dialogue/ce5battle22_end_06: Her skull will sit at the pinnacle of the ziggurat we will raise in the Blood God’s honour!
Dialogue/ce5battle22_end_07: KILL! KILL! KILL! THE SAINT WILL DIE!
Dialogue/ce5battle22_end_08_b: As Abbess Sanctorum, Morvenn Vahl commands the Orders Militant and leads the Ecclesiarchy’s wars from the front. Though youthful in appearance, she has proven herself a capable and resolute leader, marked by unwavering devotion to the God-Emperor and the defence of the Imperial Creed.
Dialogue/ce5battle22_end_09_b: Elevated during the upheaval following the Great Rift, Vahl rejected political manipulation and ceremonial distance, focusing instead on restoring contact with isolated Orders and directing forces to critical war zones. She continues to prosecute holy wars personally, embodying the militant authority of the Adepta Sororitas.
Dialogue/ce5battle22_start_01_a: Heretic Astartes filth. You will pay for your blasphemy.
Dialogue/ce5battle22_start_01_b: I will slay each and every one of you, in the Emperor’s name.
Dialogue/ce5battle22_start_02: You will watch us butcher your warriors! See the worthlessness of your False Emperor!
Dialogue/ce5battle22_start_03: Then I will take your head!
Dialogue/ce5battle25_end_02: I will be easy to find. I will be the one standing upon the broken corpses of every one of her deluded, weak followers.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_end_01: You think you have won, Daemon, but the Emperor’s light remains strong.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_end_02: Azkor is no Daemon. He is the master of eight, whom he has leashed within him. Their power is his.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_end_03: You have failed. We shall slaughter every soul on this world.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_end_05: SKULLS FOR THE THRONE OF KHORNE!
Dialogue/ce5battle30_end_06: You have done well, World Eaters!
Dialogue/ce5battle30_end_07: Your rampage has lured Imperial forces away from the next world in the system.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_end_08: It is all mine, now. Just as I planned.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_end_09_b: I will crush your skull in my fists before the Throne of Khorne itself, Sorcerer!
Dialogue/ce5battle30_start_01_b: Saint Celestine is a Living Saint of the Imperium, revered as a divine champion of the God-Emperor whose presence inspires the faithful and unnerves the faithless. Little is known of her life before her apotheosis, though she is believed to have been a Sister Repentia of the Order of Our Martyred Lady before rising from death during the Palatine Crusade.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_start_02_b: Since her ascension, Celestine has appeared across the Imperium during times of great crisis, repeatedly returning from death to fight the enemies of the faith. Accompanied by the Geminae Superia, champions drawn from the Orders Militant, she has fought in major conflicts such as Cadia and Vigilus, where her presence proved crucial against Chaos forces.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_start_04_a: You have done enough. So the Emperor wills, Heretics.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_start_06: DEATH TO THE FALSE EMPEROR! MAY HE BURN IN AGONY FOR ETERNITY!
Dialogue/ce5battle30_start_07: God-Emperor, make me your blade. Wield me as you see fit.
Dialogue/ce5battle30_start_08: We will break your body! Crush your bones! Drain your blood upon the ice!
Dialogue/ce5cbattle01_end_01_b:
Within the Adepta Sororitas, Sisters who commit acts of cowardice, disobedience or lose faith are judged, disgraced and subjected to severe punishment under the Orders Militant.
Stripped of their armour, Repentia are armed with eviscerator chainswords and driven into the forefront of battle under the supervision of Repentia Superiors, seeking redemption through sacrifice. Few survive long enough to atone.
Dialogue/ce5cbattle01_end_02_b: Those who flee face a harsher fate, entombed within Mortifiers, war engines that magnify pain and anguish. For the entombed, death in battle is the only release from penance.
Dialogue/ce5cbattle02_end_01_b: The Orders Militant form the martial wing of the Adepta Sororitas, maintaining sanctuaries across the Imperium and responding to threats against the Imperial faith. The six Orders Majoris were founded across different eras in honour of the Matriarchs and remain the most prominent military Orders, their Sisters trained through discipline and unwavering devotion to the Imperial Creed.
Dialogue/ce5cbattle02_end_02_b: Each Order maintains fortified convents, parishes and sanctuaries from which they prosecute Wars of Faith beyond assigned territories. Following the Great Rift, many Orders were isolated or destroyed, while others fought alone. Large numbers of Battle Sisters later joined the Indomitus Crusade, playing a central role in restoring Imperial control and prosecuting wars of faith.
Dialogue/ce5cbattle03_end_01_b: Wars of Faith are declared by the Ecclesiarch when threats to the Imperial Creed demand retribution. The Orders Militant are swiftly mustered and dispatched to destroy heretics, traitors and other enemies of the faith.
Dialogue/ce5cbattle03_end_02_b: These wars are rarely fought alone. Missionaries, priests and formations of Frateris Militia often accompany the Sisters of Battle, combining fanatic devotion with military force in the Emperor’s name.
Dialogue/eSm2SrvRandom1: Bolter loaded. What else do I need?
Dialogue/eSm2SrvRandom2: We are the Emperor's chosen. We do what is necessary to protect His realm.
Dialogue/eSm2SrvRandom3: The Codex is a guide, not a commandment.
Dialogue/eSm2SrvRandom4: Do not become complacent. The galaxy will always find new threats to test you.
Dialogue/eSm2SrvRandom5: In the Deathwatch, I came to appreciate the varied tactics of our brother Chapters.

Keywords/AbilityClarification_Active: Active abilities can be used once per battle unless otherwise specified.
Keywords/AbilityClarification_Melee: Melee attacks can only target adjacent units unless otherwise specified. Additional hits are considered as part of the attack they are added to.
Keywords/AbilityClarification_NoAttack: Some abilities are not considered an attack and offer a different value on the battlefield, like supporting <style="BUFF">buffs</style> or applying <style="DEBUFF">debuffs</style> on the enemy.
Keywords/AbilityClarification_Passive: Passive abilities provide their effects automatically, based on their condition to trigger.
Keywords/AbilityClarification_Primary: Primary abilities are only used by <style="MoW">Machines of War</style>. They cost the consumable resource <style="Resource_MachinesOfWarAmmo">Munitions</style> to activate and can be used multiple times per battle, but their use can be restricted by initial <style="Cooldown">cooldowns</style>.
Keywords/AbilityClarification_Ranged: Ranged attacks can target units or hexes that are not adjacent to the attacker. If they are triggered by an ability, they can also target units that are adjacent to the attacker. Additional hits are considered as part of the attack they are added to.
Keywords/AbilityClarification_Secondary: Secondary abilities are only used by <style="MoW">Machines of War</style>. They consume no resources and can be used multiple times per battle, but their use can be restricted by initial <style="Cooldown">cooldowns</style>.
Keywords/AbilityClarification_Tertiary_M: Mythic abilities provide their effects automatically, based on their condition to trigger. Disabled if the unit is capped at a rarity below <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style>.
Keywords/AbilityClarification_Tertiary_R: Relic abilities provide their effects automatically as long as the Relic is equipped, based on their condition to trigger. Disabled if the unit is capped at a rarity below <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style>.
Keywords/Capped: Some units are capped to a specific rarity to enable fair play. The capping influences the overall power and stats of a <style="Character">character</style>.
Keywords/Charging: A unit is charging when it has moved adjacent to its melee target this turn and started the movement not being adjacent to it
Keywords/Cooldown: Number of rounds or turns you have to wait before you can use an ability.
Keywords/Decoy: Will be destroyed if stepped on or if damaged, but can not be targeted. <style="Ambush">Ambush</style> units can resurrect here.
Keywords/Displacement: Push, Pull and Throw are displacement effects and do not count as movement. Units can only be displaced onto free adjacent hexes unless otherwise specified. If there is no free adjacent hex, they instead receive 20% of their maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> as damage, except units with <style="Immune">Immune</style> or <style="Big_Target">Big Target</style>.
Keywords/DMG_Blast: {[piercingDmgPct]}% pierce ratio. Can hit multiple members of Swarms or 2-man Teams
Keywords/DMG_Flame: {[piercingDmgPct]}% pierce ratio. Sets target hex on Fire
Keywords/DMG_Las: {[piercingDmgPct]}% pierce ratio. Has +50% Pierce ratio if the unit has the Emplacement or Heavy Weapon traits
Keywords/DMG_Melta: {[piercingDmgPct]}% pierce ratio. Deals +50% damage against <style="Vehicle">Vehicle</style> units
Keywords/DMG_Toxic: {[piercingDmgPct]}% pierce ratio. Has a 25% chance to apply <style="Tile_Contamination">Contaminated</style> to the target hex
Keywords/EffectDespoiledGround: Units starting their turn on a <style="Tile_DespoiledGround">Despoiled Ground</style> hex take {[DespoiledGroundMinDmgPct]}-{[DespoiledGroundMaxDmgPct]}% of their initial <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> as <style="DMG_Direct">Direct Damage</style>. Affected <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units also deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[DespoiledGroundExtraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> to <style="Aliance_Xenos">Xenos</style> or <style="Aliance_Imperial">Imperial</style> enemies. Despoiled Ground disappears after 2 rounds.
Keywords/EffectFire: Units entering a hex on Fire end their movement, excluding <style="Flying">Flying</style> and <style="Unstoppable">Unstoppable</style> units. Units starting their turn on a Fire hex take 20% of their initial <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> as <style="DMG_Flame">Flame</style> Damage. Fire disappears after 2 rounds but may spread in Tall Grass
Keywords/EffectIce: Units entering a hex with Ice end their movement, excluding <style="Flying">Flying</style> and <style="Unstoppable">Unstoppable</style> units. Units on hexes with Ice take 25% more Crit Damage. Ice disappears after 2 rounds.
Keywords/FloatingDeath:
Has +1 <style="Stat_Movement">Movement</style> when starting its turn within <style=Synapse">Synapse</style> range. This unit explodes when it attacks or if it or an adjacent friendly <style="Faction_Tyranids">Spore Mine</style> is defeated, and deals <style="DMG_Toxic">Toxic Damage</style> to all adjacent enemies. Does not explode when <style="Overkill">overkilled</style>.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}
Keywords/Healing: Healing restores a unit's <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> and removes certain negative effects like <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style>, <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> or <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>. No effect on <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units.
Keywords/HexEffect: Traversable hexes can have temporary hex effects that provide a unique effect. Hexes can have only one hex effect at a time. Hex effects include <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style>, <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style>, <style="Tile_Contamination">Contaminated</style> and <style="Tile_DespoiledGround">Despoiled Ground</style>.
Keywords/LHE_Common: Units rarity capped at Common cannot exceed <style="Rank_3">Iron Rank I</style>, 2 Character Stars, Ability levels 8 and Common equipment level 3 during the battle. Equipment of a higher rarity is treated as Common level 3.
Keywords/LHE_Epic: Units rarity capped at Epic cannot exceed <style="Rank_12">Gold Rank I</style>, 8 Character Stars, Ability levels 35 and Epic equipment level 9 during the battle. Equipment of a higher rarity is treated as Epic level 9.
Keywords/LHE_Legendary: Units rarity capped at Legendary cannot exceed <style="Rank_17">Diamond Rank III</style>, 11 Character Stars, Ability levels 50 and Legendary equipment level 11 during the battle.
Keywords/LHE_Mythic: Units rarity capped at Mythic cannot exceed <style="Rank_20">Mythic Rank III</style>, 14 Character Stars, Ability levels 65 and Mythic equipment level 10 during the battle.
Keywords/LHE_Rare: Units rarity capped at Rare cannot exceed <style="Rank_9">Silver Rank I</style>, 6 Character Stars, Ability levels 26 and Rare equipment level 7 during the battle. Equipment of a higher rarity is treated as Rare level 7.
Keywords/LHE_Uncommon: Units rarity capped at Uncommon cannot exceed <style="Rank_6">Bronze Rank I</style>, 4 Character Stars, Ability levels 17 and Uncommon equipment level 5 during the battle. Equipment of a higher rarity is treated as Uncommon level 5.
Keywords/Lifewards: If Celestine is in an adjacent hex and takes Damage, that post-Armour Damage is taken as Direct Damage by the Geminae Superia instead
Keywords/MachineVengeance: Can only affect <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units. Affected units deal <style="DMG">+5% Damage</style> for each level of Machine Vengeance they have.
Keywords/MortisRound: Deals Heavy Round Damage to a single target, which is then pushed back 1 hex. The Heavy Weapon trait applies doubly to this ability
Keywords/NonCharacter: All units in the collection screen, except Machines of War are considered "characters". That includes the same units when used as enemies in the campaign or as boss adjutants during Guild Raids. All other units (for example <style="Summon">Summons</style> or the Guild Raid Bosses) are classified as "non-characters".
Keywords/NormalAttack: Normal attacks use the damage stat, hits and pierce ratio of a unit. Additional hits are considered part of the normal attack. Attacks triggered from abilities are not considered normal attacks unless stated otherwise.
Keywords/Obliterated: Units defeated by this attack cannot be revived and count as <style="Overkill">overkilled</style>, even if they normally cannot be overkilled.
Keywords/OutOfSight: A +2 (or higher) elevation next to the shooter and/or target always blocks shooting, unless the two units are within 1 hex of each other. Does not apply to attacks with the Indirect Fire trait
Keywords/Overkill: If a unit is defeated by a Crit or if the damage of the attack that defeats it is more than double its remaining Health, the unit is Overkilled. Overkills can interact with other effects like Battle Fatigue or Reanimation Protocols.
Keywords/PierceRatio: This portion of the Damage ignores Armour
Keywords/PowerLevel: The strength of a Character based on their Stats, Abilities and Equipment. A player’s Power Score is the Power of all their Characters combined. Increase your Power Score to reach higher Power levels
Keywords/RelentlessMarch: Gives +1 Movement to all friendly units that start their turn in an adjacent hex and repairs affected Mechanical units
Keywords/Repairing: Repairing restores a <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit's <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> and removes certain negative effects like <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style>, <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> or <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>.
Keywords/Restore: Regenerating effects restore <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> but do not remove any negative effects.
Keywords/RogueTrader: Shop where you can sell excess <style="Unit">Unit</style> <style="Resource_GenericShards">Shards</style> for <style="Resource_ElderCurrency">Archeotech</style>, which can be used to buy exclusive daily deals!
Keywords/Teleport_Strike_short: Units in Deep Strike can move to any free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy, or they can move normally from their current position. They cannot be targeted or damaged until they have taken an action or ended their turn.
Keywords/TileContamination: Units standing or starting on a <style="Tile_Contamination">Contaminated</style> hex have <style="Stat_Armor">-30% armor</style> for 1 round. <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> and <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagions of Nurgle</style> units are not affected. Contamination disappears after 2 rounds.
Keywords/TileDespoiledGround: Units starting their turn on a <style="Tile_DespoiledGround">Despoiled Ground</style> hex take {[DespoiledGroundMinDmgPct]}-{[DespoiledGroundMaxDmgPct]}% of their initial <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> as <style="DMG_Direct">Direct Damage</style>. Affected <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units also deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[DespoiledGroundExtraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> to <style="Aliance_Xenos">Xenos</style> or <style="Aliance_Imperial">Imperial</style> enemies. Despoiled Ground disappears after 2 rounds.
Keywords/TileElevation: Units attacking from higher elevation deal more Damage
Keywords/TileGrass:
Units in this hex receive fewer hits from any <style="Stat_Range">ranged</style> attacks, down to a minimum of 1.

Fire has a chance to spread among Tall Grass.
Keywords/TileIce: Units passing over Broken Ice need to stop, excluding <style="Flying">Flying</style> and <style="Unstoppable">Unstoppable</style> units.
Keywords/TileNormal: A normal hex with no special features
Keywords/TileRazorwire: Units entering a hex with Razor Wire end their movement, excluding <style="Flying">Flying</style> and <style="Unstoppable">Unstoppable</style> units. Units take 50% more Damage while on Razor Wire.
Keywords/TileSpawnpoint: Enemy units can appear in this hex when they join the battle. No units can move onto or be summoned onto a hex that is a Spawn Point.
Keywords/TileTrench: Units in Trenches take less Damage from attacks passing over a trench edge. Does not apply to attacks with the Indirect Fire trait. Elevation has no effect on units in trenches.
Keywords/UnitEffect_AstartesBanner:
If this unit has the <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style> trait, it ignores it.
If this unit does not have the <style="FinalJustice">Final Vengeance</style> trait, it acts as if it has it, with final attacks dealing {[dmg]} Damage.
Keywords/UnitEffect_LightCover: Reduces incoming ranged multi-hit attacks by 2 hits, to a minimum of 1.
Keywords/UnitEffect_Markerlight: This unit is marked. Ranged attacks from <style="FactionIcon_Tau">T'au Empire</style> units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[markerlightDmgBonusPct]}% Damage</style> against it. <style="Healing">Healing</style> removes the effect.
Keywords/UnitEffect_Neuroparasite: Infected Units take more <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> from the Neurothrope. <style="Healing">Healing</style> removes the effect.
Keywords/UnitEffect_Overwatching: An Overwatching unit will attack the first enemy who moves into range, unless that unit has the Infiltrate trait
Keywords/UnitEffect_Pinned: Suppressed units deal -30% <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style>, have -1 Movement and stop <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>. <style="Healing">Healing</style> removes the effect, but does not enable Overwatch again in the same turn.
Keywords/UnitEffect_Revealed: <style="Debuff_Revealed">Revealed</style> Units are more susceptible to damage in certain situations
Keywords/UnitEffect_Shield: No <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> is dealt to the unit until the Shield is destroyed. The Shield has no <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style>.
Keywords/UnitEffect_Stunned: This unit has only <style="Stat_Movement">1 Movement</style>, deals less Damage and cannot use active Abilities. <style="Healing">Healing</style> removes the effect.
Keywords/UnitEffect_Synapse: Friendly units with the Instinctive Behaviour trait and within 2 hexes of this unit may behave as normal. They also ignore any Battle Fatigue rolls.
Keywords/UnitEffect_Taunted: Taunted units can only target the taunting unit. They can't move away, use their Active Ability, Heal, Repair, or target another unit. Attacks that are not targeted may still hit other units. <style="Healing">Healing</style> removes the effect.
Keywords/Unlocked: Even if you don't have this unit in your collection, you can still use it in this game mode by borrowing it.
LiveEvents/Anniversary_2023_desc_long: Join the festivities starting August 13 with exclusive rewards, unique missions, special offers, and more!
LiveEvents/Anniversary_2023_title: Get ready to celebrate Tacticus' first birthday on August 15!
LiveEvents/Anniversary_2024_desc_long: The festivities kick off on August 8 with a 2-week special offers calendar, including some free gifts! Then, join us on August 15 for the birthday event featuring exclusive rewards, unique missions, an Infested Power-Ups Tournament, and more!
LiveEvents/Anniversary_2024_title: Get ready to celebrate Tacticus' second birthday on August 15!
LiveEvents/Anniversary_2025_desc_long: The festivities kick off on August 1st with the Anniversary home screen event and continue on August 3rd with the "Path to Glory" survival event and a 2-week special offers calendar, including many gifts. Don't miss out on the special calendar giveaway and exclusive offer on Tacticus' birthday: August 15!
LiveEvents/Anniversary_2025_title: Get ready to celebrate Tacticus' third birthday on August 15!
LiveEvents/April_2026_desc_long: The "Dust and Destiny" survival event begins on April 19th featuring Arkazar Abraxas shards, and a week long offer calendar. On the same day, the "Against the Tide" Home Screen Event will kickoff. Defeat waves to obtain units shards and advance in the survival event running in parallel. Finally, don't miss the exclusive offers in game and in the web store, especially on April 25th!
LiveEvents/April_2026_title: The quest for knowledge starts on April 19th!
LiveEvents/December_2025_desc_long:
On November 30, our first ever Legendary Battle Pass arrives! Battle through 60 tiers to earn Marneus Calgar shards and more, with a special mission chain included to help you conquer them all.

On December 1, the six-day "Sons of Ultramar" event begins, offering even more Calgar shards and shop rewards for all other Ultramarines. That same day, our four-week Advent Calendar also starts, bringing gifts for all. Boost your event progress with the "Purge Order" and Infested Power-ups Tournament Arena. Get ready for a month packed with rewards!

On the same day, the "Against the Tide" Home Screen Event will kickoff, defeat waves to obtain salvage and advance in the survival event running in parallel.
