LiveEvents/February_2026_title: Gear up for Kin duty on February 8th!
LiveEvents/Halloween_2023_desc_long: Join the festivities starting October 22 with an all-new Battle Pass, exclusive rewards, special offers, an infested tournament, and more!
LiveEvents/Halloween_2023_title: Get ready for a Tacticus Halloween, featuring the Tyranid Deathleaper!
LiveEvents/Halloween_2025_desc_long:
The Halloween festivities begin on October 26th with the "Space Hulk" survival event, the "Against the Tide" home screen event, and an offer calendar packed with treats. Don't miss the exclusive avatar offer on Halloween Day, October 31st!

But the battle doesn't stop there, Tactician. On October 30th, a new Campaign Event will expand the Space Hulk experience with a deadly new trick: fresh mechanics that will put your skills and roster to the test. Are you ready to face what lurks in the dark?
LiveEvents/Halloween_2025_title: Get ready to scout the depths of the Space Hulk on October 26th
LiveEvents/Holidays_2025_desc_long: The Holiday festivities begin on December 25th with "Da Red Gobbo" survival event featuring Calgar's shards, and a two-week offer calendar packed with treats. On December 29th, squigs are once again flooding Tacticus with the "Squig Smash" Home Screen Event. Finally, don't miss the exclusive offers, especially on New Year's Eve, December 31st!
LiveEvents/Holidays_2025_title: Da Red Gobbo is back on December 25th!
LiveEvents/LegendaryEvent_desc_long:
The {[G_HRE_NAME]} takes place over {[AMOUNT]} days. Amass {[G_HRE_SCORE_POINTS_WITH_ICON]} to ultimately Unlock and Promote the featured Character.

Reach {[G_HRE_SCORE_POINTS_WITH_ICON]} milestones to earn {[G_HRE_CURRENCIES_WITH_ICON]} and open event crates containing {[G_HRE_SHARDS_WITH_ICON]} and other rewards.

Each Character's event will come back a number of times and you retain your amassed {[G_HRE_SCORE_POINTS_WITH_ICON]} and progress between events featuring that same Character.

Have fun!
LiveEvents/LegendaryEvent_preview_subtit: Defeat waves of enemies to Unlock and Promote the featured Character!
LiveEvents/March_2026_desc_long: On March 17th, the five-day "Benedictions of the Omnissiah" event begins, offering Actus shards and shop rewards for all Adeptus Mechanicus. A Calendar Offer will also start on the same day, bringing gifts for all. Boost your event progress with the "Faction Focus" and Power-ups Tournament Arena. Get ready for an exciting week full of rewards!
LiveEvents/MowEvent_desc_long:
This recurring event lets you pick a Machine of War to try to unlock and gain resources for.
Fight series of 15 battles that get tougher as you progress. Watch out: damage and defeated characters carry over between battles!
LiveEvents/Mythic_01_desc_long:
Tactician, the Mythic Celebration is almost here! Join this special two-week event and unlock rewards your way with rotating daily deals in the Mythic Celebration shop, letting you choose the prizes that best power up your roster.
Boost your progress by taking part in the Mythic Training Rush, the Faction Wars – Conquest Tournament Arena, and Blessed Requisitions—all running as part of the celebration. These events fuel your ability to claim even more rewards, helping your forces grow stronger throughout this limited-time event!
LiveEvents/SpaceMarine2_desc_long: Join us in celebrating the launch of Space Marine 2 by welcoming Lt. Titus to Tacticus with a new Epic Battle Pass, the all-new Survival game mode, a special event calendar, and more!
LiveEvents/Spring_2024_desc_long: Join the Hunt for the Fallen starting April 14 with an all-new Battle Pass, exclusive rewards, special offers, an infested tournament, and more!
LiveEvents/Spring_2024_title: Asmodai arrives in Tacticus with the Hunt for the Fallen event!
LiveEvents/SyncPvpEvent_desc_long: Welcome to this live Tournament, where only the most canny of tacticians can find ultimate glory in the dust of the Arena! .Play real live matches against other players online. .To put the focus on gameplay and skill, all Heroes are capped to Common in these early events. .These battles give limited XP due to the capping of the Heroes Tournament Arena is constantly being evaluated and developed further based on input from you, the players. Join the Tacticus Discord to help shape new Game Modes like this!

News/LokiSoftLaunch_description: Tacticus is an all-new experience in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, built around fast-paced tactical skirmishes. Collect your favourite Characters, some famous and some completely new, strengthen them over time and deploy them in skill-based battles to outplay your enemies! This is an alpha release with the game’s foundation in place. Come with us on this journey as we build up Tacticus to its full potential! Join our Discord server here Coming additions include: .A competitive Guild raids game mode .Several new game modes and live events .More campaign levels and enemies .The Chaos and Xenos tracks of the Onslaught game mode .Lots of Factions and Characters to collect and battle with .and many, many more things... Please note: Since this is an early build, we may have to reset progress at some point before releasing to worldwide audiences later this year. IF we do so, any money spent in-game will be credited to your new account as premium currency – in Tacticus known as Blackstone. We’ll also find a way to reward players for their progress in-game, and being part of the early Tacticus community. Any and all plans will be communicated in this space beforehand. Lastly, we hope you’ll enjoy Tacticus as much as we enjoy building it for you! The Tacticus team
News/LokiSoftLaunch_subtitle: What’s in this limited alpha release? Read all about it here
News/LokiSpotlightVindicta_description: We get to know Battle Sister Vindicta early in the game. As the sole survivor of her squad, she burns with even more holy fervour than the average Sister! Vindicta is a Celestian and as such recognised as amongst the most level-headed, imperturbable and bloodily determined of all her kind. A veteran of countless campaigns, she wields her brutal Heavy Flamer with both fury and precision. Her Active Ability, Armorium Cherub, lets her use her trusty companion to instantly reload her Heavy Flamer and fire again. Burn the heretics a second time! Her passive Ability, Fire of Absolution, is available once she has ascended to Uncommon rarity, and adds even more heat to her fire. Even enemies adjacent to her initial targets now get enveloped by the cleansing flames!
News/LokiSpotlightVindicta_subtitle: The first Character of Adepta Sororitas
News/LokiWarhammerIntro_description: Fight for the future of humanity across a vicious, war-torn galaxy. Welcome to Warhammer 40,000, the thrilling hobby of wargaming! This game universe is set in the grim darkness of the far future, where mighty armies clash on countless war-torn worlds and Humanity stands alone, beset on all sides by the threats of the heretic, the mutant and the alien. There is no mercy. There is no respite. Prepare yourself for battle. Learn much more about the wider hobby, of which Tacticus is only a small part, here: https://www.warhammer40000.com
News/LokiWarhammerIntro_subtitle: In the grim darkness of the far future there is only war

Resources/TieredRewardPoints_anniversary:
For the duration of the Anniversary Event, you gain 2 Anniversary Points each time you defeat an enemy wave in survival and 1 Anniversary point for each enemy wave you defeat in any other wave-based mode.
Use Anniversary Points to claim the Anniversary Event rewards.

You can find the event in the Home Screen tab.
Resources/TieredRewardPoints_campaign_ev:
For the duration of the Campaign Event, you earn <style="CE_Points">Progress points</style> for each victory in a battle (including raids), scoring 1-2-3 medals during a battle, scoring Lightning Victory for the first time and scoring <style="Bronze_Medal">Bronze</style>, <style="Silver_Medal">Silver</style> and <style="Gold_Medal">Gold</style> milestone medals.

Use <style="CE_Points">Progress points</style> to claim Campaign Event Crates.

You can find the Event in the Battle Tab.
Resources/TieredRewardPoints_defeat_wave:
For the duration of the Against the Tide event, you earn points each time you defeat an enemy wave in Salvage Run, Onslaught, Survival and Legendary Release Event.
Use the Against the Tide Points to claim the event rewards.

You can find the event in the Home Screen tab.

Traits/ActOfFaith_Description: This unit gets +{[extraCritChance]}% <style="Stat_Chance">Crit Chance</style> and increases their <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit Damage</style> by {[extraCritDmgPct]}% each time a friendly <style="Aliance_Imperial">Imperial</style> unit dies or kills an enemy unit. Once this unit crits, this bonus resets.
Traits/Ambush_Description: The first time this unit is defeated, it leaves behind a <style="Decoy">decoy</style> and at the beginning of their next turn, if there is still a friendly decoy on the battlefield, it is resurrected with full <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> on a random friendly decoy and can immediately take a turn. <style="Character">Characters</style> resurrect before <style="NonCharacter">Non-Character</style> units.
Traits/BattleFatigue_Description: If a friendly unit is defeated in an adjacent hex, there’s a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> that this unit flees and is removed from the battle. <style="Stat_Chance">+{[chance_2]}%</style> if it was <style="Overkill">overkilled</style>.
Traits/BeastSlayer_Description: This unit deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with melee attacks to <style="Big_Target">Big Targets</style> and <style="Vehicle">Vehicles</style>. It also has an added <style="Stat_Chance">{[blockChance]}% chance</style> to <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> {[blockDmgPct]}% of its current <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> as Damage.
Traits/BeastSnagga_Description: Deals +{[extraDmgPct]}% <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> Damage to <style="Big_Target">Big Targets</style> and <style="Vehicle">Vehicles</style>. Has an added <style="Stat_Chance">{[blockChance]}% chance</style> to <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> {[blockDmgPct]}% of its max Health as Damage.
Traits/BigTarget_Description: Due to its size, this unit benefits less from cover but also provides some obstruction to enemy sighting. Does not get any bonuses from <style="Tile_Grass">Tall Grass</style> and <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style>. Adjacent friendly units receive <style="Stat_Hits">-1 hit</style> from <style="Stat_Range">ranged</style> attacks, to a minimum of 1. Cannot be displaced.
Traits/BlessingsOfKhorne_Description: Deals <style="Stat">{[extraDmgPct]}%</style> more damage and receives <style="Stat">{[dmgPctReduction]}%</style> less <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> for each unit that was defeated in melee this battle. Counts up to a maximum of {[nrOfHeroes]} defeated units.
Traits/BossAdjutant_Description: This unit takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[damagePctReduction]}% Damage</style>. At the end of each turn, this unit loses {[damagePct]}% of its current <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> for each time it was attacked that turn.
Traits/Camouflage_Description: <style="Stat_Range">Ranged</style> attacks against this character score <style="Stat_Hits">-1 hit</style>. This increases to <style="Stat_Hits">-2 hits</style> if this character is more than 2 hexes away from the attacker or to <style="Stat_Hits">-3 hits</style> when in <style="Tile_Grass">Tall Grass</style>. Attackers always score at least <style="Stat_Hits">1 hit</style>.
Traits/CloseCombatWeakness_Description: Whenever this unit is adjacent – or started the turn adjacent – to enemy units, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style> with <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> attacks and <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgPctReduction_2]}% Damage</style> with <style="Stat_Range">ranged</style> attacks.
Traits/ContagionsOfNurgle_Description:
This unit is surrounded by an aura that expands over time. Enemies have {[armorReduction]}% <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> while in this aura. If they stand in two or more overlapping enemy auras, they have {[armorReduction2]}% <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> instead.

Aura:
Round 1-2: <style="Stat_Range">range 1</style>
Round 3-4: <style="Stat_Range">range 2</style>
Round 5+: <style="Stat_Range">range 3</style>
Traits/ContagionsOfNurgle_RealtimeDataDe: [i2p_Plural]The current range is {[rangeCurrent]} hexes.[i2p_One]The current range is {[rangeCurrent]} hex.
Traits/CrushingStrike_Description: This unit deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with normal <style="Stat_Melee">Melee</style> attacks if it has not moved this turn.
Traits/Daemon_Description: This unit has an additional <style="Stat_Chance">{[blockChance]}% chance</style> to <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> up to {[blockDmgPct]}% of its own current <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> stat.
Traits/Dakka_Description: For attacks with <style="Stat_Range">range 3</style> or more, has <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hits</style> if the target is at <style="Stat_Range">range 2</style>.
Traits/Diminutive_Description: Due to its tiny stature, this unit reduces incoming multi-hit attacks by <style="Stat_Hits">{[hitsReduction]} hit</style>, to a minimum of 1.
Traits/Emplacement_Description: This unit always deals <style="Stat_Damage">{[damageModifier]}% Damage</style> in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> and its <style="Stat_Range">ranged</style> attacks deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[damageModifier_2]}% Damage</style> if it has not moved this turn.
Traits/Explodes_Description: This unit <style="Explodes">explodes</style> on death, dealing <style="Stat">25%</style> of its max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> as <style="DMG_Direct">Direct Damage</style> to all adjacent units
Traits/FinalJustice_Description: When this unit loses its last <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>, it immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> on an eligible target and is then defeated as normal, unless <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>
Traits/Flying_Description: Can traverse impassable hexes and enemies and move between any elevation.
Traits/GetStuckIn_Description: For every 2 hits this unit scores with an attack against an enemy within range 2, it has a <style="STAT">{[chance]}%</style> chance to score an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. If 2 or more friendly <style="Faction_Orks">Orks</style> or 4 or more friendly units are adjacent to the target, the chance is increased to <style="STAT">{[chance_2]}%</style>.
Traits/Healer_Description:
Can <style="Healing">heal</style> a friendly unit as its action.
The amount of <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> restored equals the Healer’s <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> multiplied by the highest number of <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> of any of their weapons.
Traits/HeavyWeapon_Description: When this unit has not moved this turn, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with ranged attacks.
Traits/Immune_Description:
This unit is immune to special hexes and <style="HexEffect">hex effects</style>, and cannot have its <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style>, <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style>, <style="Stat_Movement">Movement</style> or <style="Stat_Range">Range</style> reduced.

Additionally, this unit cannot be <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style>, <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> or <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style>, and does not receive knockback damage.
Traits/Impervious_Description: Has to be hit by a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style> to take any Damage, but is instantly defeated by a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style>.
Traits/IndirectFire_Description: Can fire over <style="Out_Of_Sight">obscuring</style> hexes and hit targets in <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style>
Traits/InstinctiveBehaviour_Description: If there are targets in range, this unit does not move and attacks the closest target.
Traits/LetTheGalaxyBurn_Description: All attacks have a <style="Stat">{[chance]}% chance</style> to score an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> and add <style="Tile_DespoiledGround">Despoiled Ground</style> to the hex of the attacked unit. If the attacked unit is already on a hex with a <style="HexEffect">hex effect</style>, the attack automatically scores an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> but does not add <style="Tile_DespoiledGround">Despoiled Ground</style>.
Traits/LivingMetal_Description: <style="Regenerate">Regenerates</style> <style="Stat">{[hpPct]}%</style> of its max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> at the start of the players' turn. This unit is also <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style>
Traits/MachineOfWar_Description:
<style="MoW">Machines of War</style> stand beside the battlefield and provide two additional powerful abilities to use multiple times during the battle. Some of them cost <style="Resource_MachinesOfWarAmmo">Munitions</style> and some have a <style="Cooldown">cooldown</style> before you can use them. Machines of War cannot be targeted in their off-battlefield position and are destroyed when a battle is lost. 

Not every game mode allows to field Machines of War!
Traits/MartialKatah_Description: <style="NormalAttack">Normal attacks</style> against this unit deal <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style>. This unit deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with all attacks against <style="Summon">Summons</style>.
Traits/Mechanic_Description:
Can <style="Repairing">repair</style> a friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit as its action.
The amount of <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> restored equals the <style="Mechanic">Mechanic</style>'s Damage multiplied by the highest number of <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> of any of their weapons.
Traits/Mechanical_Description: Cannot be healed, but can be repaired instead. Note: units with the Living Metal trait also count as being Mechanical
Traits/MkXGravis_Description: Any incoming <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> has to go through <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> a second time. Does not apply to <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crits</style>
Traits/Object_Description: Automatically takes its action, if any, at the beginning of the turn. Cannot be <style="Healing">healed</style> or <style="Repairing">repaired</style>. A player loses the battle if their only remaining units are <style="Object">Objects</style>
Traits/Overwatch_Description: If this unit has not attacked during its turn, nor after that, it attacks when an enemy moves within range during the enemy's turn
Traits/Parry_Description: This unit reduces incoming <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> multi-hit attacks by <style="Stat_Hits">{[hitsReduction]} hit</style>, to a minimum of 1.
Traits/PrioritisedEfficiency_Description:
At the beginning of each turn and until the end of that turn, this unit gains an effect depending on its stance. Whenever a friendly <style="Character">character</style> with <style="PrioritisedEfficiency">Prioritised Efficiency</style> uses an active ability, the stance switches for all friendly units with this trait.

Hostile Acquisition: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with all attacks and gains <style="Stat_Movement">+1 Movement</style>.
Fortify Takeover: Takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style>.
Traits/Psyker_Description: When this unit performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal ranged attack</style>, it also deals {[extraDmgPct]}% of its <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to a random enemy adjacent to the target.
Traits/PutridExplosion_Description: This unit explodes when defeated, dealing {[extraDmgPct]}% of its max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> as <style="DMG_Toxic">Toxic</style> Damage to all adjacent units except to <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Death Guard</style> units.
Traits/RangedSpecialist_Description: If this unit did not start its turn adjacent to an enemy unit, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with ranged attacks.
Traits/RapidAssault_Description: This unit has <style="Stat_Movement">+1 Movement</style> until it makes either a melee or ranged attack. Its first attack each battle and all following attacks it makes in the same turn deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style>.
Traits/Resilient_Description: If this unit is not already at <style="Stat_Health">1 Health</style> and would be defeated, its <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> is instead reduced to <style="Stat_Health">1 Health</style>, unless <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>.
Traits/ShadowInTheWarp_Description: Enemy <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> within {[range]} hexes deal {[dmgPct]}% <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style>. Does not affect <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid</style> <style="Psyker">Psykers</style>.
Traits/Steppable_Description: Will be destroyed if stepped on or if damaged, but can not be targeted.
Traits/Summon_Description: Moves and attacks automatically at the beginning of its turn
Traits/SuppressiveFire_Description: An enemy hit by this unit’s ranged attack becomes <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>.
Traits/Swarm_Description:
Attacks with <style="Stat_Hits">1 hit</style> per individual member of the swarm. Each incoming hit can deal <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> only to one member. Does not apply to <style="DMG_Blast">Blast Damage</style>.
For each member defeated, the swarm attacks with 1 fewer <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. 
<style="Healing">Healing</style> this unit can revive dead members of the swarm.
Traits/Synapse_Description: Friendly units within 2 hexes ignore the effects of <style="Instinctive_Behaviour">Instinctive Behaviour</style> and <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style>.
Traits/TeleportStrike_Description:
This unit starts the battle in Deep Strike. 

Units in Deep Strike can move to any free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy, or they can move normally from their current position. They cannot be targeted or damaged until they have taken an action or ended their turn.
Traits/TerminatorArmour_Description: The first attack each turn against this unit deals <style="Stat">{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style>. <style="Stat_Hits">Hits</style> dealing <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic</style> or <style="DMG_Direct">Direct</style> Damage are excluded. This unit cannot be <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>.
Traits/ThrillSeekers_Description: Each turn, when this unit takes Damage or targets an enemy with full Health, it becomes Thrilled for {[nrOfRounds]} round. While Thrilled, its Crit Chance is increased by +{[extraCritChance]}% and if it defeats an enemy with a Crit, that enemy is always overkilled.
Traits/TwoManTeam_Description: Takes a maximum of <style="Stat">50%</style> of its max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> in <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> from a single <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. Does not apply to <style="DMG_Blast">Blast Damage</style>. Once below <style="Stat">50%</style> of its max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>, cannot be <style="Healing">healed</style> above <style="Stat">50%</style> of its max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> again.
Traits/Unstoppable_Description: This unit does not have to stop on special hexes and <style="HexEffect">hex effects</style> that would normally force a unit to end their <style="Stat_Movement">Movement</style>.
Traits/Vehicle_Description: This unit does not have to stop on special hexes and <style="HexEffect">hex effects</style> that would normally force a unit to end their <style="Stat_Movement">Movement</style>. Does not get any bonuses from <style="Tile_Grass">Tall Grass</style> and <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style>. This unit is also <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style>.
Traits/WeaverOfFate_Description: In any turn where 3 or more enemy units have taken <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style>, this unit will deal the maximum possible <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> with its attacks and abilities on that turn.

Tutorial/tut_ce01_intro_b: They are the custodians of all of Mankind’s technological knowledge, appointed by ancient covenants with the Emperor himself. With great reverence and elaborate ritual, robed Tech-Priests oversee the fabrication, maintenance and repair of every device crafted by Mankind, and view the careful protection of every scrap of ancient information as their religious duty. Strange creations lumber forward at their command, energies that primitives consider magical are summoned and technologies from ages best forgotten are unleashed in destructive tempests.
Tutorial/tut_ce02_intro_b: The Tyranids are a race of alien predators that are invading the galaxy from the void beyond its edges. Like swarming insects falling upon precious crops, they devour all before them – consuming all life upon each world in their path, and leaving nothing but airless rocks in their wake.
Tutorial/tut_ce02_intro_d: They are a threat to every sentient species in the galaxy, and their numbers are evergrowing. A billion times a billion Tyranids stand at the rim of the galaxy, yet each one is no more than a single cell in the living body of a single great entity that stretches over light years of space: The immortal Tyranid Hive Mind, the Great Devourer.
Tutorial/tut_ce03_intro_b: The T'au Empire is amongst the most dynamic and determined powers in the 41st Millenium. Their technology is advanced and ever-improving, from grav-skimming gunships and artificial intelligence, to potent energy weapons and formidable battlesuits. Their territories expand with every victory, be it diplomatic or military.
Tutorial/tut_ce03_intro_d: When the T’au attack, they come suddenly from the firmament with overwhelming speed and firepower, seeking to prove to their enemies the hopelessness of standing against those unified by the T'au'va - the Greater Good.
Tutorial/tut_ce04_intro_b: They are the grind of rotted bone crushed beneath trudging yet tireless feet. They are the wet rattle of pestilent breath, the shriek of rusted gears chewing meat, the hurricane drone of all the wings of all the flies that ever hatched. They are the relentless swing of the reaper's scythe. They are the Death Guard. They are Doom.
Tutorial/tut_ce04_intro_d: The Death Guard advance amidst rolling smog banks of spore-thick fumes and whirling flies. Blessed by the Plague God Nurgle and commanded by their Daemon Primarch Mortarion, these mutated warriors are incredibly resilient and unleash the grim powers of alchemy, sorcery and supernatural contagion to wither and ruin their foes.
Tutorial/tut_ce05_intro_b: The Orders of the Adepta Sororitas are the defenders of the Imperial Creed, waging wars of faith in the name of the God-Emperor. Their campaigns are defined by unwavering belief, as battle psalms echo across war zones and Sisters advance under sacred rites to deliver the Emperor’s judgement.
Tutorial/tut_ce05_intro_d:
The Sisters of Battle fight equipped with finely crafted wargear and weapons of the Imperial faith, the bolter, the flamer and the melta. The Emperor’s blessings accompany them into battle, granting acts of supernatural fortitude and divine strength.
Blasphemers, heretics, mutants and xenos - No enemy of the faith lies beyond the judgement of the God-Emperor.

The war has started!

Tutorial/tut_guild_war_set_defence_2: For each lineup, your guild's chosen battlefield level defines a maximum rarity that all defenders and attackers will be capped at during battle.
Tutorial/tut_guild_war_set_defence_3: The panel border of each lineup shows its maximum rarity at a glance.
Tutorial/tut_guild_war_start_attack_1: Select one of the enemy lineups and start a battle. Your characters will be <style="Capped">capped</style> at the same rarity as the defenders are.
Tutorial/tut_guild_war_start_attack_2: Important: Each character can only be used once for attacking per war.
Tutorial/tut_guild_war_start_attack_3: During a battle you score the highest if you defeat an enemy lineup in one attack without losing a character. Eliminating all defenders in a whole war zone increases your guild's score drastically.
Tutorial/tut_guild_war_swap_1: As a guild officer or leader you have additional options to optimize your guild's battle plan:
Tutorial/tut_guild_war_swap_2: Use "Edit War Zones" to switch up the path your opponents have to take through your guild's layered defenses of war zones. Note: Some zones cannot be moved.
Tutorial/tut_guild_war_swap_3: Use "Swap Players" inside a war zone to change the position of defending guild members between war zones.

Choose your attacks well, as you can only play a few battles per day to either attack the Boss or weaken it with a Kill Team.

UI/GuildWars_Screen_Info_Tooltip: Welcome to Guild War! Compete and fight against other guilds for glory and rewards in a season of 6 wars. Each war consists of a 24-hour preparation phase (except the first war in a season) and a 36-hour war phase, where two guilds face off. During the preparation phase, guild members can enlist in the war by claiming one of the two sections in any of the 15 War Zones. They must then set up their defensive lineups with their units. Additionally, guild leaders must choose a Battlefield Level. Higher levels provide better rewards and a higher War Score, but also pose a bigger challenge. During the war phase, each player has 10 War Tokens to attack the opponent's lineups and increase their guild's war score. The war score ultimately determines which guild wins the war and contributes directly to each guild's leaderboard position. Participation requirements: .Guild members must be Power Level 20+ .Your guild must meet the Guild Power requirement of a Battlefield Level .Your guild must be at least Guild Level 3

UI/GuildWars_WarZone_InfoButton: Each War Zone has two sections to claim. By claiming one of them, you will automatically enlist in a war. Your units are crucial to defend your claimed war zone section. Set up 5 defensive lineups, each with 5 characters and 1 Machine of War, that will try to hold the opposing guild back. Each unit can only be used in one defensive lineup. This has no influence on their availability for attacking the opponent. You can always adjust your defensive lineups during the preparation phases, but once a war has started, the selected units and their stats become locked: any changes to your units will only become effective from the following war. This locking mechanic is limited to Guild War's defensive lineups and has no impact on other game modes. Any war zone sections left unclaimed at the beginning of the war are filled with the default defenders. The strength of these defenders depends on the War Zone Tier, which is influenced by the Battlefield Level.
UI/GuildWars_WarZone_InfoButton_Attack:
Each war you have 10 <style="Resource_GuildWars_Token">War Tokens</style> to attack the opposing guild's <style="KEY_not_underscored">War Zones</style> and increase your guild's <style="Resource_GuildWarsPoints">War Score</style>.

To attack, choose an available war zone and try to defeat the opponent's defensive lineup in battle. Each attack costs one war token and each of your units can only be deployed once per war, so choose wisely!

Once all 10 opponents' lineups in a war zone are defeated, you can progress and attack any adjacent war zone. Once all opponents' war zones on the battlefield are defeated, the opposing guild is wiped out. Their defences are reset and your guild can attack all war zones another time to drive up your war score.

Each <style="MoW">Machine of War</style> - once at Mythic - unlocks a new unique passive Ability.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Ascensio: Ascend Legendary characters to Mythic and unleash their full potential with new Items, Abilities and Ranks to gain!
Real power is earned on the battlefield: No character unlocks at Mythic rarity - that can be achieved only through ascension.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Campaign: There is a new Mythic tier in Extremis campaigns with increased battle and crate rewards. The standard battles now have higher drop rates as well.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Characte: Mythic rarity is reached only through ascension and extends all progression lanes: adding more XP levels, Ability levels, Ranks and Promotions.
Initially, one additional Rank and 5 of the 15 new XP levels are available. Ranks II and III, along with the remaining XP levels, will unlock in the coming months.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Crafting: Many craftable Upgrades now require fewer ingredients to be crafted.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_DropChan: Standard and Mirror campaigns have higher drop rates and you can now win each Elite and Elite Mirror battle 6 times per day instead of 3, making raiding more effective.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Energy: An additional daily low-cost <style="Resource_Stamina">Energy</style> purchase step has been added, and the payout of the first is increased from <style="Resource_Stamina">50</style> to <style="Resource_Stamina">60</style>.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_ForgeBad: Use these badges to forge more powerful weapons than ever before!
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Grimoire: More experience for your characters: This new XP book is a great read and instantly grants 62500 XP.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_GuildRai: Raid bosses can now also appear as Mythic - with challenge and rewards to fit their ascension.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_GuildWar: The battle just got fiercer - the new Legendary cap on some war zones might limit the mayhem!
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_HeroQues: Take on a new Legendary battle, the added Mythic tier, and earn even more reward crates!
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Incursio: Face new challenges in the Mythic tier in revamped and new Incursion events.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Legendar: Added harder encounters with increased rewards, allowing progress all the way up to Mythic for the strongest players.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Mission: The new Mythic Journey mission chain unlocks when a character reaches the final <style="StarLegendary">Legendary star</style>. Its rewards bring the character to their Mythic ascension and may include a Mythic item or even a Relic.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Mission_: For new characters released in Character Release Events, Mythic Missions trigger right after the event. For new characters released in Legendary events, they trigger as normal when the character reaches the final <style="StarLegendary">Legendary star</style>.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_MythicAb:
Used to upgrade your Abilities once at Mythic rarity.

To ease the transition, the upgrade cost for Ability level 50 has been greatly reduced.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_MythicOr: Use Mythic orbs to ascend Legendary characters to Mythic and promote them even further!
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_MythicSa: These precious materials are used to level up Mythic Items and Relics
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_MythicSh: Used to ascend Legendary characters to Mythic, and to promote them further. If a character is at the last Legendary star or already Mythic, dropped regular Shards from the blessed requisitions convert into a smaller number of Mythic ones.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_MythicUp:
Used in the new powerful Adamantine Ranks that are accessible once at Mythic.

Adamantine I is available from the start, while Adamantine II and III will come later.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_NewItems:
The new Mythic items bring crits and blocks higher than ever.

Some Mythic items are Relics, which enable powerful new abilities but are hard to come by.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Relics: Powerful Mythic-only Items which add a new tactical layer to the battlefield.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Relics_T: Each character, once at Mythic, can equip a specific Relic, which adds a special ability to the character’s skill set. While not all Relics will be available at launch, more will be introduced with future releases to expand each character's potential even further.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Resource: Character unlock missions have more rewards. The Daily Mission now awards <style="Resource_Stamina">Energy</style>. Requisitions give more Shards.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Description_Shops: Each shop is more focused on specific resource types. Stock has been increased and prices reduced for many deals. Daily deals now include "draft rewards", offering a choice of resources.
UI/MythicIntroPopup_Title_Page_04_Discla: Many game modes and events have been adjusted to support Mythic
UI/MythicReleaseIntroPopup_Claim_Descrip: Mythic ascensions and missions chains are available now! See the full list of changes in the patch notes in the Hobby Hub, and join the discussion on the Tacticus Discord - we look forward to your feedback! UnbreakableDuty_Next
UI/MythicReleaseIntroPopup_Teaser_Descri:
For more details, check out the patch notes in the Hobby Hub!

UI/Survival_BPP_Tooltip_Description:
Your goal is to withstand as many waves of enemies as possible in a single battle. Every battle starts with the featured <style="Character">character</style> and your chosen lineup. The rarity cap starts at Common, but increases when you defeat specific waves. 

Defeating waves can also spawn power-ups that can reactivate abilities, grant a shield to future reinforcements, heal, improve stats, or provide Reinforcement Points (which allow you to replace fallen characters through a draft system).

The waves increase in difficulty, culminating in an almost impossible final wave, designed to test the most skilled and powerful players. Your score increases each time you damage or kill an enemy, defeat a wave, or trigger a wave early—fortune favours the bold! Your high score ultimately determines your position on the event's leaderboard.

Prepare for a battle of endurance, where every decision matters and survival is the ultimate goal!

UI/WavesGameMode_Description:
Defeat a series of waves of enemies using ALL your <style="Character">Characters</style> from one grand alliance and above a certain <style="Power_Level">Power score</style>.
 
Each wave you defeat instantly grants you <style="Onslaught_Level">Onslaught XP</style> and a one-time reward.

Every time one of your Characters is defeated, a new one can be drafted to join the fray: choose wisely between the two proposed replacements!
UI/WavesGameMode_Description_New:
Face relentless waves of enemies using all your Imperial, Xenos, or Chaos units, depending on the track you choose.

When one of your <style="Character">Characters</style> falls, you can draft a replacement to take their place. Each choice matters, so pick wisely from the options offered.

Defeating a wave rewards you with <style="Onslaught_Level">Tyranid Skulls</style> and one or more Ability Badges.

Honour your warriors: at the end of each battle, select one of your deployed units to receive additional rewards, including Shards, Ability Badges, and Ascension Orbs.

Each planet is divided into sectors with a rarity and rank that reflect enemy strength. When you unlock sectors of a new rank material, the previous three sectors collapse into a single one.

After unlocking all sectors on a planet, filling the Eradication Tier progress bar will transport you to a new planet, introducing fresh terrain and new battle conditions.
