UnitEffects/NornCrown_Description: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> to enemies affected by <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style>
UnitEffects/OnMyPosition_ExtraDamagePct_: Takes <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> from ranged attacks by <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> <style="Character">characters</style>
UnitEffects/Overwatch_AutoAttack_Descrip: This unit will attack the first enemy who moves into range, unless that unit has the <style="Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> trait or <style=Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> effect
UnitEffects/PhoenixGem_CanRevive_Descrip: When defeated, revives with <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> remaining, even if <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>
UnitEffects/Pinned_Description: This unit deals <style="Stat_Damage">-{[pinnedDmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> and moves with <style="Stat_Movement">-{[pinnedMovementReduction]} Movement</style> for 1 round. <style="Overwatch">Overwatch</style> cannot be used. <style="Healing">Healing</style> or <style="Repairing">repairing</style> removes the effect, but does not activate Overwatch again in this turn.
UnitEffects/PowerTrip_FullHealth_Descrip: <style="NormalAttack">Normal attacks</style> score <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> and reduce the target's Armour by <style="Stat_Armor">{[armorReduction]} Armour</style>, but <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> loses <style="Stat">{[hpPct]}%</style> of his maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> after the attack.
UnitEffects/PowerUp_Armor_Description: Increases Armour by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of the unit's max Health
UnitEffects/PowerUp_Bomb_Description: When picked up, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all enemy units within range {[range]} of the bomb. Cannot be triggered by enemy units.
UnitEffects/PowerUp_Health_Description: Increases Health by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of the unit's max Health
UnitEffects/PredictiveGuidance_Melee_Des: Takes +{[extraDmg]} Damage from melee attacks by Leagues of Votann or Mechanical units and Leagues of Votann units score an additional hit with all attacks against this unit. Attacks made by Âmmuk are unaffected by Predictive Guidance.
UnitEffects/PredictiveGuidance_Ranged_De: Takes +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage from ranged attacks by Leagues of Votann or Mechanical units and Leagues of Votann units score an additional hit with all attacks against this unit. Attacks made by Âmmuk are unaffected by Predictive Guidance.
UnitEffects/PrioritisedEfficiency_Hostil: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with all attacks and has <style="Stat_Movement">+1 Movement</style>.
UnitEffects/PsychicStalk_VisualEffect_De: Takes additional damage from <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic</style> and <style="DMG_Flame">Flame</style> attacks
UnitEffects/RapidAssault_ExtraDamage_Des: This unit's next melee attack and all melee attacks in the same turn deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> Damage</style>
UnitEffects/RedThirst_ExtraDamageAndHit_: When <style="Charging">charging</style>, gains <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and scores <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> .
UnitEffects/Regenerate_Description: At the start of any following battle during this run, the <style="Character">characters</style> you choose for your lineup regenerate {[hpPct]}% of their maximum <style="Stat_Health">health</style>
UnitEffects/RelicBoltPistol_ExtraCritDam: Deals <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> with ranged attacks. Doubled against <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> or <style="Aliance_Xenos">Xenos</style> units.
UnitEffects/RelicBoltPistol_ExtraPierce_: Has <style="Piercing_Ratio">+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> with all melee attacks. Doubled against <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> or <style="Aliance_Xenos">Xenos</style> units.
UnitEffects/Resurrect_Description: Resurrects a character and restores its <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> to 100%. Starting with the next battle, the character can be deployed in battle again.
UnitEffects/Revealed_Description: Enemy Aeldari ignore hit reductions and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% damage against this unit.
UnitEffects/RitesOfMorkai_Description: If defeated, revives with <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>, unless <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>.
UnitEffects/SagaOfTheWarriorBorn_OtherSp: [i2p_Plural]When <style="Charging">charging</style>, this unit scores <style="Stat">{[extraHits]}</style> additional <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> and critical hits deal an additional <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style>.[i2p_One]When <style="Charging">charging</style>, this unit scores <style="Stat">{[extraHits]}</style> additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> and critical hits deal an additional <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style>.
UnitEffects/ShroudPsalm_Description: <style="NormalAttack">Normal attacks</style> against this unit score <style="Stat_Hits">-{[hitsReduction]} hits</style>, to a minimum of 1.
UnitEffects/Skullsmasher_ExtraDamage_Des: Deals +{[extraDmgCurrent]} damage with melee attacks (+{[extraDmg]} for every {[hpPct]}% of health missing)
UnitEffects/SmashaEad_Description: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} damage</style> with normal attacks and receives <style="STAT">{[dmgReductionPct]}%</style> less incoming damage.
UnitEffects/SorcerousFacade_AdditionalHi: Deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> with normal attacks.
UnitEffects/SquigMine_Tile_Description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to the first enemy that occupies this hex
UnitEffects/StandVigil_ExtraDmg_Descript: Deals +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage with attacks that are not <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style>
UnitEffects/StructuralAnalyserDmgBoost_D: This unit's ranged attacks deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> Damage against targets with a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>
UnitEffects/Stunned_Description: This unit has only <style="Stat_Movement">1 Movement</style>, deals <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> and cannot use active Abilities. <style="Healing">Healing</style> or <style="Repairing">repairing</style> removes the effect.
UnitEffects/Summons_Description: [i2p_Plural]{[nrOfSummons]} friendly {[UNIT_NAME]}'s will join you on the battlefield. [i2p_One]{[nrOfSummons]} friendly {[UNIT_NAME]} will join you on the battlefield.
UnitEffects/Supercharge_ExtraPiercing_De: <style="Stat_Hits">Hits</style> that deal <style="DMG_Plasma">Plasma Damage</style> against this unit have <style="Piercing_Ratio">+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style>. <style="Healing">Healing</style> or <style="Repairing">repairing</style> removes the effect.
UnitEffects/SuppressRangeCloseCombatWeak: This unit ignores the <style="Combat_Weakness">Close Combat Weakness</style> trait for ranged attacks until the end of their turn.
UnitEffects/Taunted_CantUseAbility_Descr: <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style> units are forced to attack the taunting unit. They can’t move away, use their Active Ability, Heal, Repair, or attack another target. <style="Healing">Healing</style> or <style="Repairing">repairing</style> removes the effect.
UnitEffects/TerminatorArmour_ReduceDmg_D: The first attack each turn against this unit deals <style="Stat">{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style>. Hits dealing <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic</style> or <style="DMG_Direct">Direct</style> Damage are excluded.
UnitEffects/TerminatorArmour_Visual_Desc: The first attack each turn against this unit deals <style="Stat">{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style>. Hits dealing <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic</style> or <style="DMG_Direct">Direct</style> Damage are excluded.
UnitEffects/TheBetrayer_Description: At the start of each turn, Khârn will automatically move up to {[range]} hexes and attack.
UnitEffects/TheBloodyHanded_Description: Has <style="Unstoppable">Unstoppable</style> and deals <style="Stat_Damage">{[extraDmg]}</style> additional damage against enemies standing on a hex on <style="Effect_Fire">fire</style>.
UnitEffects/ThinVeil_ExtraDamage_Descrip: Deals {[extraDmgPct]}% damage and summons a random Daemon with this unit's level, when defeated. The Daemon will be an enemy to both sides.
UnitEffects/ThriceBlessedConflagration_E: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with all attacks to enemies on <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style> hexes
UnitEffects/ThriceBlessedConflagration_R: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> with ranged attacks to enemies on <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style> hexes
UnitEffects/ThrillSeekers_Description: <style="Stat_CritChance">Crit Chance</style> is increased by <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}%</style> and if this unit defeats an enemy with a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style>, that enemy is <style="Obliterated">always overkilled</style>.
UnitEffects/TileContaminated_Description: Units standing on or starting their turn on hexes with <style="Tile_Contamination">Contamination</style> have <style="Stat_Armor">-30% armor</style> for 1 round. <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> and <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagions of Nurgle</style> units are not affected. Contamination disappears after 2 rounds.
UnitEffects/TileDespoiledGround_Descript: Units starting their turn on a <style="Tile_DespoiledGround">Despoiled Ground</style> hex take {[DespoiledGroundMinDmgPct]}-{[DespoiledGroundMaxDmgPct]}% of their initial <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> as <style="DMG_Direct">Direct Damage</style>. Affected <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units also deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[DespoiledGroundExtraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> to <style="Aliance_Xenos">Xenos</style> or <style="Aliance_Imperial">Imperial</style> enemies. The effect disappears after 2 rounds.
UnitEffects/TileFire_Description:
Units entering a hex with <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style> must stop. They receive 20% of their initial <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> as <style="DMG_Flame">Flame</style> Damage if they start their turn on it.

The effect disappears after 2 rounds.
UnitEffects/TileIce_Description:
Units entering a hex with <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style> end their movement. Units on hexes with <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style> take {[IceCritDmgBonusPct]}% more <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit Damage</style>. 

The effect disappears after 2 rounds.
UnitEffects/UnbreakableDuty_DamageReduct: Takes <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> less damage from incoming attacks.
UnitEffects/Waaagh_Description: Has <style="Stat_Movement">+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> and <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and score <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]}x hit</style>.
UnitEffects/WarConstruct_CounterAttack_D: If there is no enemy adjacent to the <style="Faction_Aeldari">Wraithguard</style> it shoots back at each enemy within range that attacks it or friendly adjacent <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style>.
UnitEffects/WarHowl_ExtraDamage_Unstoppa: Is <style="Unstoppable">Unstoppable</style> and <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style> have <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance</style> and deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.
UnitEffects/WayOfTheShortBlade_Additiona: When this unit performs a Melee attack, they also immediately perform a normal ranged attack against the same unit, even if they are adjacent to it
UnitEffects/WayOfTheShortBlade_DamageBuf: Normal ranged attacks against enemies that are adjacent to a friendly character have ignore <style="Stat_Armor">{[armorIgnored]} Armour</style> and deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style>, except attacks that deal <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic</style> Damage.
UnitEffects/WeakerRearArmourTarget_Descr: <style="Stat_Chance">Crit Chance</style> against the Rogal Dorn increased by <style="Stat">{[extraCritChance]}%</style>
UnitEffects/WeaverOfFate_MaxOutDamage_De: This unit always deals the maximum possible <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> with its attacks and abilities until the end of this turn.
UnitEffects/WireweaveNet_CounterAttack_D: The first time <style="Faction_Aeldari">Calandis</style> is targeted by a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style> during the enemy's turn, the attacker immediately takes <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style>. If the attacker is eliminated, their attack is not executed.
Units/adeptCanoness_Description: Canonesses are the martial and spiritual commanders of the Orders Militant. Each is a shining example of purity and dedication of purpose, a veteran warrior and a slayer of the faithless of many hundreds of battles.
Units/adeptCanoness_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Roswitha
Units/adeptCelestine_Description: Saint Celestine is a living embodiment of the Emperor’s might, and she radiates holy light. Beneath her, the faithful are filled with courage, while heretics experience overwhelming terror.
Units/adeptCelestine_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Celestine
Units/adeptExorcist_Description: Every flurry of notes performed by the Exorcist's artillerist loads and targets thrice-blessed rocket volleys to bombard the enemy. More than artillery tanks, Exorcists are mobile shrines to the magnificence of the Emperor that project inspirational battle canticles.
Units/adeptHospitaller_Description: Sisters of the Orders Hospitaller are the physical and spiritual healers of the Adepta Sororitas. As much as their medicinal expertise and surgical skill, they provide a source of faith to those in need.
Units/adeptHospitaller_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Isabella
Units/adeptMorvenn_Description: Morvenn Vahl is the current Abbess Sanctorum of the Adepta Sororitas and a High Lord of Terra. She goes to battle in the Paragon Warsuit Purgator Mirabilis.
Units/adeptMorvenn_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Morvenn Vahl
Units/adeptMorvenn_Title: Abbess Sanctorum of the Adepta Sororitas
Units/adeptRetributor_Description: Celestians are the finest and noblest warriors of their Order, inspirational figures who punish the faithless with relentless barrages of bolter fire and gouts of sacred flame.
Units/adeptRetributor_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Vindicta
Units/admecDestroyer_Description: These biomechanical constructs operate as mobile heavy weapons platforms, bearing large esoteric cannons. Their ballistic subroutines can be directed to operate independently of preprogrammed battle protocols, making them flexible tools of destruction.
Units/admecDominus_Description: These theocratic generals lead congregations of warriors in binharic prayer and direct those beneath them with precision strategies. They are masters of machines, as capable of healing damage to their creations as they are at destroying the enemy’s corrupted engines.
Units/admecDominus_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Vitruvius
Units/admecManipulus_Description: Amongst the augmentations of a Tech-Priest Manipulus is a galvanic cell from which they channel powerful charges of the Motive Force. They overcharge their warriors’ armaments, all while defending their divine work with blasts from their own arcane weapons.
Units/admecManipulus_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Actus
Units/admecMarshall_Description: Privileged to enhanced augmentations, Marshals are veteran warriors that stand as intermediaries between the Skitarii and their priestly masters, employing sacred uplinks to refine their warriors’ doctrines closer to holy perfection and lead the Skitarii to ensured victory.
Units/admecMarshall_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Tan Gi'da
Units/admecRuststalker_Description: Ruststalkers are unleashed to hunt down errant servo units and heretic blasphemers, or to pounce on isolated hostile units and assassinate enemy leaders. Their stilt-like limbs enable them to run down their prey before carving them apart with transonic blades.
Units/admecRuststalker_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Exitor-Rho-1.15/x
Units/astraBullgryn_Description: With their overwhelming physicality Ogryns are exceptional shock troops, and are regularly deployed on the front lines of battle. While often not the brightest stars, they take their duties very seriously.
Units/astraBullgryn_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Kut
Units/astraCreed_Description: Blistering assaults, devious traps and impenetrable defences as his trademarks, within three decades the ragged orphan boy Creed had earned acclaim as Cadia’s greatest commander and in Colour Sgt. Kell the most loyal voice to his command.
Units/astraCreed_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Creed
Units/astraCreed_Title: Lord General of the Astra Militarum
Units/astraDreir_Description: Lord Marshal Dreir leads from the front, despite his lofty rank, and often to the horror of his superiors. That he and his loyal Krieg steed have emerged from so many battles alive and victorious speaks to his skill as both commander and cavalry soldier.
Units/astraOrdnance_Description: Masters of Ordnance are the eyes on the battlefield, spotting for batteries of long-range weaponry nested far from the front lines. Wherever they direct their gaze, a rain of exploding shells is sure to follow.
Units/astraOrdnance_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Thaddeus Noble
Units/astraOrdnanceBattery_Description: Among the largest man-portable weapons fielded by the Astra Militarum are those crewed by Ordnance Teams. Such batteries are powerful assets, unleashing multiple warheads from their Malleus Rocket Launchers to vanquish the enemies of the Emperor.
Units/astraPrimarisPsy_Description: Primaris Psykers are rare and extraordinary individuals who wield the destructive power of the warp as a weapon to smite the enemies of the Emperor, their every action a walk on a fine line between heroic service and eternal damnation.
Units/astraPrimarisPsy_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Sibyll Devine
Units/astraYarrick_Description: At Hades Hive, Commissar Yarrick lost his right arm to the snapping battle klaw of an Ork Warboss. Fighting through pain and shock, Yarrick beheaded the Warboss and took that same klaw as his own.
Units/astraYarrick_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Commissar Yarrick
Units/blackAbaddon_Description: The name of Abaddon, Warmaster of Chaos, favoured champion of all Chaos gods, has become a bitter curse for the Imperium. It is said that he alone has the power to unite the Traitor Legions and finish the treachery begun ten thousand years ago.
Units/blackAbaddon_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Abaddon
Units/blackForgefiend_Description: Forgefiends are fused with enormous rotary cannons and ancient artefact-ordnance perverted to vomit ectoplasma from the beasts’ own innards. With such weaponry they scythe down masses of enemy troops and blast glowing craters into the toughest opposition.
Units/blackHaarken_Description: Before every doom, there is a portent, before every apocalypse a sign. Haarken Worldclaimer is that dark omen given form, and the otherworldly destruction he heralds is the coming of the Warmaster himself.
Units/blackHaarken_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Haarken
Units/blackObliterator_Description: Some believe Obliterators are the by-product of a heretical quest to embody the Omnissiah, whilst others think they are infected with a daemonic technovirus. Whatever creates them, they are a blasphemy against nature and Machine God alike.
Units/blackObliterator_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Volk
Units/blackPossession_Description: Masters of Possession exert the darkest and most blasphemous lore: The art of using hosts of living flesh to house daemons. So thoroughly are they steeped in desecrating sorcery that where they walk, reality itself recoils.
Units/blackPossession_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Archimatos
Units/blackTerminator_Description: This Champion of Chaos has dedicated his life to further the cause of Chaos. An extremely powerful warrior, wearing an indomitable suit of Terminator armour most likely acquired through killing the previous owner.
Units/blackTerminator_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Angrax
Units/bloodDante_Description: Commander Dante is the Bringer of Sanguinius’ Light and the Living Embodiment of the Five Angelic Graces. He is among the oldest living Space Marines and is the longest serving Chapter Master. To describe him as a legend is an understatement bordering on insult.
Units/bloodDeathCompany_Description: Members of the Death Company are possessed of a berserk fury, driven insane by terrible visions and hallucinations. Barely flinching at even the most grievous of injuries, they seek nothing but the destruction of their enemies and death in battle.
Units/bloodIntercessor_Description: Intercessors equipped with powerful jump packs soar over the battlefield, slamming into the foe like a hammer from the skies. They swiftly cut down all opposition with point-blank pistol fire and furious slashes, before launching off to engage the next target.
Units/bloodMephiston_Description: Mephiston is an enormously powerful warrior and psyker. He is the only Blood Angel known to have suppressed the Black Rage, resurrecting from near death with exceptional strength and speed. Many whisper behind his back, asking what price he paid for such a transformation.
Units/bloodSanguinary_Description: The Blood Angels’ Apothecaries hold responsibility for the Chapter’s soul as well as its body. Through their ministrations and ceremonies they call upon the Blood Angels to embrace the Red Thirst, control it and unleash their rage upon the enemy.
Units/custoAtlacoya_Description: Atlacoya took her vow of silence upon joining the Sisters of Silence. She is stationed aboard a Black Ship, tasked with collecting a cargo of psykers for the Imperial Tithe - most to be sacrificed to the Golden Throne, a fact that she accepts as a necessity for the continuation of the Imperium.
Units/custoBladeChampion_Description: A Blade Champion's role is to identify the greatest battlefield threat and ensure its swift destruction. They are well‐equipped for the task, wielding crackling archeotech blades in a variety of combat styles, each perfect for dealing with a different kind of foe.
Units/custoKyrus_Description: Tyrith sees enacting the Emperor’s Will as her utmost duty. She was an advocate for expanding the reach of the Custodians beyond the halls of the Imperial Palace to guard against any risk to the Throne, even condemning worlds to Exterminatus in order to divert threats from Terra.
Units/custoTrajann_Description: Many claim that Trajann Valoris is the greatest warrior to have ever held the title of Captain-General, one of the most powerful military appointments in the Imperium. Valoris is responsible for the overall defence of the Sol System, Terra, and the Emperor himself.
Units/custoVexilusPraetor_Description: Vexilus Praetors are veteran Custodians who have the incomparable privilege of bearing one of the Custodes’ prized vexillas into battle. These inspirational, artisan-crafted banners bear arcane technologies and radiate with the Emperor’s own light.
Units/darkaAsmodai_Description: Asmodai is the Dark Angels’ most successful Interrogator-Chaplain. Relentless and humourless, in battle he incites his brothers’ fighting spirit to reach new heights, rendering them unstoppable killing machines by chanting his litanies of hate with unshakeable belief.
Units/darkaAzrael_Description: As the "Keeper of the Truth", Azrael carries the dark burden of his chapter. As masterful commander, he quickly grasps changing battlefield realities and orchestrates his forces to maximum advantage. As a warrior, he never falters.
Units/darkaAzrael_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Azrael
Units/darkaCompanion_Description: Wielding Calibanite greatswords with breathtaking skill, Inner Circle Companions are sinister warriors whether battling as allies or enemies. They fight in silence, save for the whine of their armour servos and the crunch of their blades through flesh and bone.
Units/darkaHellblaster_Description: Bolt after bolt of plasma sears across the battlefield; those caught in the Hellblasters’ sights are swiftly annihilated, their armour blasted to ash and their flesh and bone to glowing motes.
Units/darkaHellblaster_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Sarquael
Units/darkaStormSpeeder_Description: The Hailstrike is so heavily armed that it can annihilate entire swathes of infantry in fusillades of blistering projectiles. Speeding over the battlefield, its specialised loadout shatters charging formations and shreds barricades and defences.
Units/darkaTerminator_Description: Deploying rapidly onto the battlefield via blazing teleport strikes, Deathwing Terminators pour heavy fire into their enemies or engage them in brutal melee. They are the unbreakable elite of the Dark Angels that can conquer and hold any key position.
Units/deathBlightbringer_Description: Cursed plague bells tolling, Noxious Blightbringers erode the enemy’s will to fight and spawn maggots in the minds of psykers. To the Death Guard the sound is beautiful, and upon hearing it they surge eagerly into the fray.
Units/deathBlightbringer_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Corrodius
Units/deathBlightlord_Description: Relentless and unstoppably tough, Blightlord Terminators are elite Death Guard warriors who are bound forever to their mutated Armour. They are saturated with foulness, which pours off them to rot flesh and corrode metal.
Units/deathBlightlord_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Maladus
Units/deathCrawler_Description: The brainchild of Mortarion himself, the Plagueburst Crawler is a hulking and incredibly resilient Daemon Engine. Equipped with Plagueburst mortars, they launch hideously powerful explosive shells that unleash clouds of corrosive spores upon detonation.
Units/deathPutrifier_Description: Biologus Putrifiers take obscene delight in developing myriad plagues and spreading them with blight grenades during battle. With their injector pistols they implant killing maladies into the enemy before extracting samples for their next experiment.
Units/deathPutrifier_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Pestillian
Units/deathRotbone_Description: This accomplished Plague Surgeon is the personal physician of Mortarion himself. And he is the keeper of the surgical dungeons deep within the Black Manse, wherein the Death Guard keep their stocks of tainted gene-seed.
Units/deathRotbone_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Nauseous Rotbone
Units/deathTyphus_Description: Once first Captain of the Death Guard, Calas Typhon led his whole legion into the rotten embrace of the God of Plagues. Now he is Typhus, the Herald of Nurgle, spreading his god’s devastating gifts throughout the galaxy.
Units/deathTyphus_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Typhus
Units/deathTyphus_Name: Typhus, Host of the Destroyer Hive
Units/eldarAutarch_Description: Autarchs are renowned for their strategic brilliance, sublime martial skill and indomitable strength of will. Wielding tactics mastered across millennia of battle, they apply all that they have learned to their command of the Asuryani war hosts.
Units/eldarAutarch_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Aethana
Units/eldarFarseer_Description: Psykers of unparalleled ability and renown, the Farseers meticulously plan and execute strategies covering thousands of years. Even their smallest actions can bring enormous change; they are the butterfly's wings and the hurricane in one.
Units/eldarFarseer_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Eldryon
Units/eldarJainZar_Description: To watch Jain Zar in combat is to watch an exquisite dance, amidst leg sweeps, dodging twists and graceful pirouettes, the glowing polearm scythes and darts until only Jain Zar is left standing.
Units/eldarJainZar_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Jain Zar
Units/eldarMauganRa_Description: Maugan Ra, the Harvester of Souls, is a master at killing from a distance. Maugetar, his scythe-like weapon, fires mind-linked shuriken discs large enough to decapitate swaths of foes and can end even more lives with its built-in reaping blade.
Units/eldarMauganRa_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Maugan Ra
Units/eldarRanger_Description: Rangers are outcast wanderers who left the regimented lives of the craftworlds behind them. Adepts in the arts of stealth warfare, marksmanship, and tracking enemies through harsh terrain, the Rangers aid their brethren as scouts and snipers.
Units/eldarRanger_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Calandis
Units/emperExultant_Description: Lords Exultant embody the Emperor's Children's obsessive desire to experience new and terrible sensations. Their enhanced forms possess all manner of sensory enhancements, allowing them to experience the thrill of battle on a level that would drive lesser mortals to insanity.
Units/emperFlawlessBlade_Description: These cruel and arrogant warriors are consumed by pride in their own skill at arms. Granted power by daemonic patrons, the Flawless Blades strive to entertain their malefic masters with superlative swordplay and by inflicting vile and visceral death upon their foes.
Units/emperFlawlessBlade_Name: Hascule Thorn of the Silken Blade
Units/emperKakophonist_Description: Lords Kakophonist are infernal conductors leading an orchestra of discordant and deafening slaughter. Such is their singular obsession with emitting lethal sonic destruction that their bodies have been agonisingly sculpted to further their art.
Units/emperLucius_Description: An arrogant slaughterer and swordmaster supreme, Lucius seeks out the most skilled enemy champions to find worthy opponents. His curse has seen him return from death many times, each resurrection leaving him more hollow, but compelled to become greater still.
Units/emperNoiseMarine_Description: Noise Marines saturate the war zone with extreme psychosonic attacks that unleash shattering noise and aural destruction. These hedonistic worshippers of Slaanesh are inured to most stimuli and seek to unleash the most cacophonous riots to stir their jaded senses.
Units/genesBiophagus_Description: A Biophagus is a scientist-surgeon and deadly agent of biological warfare. Their injector goad can be used to enhance the unholy might of Aberrants and other favoured cultists, or to dose enemies with a mutagenic cocktail that rapidly dissolves them from within.
Units/genesKelermorph_Description: These gunfighters are living icons of rebellion, moulded to exploit the psyche of fractured Human societies. Whip-fast reactions and hyper-sensory acuity lend the Kelermorph lethal reaction speeds and help them unleash withering volleys from their iconic liberator autostubs.
Units/genesMagus_Description: The Magus acts as its Patriarch’s vizier, and as the head of that alien monstrosity’s deviant church. Each one is a powerful psyker, their formidable will enhanced by the gestalt powers of the Star Children until they can manipulate enemies’ minds and bodies like puppets.
Units/genesPatriarch_Description: Psychic abomination; alpha predator; parasitic demigod – the Patriarch is all of these things and worse. Prowling the shadows of embattled worlds, they are the source of the bio corruption that spawns each Genestealer Cult cell.
Units/genesPrimus_Description: The Primus is a Genestealer Cult’s ultimate military commander. Besides being deadly combatants in their own right, their mastery of insurgent tactics transforms their followers from a rebellious mob into a lethal military machine.
Units/GuildBoss5Boss1DeathMortarion_Titl: Daemon Primarch of the Death Guard
Units/necroDestroyer_Description: Lethal ambush predators, Hexmark Destroyers unleash inescapable hails of enmitic fire. Independent ocular targeting and optimised firing patterns leave their prey with no escape.
Units/necroDestroyer_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Imospekh
Units/necroOverlord_Description: Commanding legion upon legion of deathless soldiers whose only purpose is to obey his every order, Anuphet is a cold, calculating demigod.
Units/necroOverlord_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Anuphet
Units/necroPlasmancer_Description: Plasmancers are unsubtle annihilators. They are capable of wielding energy as a weapon itself rather than needing to bind it to other forms.
Units/necroPlasmancer_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Thutmose
Units/necroSpyder_Description: Canoptek Spyders never sleep, but while away the aeons servicing the structures of their Tomb World. The Canoptek Spyder is essentially an automated drone, but still a formidable foe when the situation demands.
Units/necroSpyder_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Aleph-Null
Units/necroWarden_Description: Royal Wardens serve directly under an Overlord and ensure their lord’s will is carried out by the Dynasty’s armies. Royal Wardens can modify the orders to phalanxes of Necron Infantry, increasing their efficiency.
Units/necroWarden_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Makhotep
Units/orksBigMek_Description: Projected from a mass of whirly bits and alarmingly-sparking gubbinz, the kustom force field is a wobbling energy dome, leaving the Mek and his oblivious mates protected from incoming fire and free to storm onward into battle.
Units/orksBigMek_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Gibbascrapz
Units/orksKillaKan_Description: Surgically wiring grots into combat walkers is risky: the runty loons tend to go on a bit of a power trip, hazardous to every Ork that ever treated them badly. It is, however, also hazardous to every enemy in the way.
Units/orksKillaKan_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Snappawrecka
Units/orksNob_Description: To compensate for a lifetime of perpetual concussion, nature has furnished smasha squigs with virtually no brain. Only the most belligerent Nobz can keep these beasts pointed forward long enough to make metal- and bone-pulverizing impacts.
Units/orksNob_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Tanksmasha
Units/orksRukkatrukk_Description: These vehicles started as mobile food wagons, but became weapons of war the moment Orks realised how hilarious it was to pelt the enemy (or their mates) with more nasty or aggressive squigs from afar.
Units/orksRuntherd_Description: It takes an Ork of infinite patience – by Ork standards – and a gimlet glare to wrangle a war band’s grots and snots. Of course, a savage squig hound with which to make a few examples doesn’t hurt either.
Units/orksRuntherd_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Snotflogga
Units/orksWarboss_Description: A towering slab of muscle, metal and bad attitude, a Warboss who leads the charge from the very front, bulldozing a bloody path through the enemy. Meanwhile, his window-rattling war cry motivates his ladz to ever more gratuitous violence.
Units/orksWarboss_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Boss Gulgortz
Units/spaceBlackmane_Description: Supremely confident and eager always to be first into the fray, Wolf Lord Ragnar Blackmane leads his Great Company in devastating planetary invasions. No longer as headstrong as in his youth, Ragnar's berserk rages are still furious hurricanes of violence.
Units/spaceBlackmane_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Ragnar
Units/spaceHound_Description: Daubed with runes of warding and abjuration, Hounds of Morkai are obsessed hunters of psykers. Runic circuitry augments their uniquely pitched hunting call, disrupting their prey’s powers and sowing fear before the kill.
Units/spaceHound_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Tjark
Units/spaceRockfist_Description: A former Iron Priest of the forge, Arjac is a towering mass of muscle and a taciturn anvil of endurance, who upholds the honour of the Chapter. Wielding the enormous Foehammer, Arjac crushes his enemies with pulverising strength.
Units/spaceRockfist_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Arjac
Units/spaceStormcaller_Description: Known as the "Storm That Walks," Njal is the Space Wolves Chapter's High Rune Priest. Summoning ice-toothed blizzards to scatter his foes, he is an elemental focus of psychic fury.
Units/spaceStormcaller_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Njal
Units/spaceWolfPriest_Description: Wolf Priests are elder sages who tend to their battle‑brothers’ spiritual and physical well‑being. In battle, they inspire by bellowing litanies and extracts from epic sagas. Clad in black, bedecked with shamanistic totems and wearing wolf‑skull helms, they are terrifying to behold.
Units/spaceWulfen_Description: Altered by the Curse lying in the blood of all scions of the Wolf King, Wulfen exist on the brink of constant berserk rages. They are bestial warriors and savage hunters, ripping foes apart with inhuman speed.
Units/spaceWulfen_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Ulf
Units/tauAunShi_Description: Aun'Shi is a hero to his people, a humble warrior whose presence inspires the T'au warriors around him. Marrying the uplifting nature of his Ethereal caste with exceptional martial skill, Aun'Shi is a blazing beacon lighting the path to victory.
Units/tauAunShi_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Aun'Shi
Units/tauBroadside_Description: Broadside Battlesuit teams annihilate everything that falls beneath their sights. Each battlesuit is an indomitable slab of high-tech armour, while their iconic heavy rail rifles and other long-range weaponry can make short work of even the toughest enemy targets.
Units/tauCrisis_Description: Piloted by courageous Fire Caste veterans, XV8 Crisis Battlesuits are as tough and well armed as other races light tanks, yet they also boast jet-assisted speed to strike swiftly wherever the battle rages most fiercely.
Units/tauCrisis_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Re'vas
Units/tauDarkstrider_Description: As much a maverick as he is a master of covert operations, Darkstrider is a formidable leader of stealth and sabotage missions. Despite often not following protocol, his expertise in guerilla warfare renders him an invaluable asset for the T'au.
Units/tauDarkstrider_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Darkstrider
Units/tauFarsight_Description: Aggressive and rebellious, Commander O'Shovah is an undisputed master of Mont'ka, the T'au metastrategy of the Killing Blow. Piloting his crimson battlesuit, he leads his separatist Fire Caste forces from the front, carving a bloody path into the enemy.
Units/tauMarksman_Description: Hidden behind shimmering stealth fields, a Firesight Marksman transmits targeting data to the MV71 Sniper Drones in their thrall or, when deadly precision shots are not enough, calls in seeker missile strikes from artillery and air support.
Units/tauMarksman_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Sho'syl
Units/tauShadowsun_Description: An exceptional student of legendary commander Puretide, O'Shaserra excelled as a deadly warrior and brilliant commander. She is now the living spearhead and staunchest defender of the Greater Good and a shining example for the whole T'au empire.
Units/tauShadowsun_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Shadowsun
Units/tauShadowsun_Title: Supreme Commander of the T'au Empire
Units/templAggressor_Description: Capable of spearheading devastating offences, Aggressors are walking ceramite strong-points. They excel at close-quarters combat and laying down torrents of withering fire before crushing their foes with their energised fists.
Units/templAggressor_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Brother Burchard
Units/templAncient_Description: Ancients bear the honour of carrying their Chapter’s precious standards into battle, which incorporate the remains of fallen heroes. In their presence, battle-brothers are inspired to emulate the legendary deeds of these paragons of old.
Units/templAncient_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Ancient Thoread
Units/templChampion_Description: On the eve of battle, one among the Black Templars will receive a vision from the Emperor. The Chaplains will bless him and adorn him with the finest weapons, for he will seek out and strike down the enemy leaders as the Emperor’s Champion.
Units/templChampion_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Brother Jaeger
Units/templHelbrecht_Description: Helbrecht is the living embodiment of his Chapter’s warrior spirit. His battle-brothers follow him without question, for they believe where High Marshal Helbrecht treads, so too walks the Emperor himself.
Units/templHelbrecht_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Helbrecht
Units/templHelbrecht_Title: High Marshal of the Black Templars
Units/templSwordBrother_Description: An unstoppable, uncompromising and reaping whirlwind on the battlefield, every Sword Brother has earned their place amongst the Marshal’s household through acts of unswerving faith and spectacular violence.
Units/templSwordBrother_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Brother Godswyl
Units/thousAhriman_Description: For ten thousand years, the seeker of truth known as Ahriman has roamed the galaxy in a quest to acquire every artefact, tome and scroll that harbours eldritch knowledge. Worlds burn in his shadow as he plucks these treasures by any means necessary.
Units/thousAhriman_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Ahriman
Units/thousDaemonPrince_Description: Daemon Princes of Tzeentch are potent sorcerers and monstrous warriors, terrifying in their martial might. Buoyed upon sorcerous zephyrs, they revel in hurling arcane fire from on high, reinforcing their megalomaniacal superiority over their foes.
Units/thousInfernalMaster_Description: Infernal Masters forge pacts with daemonic entities, called tutelaries. They can unleash the powers of these malign familiars to engulf their foes in swarms of momentarily corporeal terrors or to master the currents of the empyrean itself.
Units/thousInfernalMaster_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Abraxas
Units/thousSorcerer_Description: Twisted arcanists, wicked of intent and strange of form, these warrior-mystics have an encyclopædic knowledge of spells and are able to bend reality to their desires.
Units/thousSorcerer_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Thaumachus
Units/thousTerminator_Description: Undead husks of dust controlled by their Sorcerer masters, the Scarab Occult Terminators advance upon their foes implacably and as silent as the grave, still fighting with all the merciless skill they had when they were Magnus’ elite bodyguards.
Units/thousTerminator_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Toth
Units/thousTzaangor_Description: Most blessed of all their kind, the Enlightened see the skeins of fate through communion with Tzeentch. They surge to battle atop daemonic discs, their Fatecaster Greatbows launching ensorcelled arrows from ectoplasmic strings with lethal effect.
Units/thousTzaangor_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Yazaghor
Units/tyranBiovore_Description: These living artillery pieces nurture a clutch of Spore Mines within their bodies. After anchoring themselves to the ground with their chitinous spurs, the creatures fire their living ammunition in high arcs into the midst of the foe where it detonates with sudden violence.
Units/tyranDeathleaper_Description: The Hive Mind created this advancement of the Lictor strain as a terror weapon. Possessing an instinctive understanding of how to spread fear, it uses its skills in stealth, infiltration and assassination to sow paranoia and dread before the hive fleet attacks en masse.
Units/tyranDeathleaper_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for the Deathleaper
Units/tyranNeurothrope_Description: A Neurothrope’s physical form is given over to harnessing the power of the Hive Mind. Not only do they act as synapse nodes, but are a pulsing nexus of the Hive Mind's psychic might, channelling alien impulses into an eldritch onslaught.
Units/tyranNeurothrope_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for the Neurothrope
Units/tyranParasite_Description: Swooping on leathery wings, Parasites of Mortrex use their barbed ovipositors to drive Ripper gestation pods deep into their victims’ bodies. They wreak havoc on the foes of the Hive Fleet by soaring over defences and seeding unlucky souls with nascent Rippers.
Units/tyranParasite_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for the Parasite of Mortrex
Units/tyranTyrantGuard_Description: Tyrant Guards are the ultimate bodyguards, the entire purpose of their creation being to protect their Hive Tyrant. They take the form of colossal living shields, all but impervious to even the heaviest weapons.
Units/tyranTyrantGuard_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for the Tyrant Guard
Units/tyranWingedPrime_Description: The Winged Tyranid Prime is the apex of the Tyranid Warrior strain. Boasting powerful wings and a greater synaptic capacity than their lesser kindred, these alpha Warriors command the swarming tide of chitinous horrors that signals a Hive Fleet's arrival.
Units/tyranWingedPrime_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for the Winged Prime
Units/ultraApothecary_Description: Amongst the most honoured Space Marines of a Chapter are its Apothecaries. It is their role to mind the physical well-being of their battle-brothers. On the battlefield, they serve as medics.
Units/ultraApothecary_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Incisus
Units/ultraCalgar_Description: Marneus Calgar, Chapter Master of the Ultramarines, is not only a consummate warrior, but also a highly talented strategist. He is master of Ultramar, a vast swathe of space on the embattled Eastern Fringe.
Units/ultraCalgar_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Marneus Calgar
Units/ultraDreadnought_Description: Redemptor Dreadnoughts are some of the largest of their kind ever fielded by the Adeptus Astartes. Armed to the teeth, they can be equipped to utterly destroy any kind of battlefield target with hails of solid shot, super-heated plasma or crushing redemptor fist.
Units/ultraEliminatorSgt_Description: Dedicated marksmen, Eliminators haunt the shadows of the battlefield, seeking out targets of opportunity and bringing them down. Then, these silent assassins slip away looking for their next prey.
Units/ultraEliminatorSgt_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Certus
Units/ultraInceptorSgt_Description: Equipped with jump packs and reinforced armour, Inceptors hit the enemy in one sudden and overwhelming blow, leaving them reeling as follow-up waves of Space Marines drive home the attack.
Units/ultraInceptorSgt_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Bellator
Units/ultraTigurius_Description: Tigurius is the Ultramarines Chief Librarian and as such is one of the most powerful psykers in the Imperium. Since crossing the Rubicon Primaris he can push his abilities even further.
Units/ultraTigurius_LaurelLocation: Here you will see where to find Shards for Varro Tigurius
Units/ultraTitus_Description: Amongst the ranks of the Ultramarines, Lieutenant Titus has a reputation for decisive action and incredible warrior skill. He has fought countless battles in the Emperor’s name and always emerged victorious despite seemingly impossible odds.
Units/votanIronmaster_Description: Brôkhyrs are the engineers and artisans of the Leagues, and Iron-masters are the most accomplished of their kind. In battle, they take on the duty of maintaining damaged Kin war engines, often aided by Ironkin and COG repair crews. These veteran Brôkhyrs also bring their most powerful creations to war, taking satisfaction in unleashing them upon the foe with their own hands.
Units/votanMemnyr_Description: Memnyr Strategists are superlative martial tacticians. They can extrapolate a foe’s plans so well that their advice borders on supernatural precognition, enabling the Kin to strike devastating blows when least expected.
Units/votanUthar_Description: As the most accomplished hero of the Greater Thurian League, Ûthar the Destined is a Kâhl marked for greatness. Few can assess the foe as swiftly or mercilessly as Ûthar and – once he has his enemies’ measure – he soon cuts them to pieces with the glowing Blade of the Ancestors.
Units/worldEightbound_Description: Each Eightbound is possessed by an octet of Khornate daemons. Achieving a form of apotheosis, as their mortal soul conquers the daemons that share its body, Exalted Eightbound exhibit a purer and more focused rage – one that is directed entirely at their foes.
Units/worldExecutions_Description: Masters of Executions are the enforcers and headhunters of Chaos warbands. These single-minded axemen stride unflinchingly towards the enemy's greatest champions and most beloved leaders, bellowing a fatal decree before crashing forward and claiming their skulls.
Units/worldJakhal_Description: Jakhals are the strongest, most savage, and bloodthirstiest followers of the World Eaters. Though merely human, these elite cultists seek to emulate the frenzied purity of their gore-crazed masters in any way they can, and dive into combat with wild abandon.
Units/worldKharn_Description: Kill! Maim! Burn! This is Khârn’s mantra, and it has become infamous across the Imperium as a harbinger of carnage to follow. Khârn embodies the eightfold path of Khorne; friend and foe alike are left broken, twitching and torn apart in his wake.
Units/worldTerminator_Description: Clad in – or fused to – ancient suits of corrupted war-plate, Chaos Terminators are murderous elites akin to walking tanks. Wading through futile volleys of enemy fire, they tear apart squads and vehicles alike at the head of their warband.
